title: A foundation model for electrodermal activity data
summary: Foundation models have recently extended beyond natural language and vision to timeseries domains, including physiological signals. However, progress in electrodermal activity (EDA) modeling is hindered by the absence of large-scale, curated, and openly accessible datasets. EDA reflects sympathetic nervous system activity and is widely used to infer cognitive load, stress, and engagement. Yet very few wearable devices provide continuous, unobtrusive sensing, and the only large-scale archive to date is proprietary. To address this gap, we compile EDAMAME, a collection of EDA traces from 24 public datasets, comprising more than 25,000 hours from 634 users. Using this resource, we train UME, the first dedicated foundation model for EDA. In eight out of ten scenarios, UME outperforms baselines and matches generalist timeseries foundation models while using 20x fewer computational resources. Our findings, however, also highlight the intrinsic challenges of EDA modeling, motivating further research to unlock its full potential. All datasets, model weights, and code are released to support further research.

AI.tldr: 构建了包含25,000+小时EDA数据的大规模数据集EDAMAME，并训练了首个专用EDA基础模型UME，在多数任务上优于基线且匹配通用时序模型，计算效率提升20倍。
AI.motivation: 基础模型已扩展到时序和生理信号领域，但EDA（皮肤电活动）建模缺乏大规模、公开可用的数据集。EDA反映交感神经活动，广泛用于推断认知负荷、压力和参与度此前仅有专有数据集可用。
AI.method: 从24个公共数据集中收集EDA信号，构建了包含634名用户超过25,000小时数据的EDAMAME数据集，并基于此训练了首个专用EDA基础模型UME。模型与基线和通用时序基础模型进行了对比评估。
AI.result: 在10个场景中的8个，UME优于基线方法，并与通用时序基础模型性能相当，同时使用减少了20倍的计算资源。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了EDA建模的内在挑战，需要进一步研究来释放其全部潜力。所有数据集、模型权重和代码均已发布以支持后续研究。

title: Federated Multi Agent Deep Learning and Neural Networks for Advanced Distributed Sensing in Wireless Networks
summary: Multi-agent deep learning (MADL), including multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL), distributed/federated training, and graph-structured neural networks, is becoming a unifying framework for decision-making and inference in wireless systems where sensing, communication, and computing are tightly coupled. Recent 5G-Advanced and 6G visions strengthen this coupling through integrated sensing and communication, edge intelligence, open programmable RAN, and non-terrestrial/UAV networking, which create decentralized, partially observed, time-varying, and resource-constrained control problems. This survey synthesizes the state of the art, with emphasis on 2021-2025 research, on MADL for distributed sensing and wireless communications. We present a task-driven taxonomy across (i) learning formulations (Markov games, Dec-POMDPs, CTDE), (ii) neural architectures (GNN-based radio resource management, attention-based policies, hierarchical learning, and over-the-air aggregation), (iii) advanced techniques (federated reinforcement learning, communication-efficient federated deep RL, and serverless edge learning orchestration), and (iv) application domains (MEC offloading with slicing, UAV-enabled heterogeneous networks with power-domain NOMA, intrusion detection in sensor networks, and ISAC-driven perceptive mobile networks). We also provide comparative tables of algorithms, training topologies, and system-level trade-offs in latency, spectral efficiency, energy, privacy, and robustness. Finally, we identify open issues including scalability, non-stationarity, security against poisoning and backdoors, communication overhead, and real-time safety, and outline research directions toward 6G-native sense-communicate-compute-learn systems.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述论文，系统梳理了2021—2025年多智能体深度学习（MADL，含MADRL、分布式/联邦训练、图结构神经网络）在无线通信与分布式感知中的应用现状，提出以任务为导向的四层分类体系（学习范式、神经架构、进阶技术、应用域），并给出算法/训练拓扑对比表与系统级权衡分析，最后指出可扩展性、非平稳性、投毒与后门安全、通信开销、实时安全等开放问题及面向6G"感知-通信-计算-学习"原生系统的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 5G-Advanced与6G愿景将集成感知与通信（ISAC）、边缘智能、开放可编程RAN、非地面/无人机网络等能力引入无线系统，使感知、通信、计算高度耦合，形成去中心化、部分可观测、时变且资源受限的控制与推断问题。传统集中式优化与单智能体深度学习方法难以处理这种耦合，需要一个统一的多智能体深度学习框架来组织并推进相关研究，但该领域近三年成果分散、缺乏体系化分类与横向比较。
AI.method: 以2021—2025年文献为重点进行综述式综合，建立任务驱动的分类法：(i) 学习形式（马尔可夫博弈、Dec-POMDP、集中训练分散执行CTDE）；(ii) 神经网络架构（基于GNN的无线资源管理、注意力策略、层次化学习、空口聚合）；(iii) 高级技术（联邦强化学习、通信高效联邦深度RL、无服务器边缘学习编排）；(iv) 应用域（MEC卸载与网络切片、含功率域NOMA的无人机异构网络、传感器网络入侵检测、ISAC驱动的感知移动网络）。并编制算法对比表、训练拓扑表，以及在时延、频谱效率、能耗、隐私、鲁棒性等维度的系统级权衡分析。
AI.result: 综述给出了MADL在分布式感知与无线通信中的全景图景：GNN策略适合刻画拓扑耦合的无线资源分配，注意力机制与层次化结构提升部分可观测下的策略表达与可扩展性，空口聚合与通信高效联邦DRL降低分布式训练的信令与回传开销，联邦RL在多接入边缘计算卸载/切片与UAV-NOMA网络中兼顾隐私与性能，ISAC场景下多智能体协同实现感知与通信资源联合优化；同时明确了各类方法在时延、频效、能耗、隐私与鲁棒性上的相对优劣与各自适用的部署条件（集中式/分层/完全分布式训练拓扑）。
AI.conclusion: 结论指出MADL是应对6G耦合式无线系统决策问题的有前景的统一框架，但当前研究仍受可扩展性、非平稳环境与智能体非平稳性、对训练数据投毒与后门攻击的鲁棒性、通信开销以及真实部署中的实时安全约束等瓶颈限制；未来方向是构建6G原生的"感知—通信—计算—学习"（sense-communicate-compute-learn）协同系统，将多智能体学习与ISAC、边缘智能、可编程RAN深度整合。

authors: Krishna Kumar Neelakanta Pillai Santha Kumari Amma
title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Pricing: Balancing Profitability,Stability and Fairness
summary: Dynamic pricing in competitive retail markets requires strategies that adapt to fluctuating demand and competitor behavior. In this work, we present a systematic empirical evaluation of multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) approaches-specifically MAPPO and MADDPG-for dynamic price optimization under competition. Using a simulated marketplace environment derived from real-world retail data, we benchmark these algorithms against an Independent DDPG (IDDPG) baseline, a widely used independent learner in MARL literature. We evaluate profit performance, stability across random seeds, fairness, and training efficiency. Our results show that MAPPO consistently achieves the highest average returns with low variance, offering a stable and reproducible approach for competitive price optimization, while MADDPG achieves slightly lower profit but the fairest profit distribution among agents. These findings demonstrate that MARL methods-particularly MAPPO-provide a scalable and stable alternative to independent learning approaches for dynamic retail pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文对多智能体强化学习（MARL）方法在竞争性零售市场动态定价中的应用进行了系统性实证评估，发现MAPPO在利润和稳定性方面最优，MADDPG在公平性方面最佳。
AI.motivation: 竞争性零售市场中的动态定价需要适应需求波动和竞争者行为的策略，传统的定价方法难以应对多智能体竞争环境的复杂性。
AI.method: 使用基于真实零售数据构建的模拟市场环境，对MAPPO、MADDPG和IDDPG进行基准测试，评估指标包括利润表现、随机种子稳定性、公平性和训练效率。
AI.result: MAPPO实现最高平均回报且方差低，表现稳定可复现；MADDPG利润略低但智能体间利润分配最公平。
AI.conclusion: MARL方法（尤其是MAPPO）为动态零售定价提供了可扩展且稳定的解决方案，优于独立学习策略。MAPPO在利润和稳定性方面表现最佳，而MADDPG在公平性方面更具优势。

title: From Language to Action in Arabic: Reliable Structured Tool Calling via Data-Centric Fine-Tuning
summary: Function-calling language models are essential for agentic AI systems that translate natural language into executable structured actions, yet existing models exhibit severe structural instability when applied to Arabic. We present AISA-AR-FunctionCall, a production-oriented Arabic function-calling framework built on a 270M-parameter FunctionGemma backbone and trained through systematic dataset auditing, schema repair, tool-aware prompt restructuring, and full-parameter supervised fine-tuning. On a held-out test set, fine-tuning reduces parse failures from 87\% to below 1\%, improves function name accuracy by more than eightfold, and substantially enhances argument alignment across dialects and domains. Error analysis reveals a transition from structural collapse to semantic misalignment, suggesting that serialization stability and decision-level reasoning are separable challenges. We further explore a reasoning-augmented LoRA variant that introduces explicit intermediate reasoning prior to tool invocation. All datasets and models are publicly released under the AISA framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AISA-AR-FunctionCall：以 270M 参数的 FunctionGemma 为基座，通过数据集审计与模式修复、随机工具采样降长、FunctionGemma 控制符模板序列化以及全参数监督微调，得到面向阿拉伯语的可执行函数调用模型。测试集上解析失败率从 87% 降至 1% 以下，函数名准确率提升八倍以上；同时发布 AISA-AR-FunctionCall-Think（LoRA 推理增强探索版），并开源全部数据集与模型。
AI.motivation: 函数调用/工具使用是智能体系统将自然语言意图转化为可执行结构化动作的关键环节，但现有多语言模型在阿拉伯语上出现严重的「结构崩塌」：输出无法被解析为合法函数调用、工具选择近乎随机。作者指出该问题不仅源于基座模型，更源于提示格式、schema 设计、运行时校验与评测盲点的交互（MASSIVE-Agents 等跨语言基准亦显示英语之外性能显著下滑）。同时，阿拉伯语 NLP 虽有 AraBERT、Jais、AceGPT 等本地化模型，但工具调用数据集与智能体评测资源相对匮乏。因此本文以「数据为中心」路线：先修复数据与序列化，再谈语义决策，并借 AISA 分层架构（模型/工具/编排/评测/部署/治理）把函数调用从提示工程问题升级为可审计、可部署的系统工程问题。
AI.method: 基座：unsloth/functiongemma-270m-it（268M 可训练权重，FunctionGemma 控制符接口）。数据源为 Arabic Function Calling（50,810 样本、36 工具、5 种方言 MSA/埃及/海湾/黎凡特/马格里布、8 个领域）。管线：(1) 结构审计，发现四类缺陷——负样本静默输出、枚举违规、重复/语义重叠工具、工具声明过多导致提示截断；(2) schema 修复，将枚举校验规则由 v∈Enum 改为 (v=None)∨(v∈Enum)，恢复数千被误删样本并复活 6 个「死工具」，同时归一化枚举值（阿拉伯语表层形式/英文变体→schema 规范值）；(3) 工具剪枝与整合，工具数 36→27；(4) 随机工具采样（stochastic tool sampling）：每个样本固定 5 个工具，正样本为真值工具+4 个无放回干扰工具、负样本全随机并随机置换以去位置偏置，中位提示长度由 ~4,900 token 降至 ~793 token（上限 2048）；(5) FunctionGemma 四段式聊天序列化：developer 轮（含时间戳以支持「明天/下周一」等时间推理）、控制符工具声明、阿拉伯语用户查询、助手结构化调用，启用 completion-only masking（dataset_text_field="text"），损失仅作用于助手调用 token；(6) 分层划分 41,104 训练 / 4,568 验证 / 5,079 留出测试，保持领域与方言分布并防泄漏；(7) 全参数微调：2 epoch、per-device bs 4、梯度累积 8（有效 bs 32）、8-bit AdamW、cosine 调度、初始学习率 2e-5、BF16、梯度检查点。探索变体 Think：在 12k 样本上用 <think>…</think> 包裹显式推理轨迹再接 <start_function_call>，采用 LoRA（r=64, α=64, dropout=0.05，约 5.36% 可训练参数）、3 epoch、lr 3e-6，并加入 no-tool 弃答样本以抑制幻觉。评测指标涵盖解析失败率、格式合法率、函数名准确率、完整调用匹配、参数 F1/精确匹配、幻觉率，按方言与领域细分，并做错误类型分布迁移与人工定性分析。
AI.result: 基线呈系统性结构失败：>87% 输出无法解析为合法函数调用，函数名准确率 <8%，完整调用匹配几乎为零；错误分布中解析失败占 80.7%，正确率仅 0.3%。全参微调后解析失败率降至 <1%（0.76%），格式合法率接近 100%，函数名准确率提升八倍以上，正确输出占比升至 20.3%，且负样本弃答保持 100% 准确，说明结构恢复未以过度调用为代价。方言维度：MSA 0.0862→0.7613、海湾 0.0526→0.6972、埃及 0.0493→0.6834、黎凡特 0.0633→0.6948、马格里布 0.0452→0.6158，方言差距显著收窄。领域维度：结构化交易型领域（公用事业、旅行、天气、伊斯兰服务）表现最佳，政府服务等程序/规管复杂领域最弱。错误结构从「结构崩塌」转为「语义错位」：解析失败 80.7%→0.76%，而工具幻觉升至 24.7%、错误函数 23.6%、参数不匹配 20.2%。定性错误包括天气与空气质量混淆、转账与货币转换误路由、政府与医疗跨域混淆、隐含参数导致参数漂移。Think 变体在 n=240 严格评测子集上：工具调用率 0.992、思考前置率 1.000、函数名准确率 0.992、参数 F1 1.000、幻觉率 0；但因输出含 <think> 前缀，严格格式校验器会将其判为解析失败，需在部署感知评测下解读。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论：多语言结构化执行的瓶颈是数据与监督对齐问题，而非模型规模问题——270M 轻量模型在精心的数据修复与序列化工程下即可获得可靠的阿拉伯语函数调用能力。作者主张「两阶段进阶」范式：先保证格式与 schema 稳定性（序列化可通过格式感知训练强制），再进行语义校准与决策层推理（工具消歧、参数对齐），后者可能需要对比式/排序式监督与置信度校准（列为未来工作）。此外分层架构（AISA）视角强调 schema 校验、安全派发、结构化解析与重试、版本化数据集与发布门禁、基于 NIST AI RMF/ISO 42001 的治理与可观测性是生产级智能体的必要组成，而非事后补丁。局限方面：语义级错误占比高、推理变体改变输出序列化带来部署兼容代价、严格/部署感知两套评测口径需谨慎区分。数据集与模型均以 AISA 框架名义公开发布（HuggingFace）。

title: Background and Intellectual Development: Supplementary Material for the Category Mistake Papers
comment: 21 pages, tufte-handout format, 21 references. Supplementary material for the FITO Category Mistake paper series
summary: This supplement documents the intellectual trajectory that led to the Category Mistake framework and the Forward-In-Time-Only (FITO) analysis presented in our recent arXiv papers. The ideas crystallized over fifteen years of research, conversation, and engineering practice -- beginning with a 2014 Stanford EE380 lecture on the physics of time in computing, sharpened through a 2016 email exchange with Leslie Lamport following a Papers We Love presentation of his seminal 1978 paper, and matured through the development of Open Atomic Ethernet (OAE). This document traces the concept development from its origins in the physics of entanglement and background-free time, through the recognition that Lamport's "happened-before" relation embeds a category mistake, to the practical engineering consequences documented in "Why iCloud Fails" and "What Distributed Computing Got Wrong." It is intended as archival supplementary material for future arXiv submission.

AI.tldr: 一篇思想史性质的补充文档，追溯了作者十五年来从物理学角度重新审视分布式计算时间概念的学术历程，形成了Category Mistake框架和FITO分析方法，并对现有分布式计算理论提出了根本性批判。
AI.motivation: 为未来arXiv提交提供档案性质的补充材料，记录从物理学角度重新审视分布式计算时间概念的15年思想发展历程。
AI.method: 通过思想史研究方法，追溯了2014年斯坦福EE380讲座、2016年与Leslie Lamport的邮件交流、以及Open Atomic Ethernet (OAE)开发过程中的关键概念演化节点。
AI.result: 建立了Category Mistake框架和FITO分析方法，揭示了Lamport"happened-before"关系中嵌入的范畴错误，并得出分布式计算存在根本性错误的结论。
AI.conclusion: 本文作为补充材料，追溯了Category Mistake框架和FITO分析的十五年发展历程，阐明了从物理学中的纠缠与无背景时间概念，到发现Lamport的"happened-before"关系中的范畴错误，最终形成分布式计算工程批判的完整思想演进脉络。

title: HierarchicalKV: A GPU Hash Table with Cache Semantics for Continuous Online Embedding Storage
summary: Traditional GPU hash tables preserve every inserted key -- a dictionary assumption that wastes scarce High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) when embedding tables routinely exceed single-GPU capacity. We challenge this assumption with cache semantics, where policy-driven eviction is a first-class operation. We introduce HierarchicalKV (HKV), the first general-purpose GPU hash table library whose normal full-capacity operating contract is cache-semantic: each full-bucket upsert (update-or-insert) is resolved in place by eviction or admission rejection rather than by rehashing or capacity-induced failure. HKV co-designs four core mechanisms -- cache-line-aligned buckets, in-line score-driven upsert, score-based dynamic dual-bucket selection, and triple-group concurrency -- and uses tiered key-value separation as a scaling enabler beyond HBM. On an NVIDIA H100 NVL GPU, HKV achieves up to 3.9 billion key-value pairs per second (B-KV/s) find throughput, stable across load factors 0.50-1.00 (<5% variation), and delivers 1.4x higher find throughput than WarpCore (the strongest dictionary-semantic GPU baseline at lambda=0.50) and up to 2.6-9.4x over indirection-based GPU baselines. Since its open-source release in October 2022, HKV has been integrated into multiple open-source recommendation frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HierarchicalKV (HKV)，首个支持缓存语义的GPU哈希表库，采用策略驱动的淘汰机制而非传统字典的全容量保留假设，在NVIDIA H100 NVL上实现最高3.9 B-KV/s查找吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 传统GPU哈希表保留每个插入的键值对，当嵌入表超过单GPU容量时会造成HBM内存浪费。作者挑战这一字典假设，提出缓存语义方法，将策略驱动的淘汰视为一等操作。
AI.method: HKV协同设计了四个核心机制：(1)缓存行对齐的桶结构；(2)内联分数驱动的upsert；(3)基于分数的动态双桶选择；(4)三重组并发。使用键值分离作为超越HBM的扩展使能器。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA H100 NVL GPU上，HKV实现最高3.9 B-KV/s查找吞吐量，在负载因子0.50-1.00范围内保持稳定（<5%变化），比最强基线WarpCore(lambda=0.50)高1.4倍，比基于间接寻址的GPU基线高2.6-9.4倍。
AI.conclusion: HKV是首个支持缓存语义操作的一般用途GPU哈希表库，自2022年10月开源以来已被多个开源推荐框架集成，证明了其实用价值。

title: The State of Generative AI in Software Development: Insights from Literature and a Developer Survey
summary: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) rapidly transforms software engineering, yet existing research remains fragmented across individual tasks in the Software Development Lifecycle. This study integrates a systematic literature review with a survey of 65 software developers. The results show that GenAI exerts its highest impact in design, implementation, testing, and documentation, where over 70 % of developers report at least halving the time for boilerplate and documentation tasks. 79 % of survey respondents use GenAI daily, preferring browser-based Large Language Models over alternatives integrated directly in their development environment. Governance is maturing, with two-thirds of organizations maintaining formal or informal guidelines. In contrast, early SDLC phases such as planning and requirements analysis show markedly lower reported benefits. In a nutshell, GenAI shifts value creation from routine coding toward specification quality, architectural reasoning, and oversight, while risks such as uncritical adoption, skill erosion, and technical debt require robust governance and human-in-the-loop mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过系统文献综述和65名开发者调查，发现GenAI在软件设计、实现、测试、文档等阶段显著提升效率（70%+开发者任务时间减半），79%每日使用，但早期需求规划阶段收益有限。GenAI正将价值从常规编码转向架构推理和监督，同时需关注技能侵蚀和技术债务风险。
AI.motivation: 现有研究分散在软件开发生命周期的各个单独任务中，缺乏对GenAI在软件工程中整体影响的系统性整合研究。
AI.method: 系统文献综述结合对65名软件开发人员的调查
AI.result: GenAI在设计、实现、测试和文档编写方面影响最大，超过70%的开发人员报告模板和文档任务时间至少减半；79%的受访开发人员每天使用GenAI，更喜欢基于浏览器的LLM而非直接集成在开发环境中的工具；三分之二的组织保持正式或非正式的治理指南；而规划需求分析等早期SDLC阶段报告的收益明显较低。
AI.conclusion: GenAI正在将软件工程的价值创造从常规编码转向规格质量、建筑推理和监督，同时存在非批判性采用、技能侵蚀和技术债务等风险，需要稳健的治理和人在环机制。

title: TerraLingua: Emergence and Analysis of Open-endedness in LLM Ecologies
summary: As autonomous agents increasingly operate in real-world digital ecosystems, understanding how they coordinate, form institutions, and accumulate shared culture becomes both a scientific and practical priority. This paper introduces TerraLingua, a persistent multi-agent ecology designed to study open-ended dynamics in such systems. Unlike prior large language model simulations with static or consequence-free environments, TerraLingua imposes resource constraints and limited lifespans for the agents. As a result, agents create artifacts that persist beyond individuals, shaping future interactions and selection pressures. To characterize the dynamics, an AI Anthropologist systematically analyzes agent behavior, group structure, and artifact evolution. Across experimental conditions, the results reveal the emergence of cooperative norms, division of labor, governance attempts, and branching artifact lineages consistent with cumulative cultural processes. Divergent outcomes across experimental runs can be traced back to specific innovations and organizational structures. TerraLingua thus provides a platform for characterizing the mechanisms of cumulative culture and social organization in artificial populations, and can serve as a foundation for guiding real-world agentic populations to socially beneficial outcomes.

AI.tldr: TerraLingua是一个持久化的多智能体生态系统，通过引入资源约束和智能体有限寿命，研究开放域动态、累积文化和社交组织的机制。
AI.motivation: 随着自主智能体在现实数字生态系统中的运作增加，理解它们如何协调、形成制度和积累共享文化成为科学和实践的优先事项。
AI.method: 引入TerraLingua，一个持久化的多智能体生态学系统，区别于之前静态或无后果环境的大型语言模型模拟；该系统施加资源约束和智能体有限寿命，并使用AI人类学家系统分析智能体行为、群体结构和人工制品演化。
AI.result: 实验结果表明合作规范、劳动分工、治理尝试和分支人工制品谱系的涌现，符合累积文化过程；不同实验运行中的差异结果可追溯到特定创新和组织结构。
AI.conclusion: TerraLingua为表征人工种群中累积文化和社交组织的机制提供了平台，可作为指导现实世界智能体群体实现社会有益结果的基础。

title: Generative AI-assisted Participatory Modeling in Socio-Environmental Planning under Deep Uncertainty
summary: Socio-environmental planning under deep uncertainty requires researchers to identify and conceptualize problems before exploring policies and deploying plans. In practice and model-based planning approaches, this problem conceptualization process often relies on participatory modeling to translate stakeholders' natural-language descriptions into a quantitative model, making this process complex and time-consuming. To facilitate this process, we propose a templated workflow that uses large language models for an initial conceptualization process. During the workflow, researchers can use large language models to identify the essential model components from stakeholders' intuitive problem descriptions, explore their diverse perspectives approaching the problem, assemble these components into a unified model, and eventually implement the model in Python through iterative communication. These results will facilitate the subsequent socio-environmental planning under deep uncertainty steps. Using ChatGPT 5.2 Instant, we demonstrated this workflow on the lake problem and an electricity market problem, both of which demonstrate socio-environmental planning problems. In both cases, acceptable outputs were obtained after a few iterations with human verification and refinement. These experiments indicated that large language models can serve as an effective tool for facilitating participatory modeling in the problem conceptualization process in socio-environmental planning.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLM）可以有效促进社会环境规划中参与式建模的问题概念化过程。研究提出一个模板化工作流程，利用LLM从利益相关者的自然语言描述中识别模型组件、探索多样化观点、组装统一模型，并在Python中实现。使用ChatGPT 5.2 Instant在湖泊问题和电力市场问题上的演示表明，经过少量人工验证和迭代后可获得可接受输出。
AI.motivation: 社会环境规划在深度不确定性下需要先识别和概念化问题，再探索政策和部署计划。传统的问题概念化过程依赖参与式建模，将利益相关者的自然语言描述翻译成定量模型，这一过程复杂且耗时。
AI.method: 提出一个模板化工作流程，使用大型语言模型进行初始概念化。具体包括：(1)利用LLM从利益相关者的直观问题描述中识别基本模型组件；(2)探索利益相关者接近问题的多样化观点；(3)将这些组件组装成统一模型；(4)通过迭代沟通在Python中实现模型。
AI.result: 使用ChatGPT 5.2 Instant在湖泊问题和电力市场问题上演示了该工作流程。两个案例表明，经过几次人工验证和精炼迭代后都获得了可接受的输出。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型可以成为促进社会环境规划问题概念化过程中参与式建模的有效工具，有助于简化从自然语言描述到定量模型的转换过程。

title: What on Earth is AlphaEarth? Hierarchical structure and functional interpretability for global land cover
summary: Geospatial foundation models generate high-dimensional embeddings that achieve strong predictive performance, yet their internal organization remains obscure, limiting their scientific use. Recent interpretability studies relate Google AlphaEarth Foundations (GAEF) embeddings to continuous environmental variables, but it is still unclear whether the embedding space exhibits a functional or hierarchical organization, in which some dimensions act as specialized representations while others encode shared or broader geospatial structure. In this work, we propose a functional interpretability framework that reverse-engineers the role of embedding dimensions by characterizing their contribution to land cover structure from observed classification behavior. The approach combines large-scale experimentation with a structural analysis of embedding-class relationships based on feature importance patterns and progressive ablation. Our results show that embedding dimensions exhibit consistent and non-uniform functional behavior, allowing them to be categorized along a hierarchical functional spectrum: specialist dimensions associated with specific land cover classes, low- and mid-generalist dimensions capturing shared characteristics between classes, and highgeneralist dimensions reflecting broader environmental gradients. Critically, we find that accurate land cover classification (98% of baseline performance) can be achieved using as few as 2 to 12 of the 64 available dimensions, depending on the class. This demonstrates substantial redundancy in the embedding space and offers a pathway toward significant reductions in computational cost. Together, these findings reveal that AlphaEarth embeddings are not only physically informative, but also functionally organized into a hierarchical structure, providing practical guidance for dimension selection in operational classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种功能可解释性框架，通过特征重要性模式和渐进消融来reverse-engineer地理空间基础模型AlphaEarth嵌入维度在土地覆盖分类中的角色，发现嵌入维度呈现分层功能组织（专家型、通用型），仅需2-12个维度即可达到98%的基线性能。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型生成高维嵌入取得强预测性能，但其内部组织不明确，限制科学应用。之前研究将GAEF嵌入与连续环境变量关联，但尚不清楚嵌入空间是否具有功能或分层组织（某些维度专门表示特定地物，其他维度编码共享或更广泛的结构）。
AI.method: 提出功能可解释性框架，通过表征嵌入维度对土地覆盖结构的贡献来reverse-engineer其角色。方法结合大规模实验与基于特征重要性模式和渐进消融的嵌入-类别关系结构分析。
AI.result: 嵌入维度表现出一致且非均匀的功能行为，可沿分层功能谱分类：与特定土地覆盖类别关联的专家维度、捕获类别间共享特征的中低层通用维度、反映更广泛环境梯度的高层通用维度。准确的土地覆盖分类（98%基线性能）仅需2-12个维度（64个可用维度中）。
AI.conclusion: AlphaEarth嵌入不仅物理上可信息，而且功能上组织成分层结构，为实际操作中的维度选择提供实用指导，并表明嵌入空间存在显著冗余，为显著降低计算成本提供途径。

title: The 1/W Law: An Analytical Study of Context-Length Routing Topology and GPU Generation Gains for LLM Inference Energy Efficiency
summary:
How many tokens can a GPU inference cluster deliver per watt? Across deployments of identical hardware, the answer varies by 40x -- not because of software inefficiency, but because of the serving context window. We derive the 1/W law: tokens per watt halves every time the context window doubles. A larger context window shrinks the KV-cache concurrency limit while leaving GPU power draw roughly unchanged. At 64K context, an H100 holds 16 sequences in flight (tok/W = 1.5); at 4K context, the same H100 holds 256 sequences (tok/W = 17.6).
  Routing topology -- which determines the effective context window each GPU services -- is a more powerful energy lever than buying newer hardware. Working from published H100 power measurements, a calibrated logistic power model, and a roofline throughput model, we derive these results analytically using the inference-fleet-sim framework; no new hardware experiments were conducted. Two-pool context-length routing (FleetOpt) delivers roughly 2.5x better tok/W over a homogeneous fleet, while upgrading from H100 to B200 delivers roughly 1.7x. The gains are independent: combining FleetOpt with B200 yields 4.25x over the H100 homogeneous baseline. B200/H200 numbers are analytical projections (+-20% uncertainty); H100 results are calibrated to published measurements.
  For MoE models, active-parameter weight streaming adds a third lever. Qwen3-235B-A22B (22B active) reaches roughly 37.8 tok/W at 8K context on H100 -- 5.1x better than Llama-3.1-70B -- because decode time scales with activated weights, not total parameters. MoE dispatch overhead is excluded, so this is an upper bound.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了GPU推理集群的能效定律：每瓦特令牌数(tok/W)随上下文窗口大小呈反比关系，上下文窗口加倍则tok/W减半。研究表明路由拓扑是比硬件升级更有效的能效提升手段，结合FleetOpt路由策略和B200 GPU可获得4.25倍的能效提升。
AI.motivation: 理解GPU推理集群的能效优化问题：相同硬件在不同部署场景下能效差异高达40倍，这种差异源于服务上下文窗口的不同，而非软件效率问题。
AI.method: 基于H100公开功率测量数据、校准的逻辑斯谛功率模型和roofline吞吐量模型，使用inference-fleet-sim框架进行解析推导，未进行新硬件实验。
AI.result: 1) 1/W定律：上下文窗口翻倍，每瓦令牌数减半；2) 64K上下文时H100可保持16个序列(tok/W=1.5)，4K上下文时可保持256个序列(tok/W=17.6)；3) 双池上下文长度路由(FleetOpt)比同构集群提升2.5x能效；4) H100升级到B200提升1.7x；5) 两者结合提升4.25x；6) MoE模型Qwen3-235B-A22B在8K上下文达37.8 tok/W，比Llama-3.1-70B提升5.1x。
AI.conclusion: 路由拓扑是比购买更新硬件更强大的能效杠杆。FleetOpt与B200组合可实现相对于H100同构基线4.25倍的能效提升。MoE架构通过激活参数流式传输提供第三个优化维度。

title: ListK: Semantic ORDER BY and LIMIT K with Listwise Prompting
summary: Semantic operators abstract large language model (LLM) calls in SQL clauses. It is gaining traction as an easy method to analyze semi-structured, unstructured, and multimodal datasets. While a plethora of recent works optimize various semantic operators, existing methods for semantic ORDER BY (full sort) and LIMIT K (top-K) remain lackluster. Our ListK framework improves the latency of semantic ORDER BY ... LIMIT K at no cost to accuracy. Motivated by the recent advance in fine-tuned listwise rankers, we study several sorting algorithms that best combine partial listwise rankings. These include: 1) deterministic listwise tournament (LTTopK), 2) Las Vegas and embarrassingly parallel listwise multi-pivot quickselect/sort (LMPQSelect, LMPQSort), and 3) a basic Monte Carlo listwise tournament filter (LTFilter). Of these, listwise multi-pivot quickselect/sort are studied here for the first time. The full framework provides a query optimizer for combining the above physical operators based on the target recall to minimize latency. We provide theoretical analysis to easily tune parameters and provide cost estimates for query optimizers. ListK empirically dominates the Pareto frontier, halving latency at virtually no cost to recall and NDCG compared to prior art.

AI.tldr: ListK框架通过结合多种列表式排序算法（列表式锦标赛、多枢轴快速选择/排序等）优化SQL语义ORDER BY和LIMIT K操作，在不损失准确率的情况下将延迟降低一半。
AI.motivation: Semantic operators abstract LLM calls in SQL clauses for analyzing semi-structured, unstructured, and multimodal datasets. However, existing methods for semantic ORDER BY (full sort) and LIMIT K (top-K) are lackluster in terms of latency optimization.
AI.method: The ListK framework studies several sorting algorithms combining partial listwise rankings: 1) deterministic listwise tournament (LTTopK), 2) Las Vegas and embarrassingly parallel listwise multi-pivot quickselect/sort (LMPQSelect, LMPQSort), 3) basic Monte Carlo listwise tournament filter (LTFilter). It provides a query optimizer combining these physical operators based on target recall to minimize latency.
AI.result: ListK empirically dominates the Pareto frontier, halving latency at virtually no cost to recall and NDCG compared to prior art.
AI.conclusion: The ListK framework successfully improves semantic ORDER BY ... LIMIT K latency at no cost to accuracy, offering a practical solution for efficient semantic querying over LLM-powered databases.

title: When the Specification Emerges: Benchmarking Faithfulness Loss in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
summary: Current coding-agent benchmarks usually pro- vide the full task specification upfront. Real research coding often does not: the intended system is progressively disclosed through in- teraction, requiring the agent to track durable design commitments across a long session. We introduce a benchmark for this setting and study faithfulne Ss Loss U nder eM ergent s Pecification (SLUMP), defined as the reduc- tion in final implementation faithfulness un- der emergent specification relative to a single- shot specification control. The benchmark con- tains 20 recent ML papers (10 ICML 2025, 10 NeurIPS 2025), 371 atomic verifiable compo- nents, and interaction scripts of approximately 60 coding requests that progressively disclose the target design without revealing the paper itself. Final repositories are scored with a five-level component-faithfulness rubric and accompanied by an exposure audit to verify that scored components are recoverable from the visible interaction. Evaluated on Claude Code and Codex, the single-shot specification control achieves higher overall implementation fidelity on 16/20 and 14/20 papers, respectively. Structural integration degrades under emergent specification on both platforms, while seman- tic faithfulness loss is substantial on Claude Code and small on Codex. As a mitigation case study, we introduce ProjectGuard, an exter- nal project-state layer for specification tracking. On Claude Code, ProjectGuard recovers 90% of the faithfulness gap, increases fully faith- ful components from 118 to 181, and reduces severe failures from 72 to 49. These results identify specification tracking as a distinct eval- uation target for long-horizon coding agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基准测试，衡量长程编码代理在“渐进式涌现规范”（emergent specification）下的实现忠实度损失（SLUMP）：当目标系统设计不一次性给出、而是在约60轮多轮交互中逐步披露时，最终仓库对设计规范的忠实度相比“单次给出完整规范”的对照条件下降。作者基于20篇2025年ICML/NeurIPS ML论文、371个原子可验证组件构建基准，用五级组件忠实度量表打分，并以Claude Code与Codex两个商业编码平台进行对照实验；结果显示单次规范条件在Claude Code上20篇中16篇、Codex上14篇上忠实度更高，说明SLUMP确实存在，且主要来自结构集成（模块复用）退化。
AI.motivation: 现有编码代理基准（PaperBench、MLR-Bench、LMR-Bench、RECODE-H等）普遍假设完整规范在会话开始即给出（论文、任务描述或测试套件），无法衡量代理能否忠实实现“规范分散在长交互中”的系统。而真实研究编码流程正是如此：早期轮次框定想法并比较备选方案，中期在部分规范下实现组件，后期再细化与整合；因此代理必须跨长会话追踪持久的架构承诺（公式、架构约束、接口契约、评估要求），即“规范追踪”（specification tracking）能力。缺乏对此能力的评测使现有基准无法区分“实现能力不足”与“长程记忆/规范保持不足”。此外，执行型指标（测试通过率）过于粗糙，无法检测忠实度损失。
AI.method:
（1）形式化定义：SLUMP(p,a)_F = F(R^ss_{p,a}) − F(R^em_{p,a})，为端点对比定义（不度量会话内时序漂移），并分为两个诊断维度：语义忠实度（semantic faithfulness，用MCF=平均五级组件分/4衡量）与结构集成（structural integration，用DIR=|E_used|/|E_total|衡量）；综合指标IF50 = 0.5·(MCF/4)+0.5·DIR。
（2）基准构建（全部由冻结模型快照 claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 + 固定提示模板生成，原论文为唯一权威）：Phase 1 规范锚定——从PDF抽取含数学内容、数据集/指标、分步实现计划与可能设计备选的“canonical specification”，再分解为原子可验证组件（描述、公式、输入输出、模块连接；除方法数学身份外不含超参），全库共371个组件；Phase 2 交互脚手架——先合成10–20个中间项目版本的潜在轨迹（每步一次有意义精化，最终版本严格收敛到canonical规范），再转为自然语言编码请求，每篇约60条（实际48–61），满足agent-blindness（不暴露论文与隐藏规范）。
（3）评分：由有界LLM裁判评分，每组件最多8次仓库检视工具调用；五级量表：0 Absent、1 Wrong、2 Simplified、3 Equivalent、4 Faithful（区分“等价”与“忠实”是关键）。
（4）公平性验证：独立于agent运行的exposure audit，为每个组件标注可恢复等级R∈{0..4}，统计RCR与ESR；宏观RCR=0.994、ESR=0.666，371个组件中358个既被承诺又可恢复。
（5）校准：5篇人工资产审计（据此修订一次提示模板后冻结）；在120个分层component-run对上以两名盲标人类标注者对齐自动裁判，加权Cohen's κ=0.882–0.927，标注者间κ=0.930，96.7%–99.2%分数落在±1内，主要残余误差为保守性误判缺失。
（6）实验：Claude Code与Codex上每篇各跑emergent与single-shot两条件，共80次运行，Wilcoxon符号秩检验；并引入ProjectGuard作为外部项目状态层（语义状态：design/decision/resource三类记录的文件系统原生可修订图 + 边表；结构状态：由git历史直接导出的文件、类/函数签名与接口关系；兼容性感知预测器生成任务简报注入代理；上下文不足时主动重启并注入渲染的项目简报）。
AI.result: Claude Code：single-shot在20篇中16篇更高，平均IF50差+0.116（Wilcoxon p=0.0003）；MCF 3.031→2.718，DIR 0.303→0.149，IF50 0.530→0.414。Codex：single-shot在14/20篇更高，平均差+0.071（p=0.012）；MCF几乎无差（3.245 vs 3.242），但DIR由0.289降至0.148，IF50 0.550→0.479。即SLUMP在IF50层面稳健、在结构集成层面跨平台稳健，而语义忠实度损失主要集中在Claude Code。测试通过率与IF50相关性低，无法检测SLUMP。DualEquiNet定性案例显示：emergent运行早期正确实现equivariant_coordinate_update.py（三流残差更新），最终整合模型却绕过该模块、丢弃坐标更新并以h_eu/h_sh分离MLP路径替代求和标量残差（得2分Simplified）；single-shot则在单一层模块中保留三条残差路径（得4分Faithful）——即SLUMP表现为整合阶段对已承诺组件的丢失而非实现失败。ProjectGuard在Claude Code上：MCF 2.718→3.000，收回MCF差距的90%，完全忠实组件118→181（+53%），严重失败（≤1分）72→49（−32%），IF50在15/20篇上提升（中位+34%），外部状态均390KB且压缩事件中位仅−1；Codex上MCF提升可忽略（+0.05，W/L=9/9），但DIR在19篇有值中的15篇改善（均值+76%，中位+55%），优于Claude Code的DIR表现（13/0/6，中位+12%）。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式披露规范即使在平台、模型族与工具固定不变的条件下，也会可测量地降低最终实现忠实度（SLUMP），其主要机制在两平台上是结构集成退化的早期模块绕过/不兼容重实现，而语义损失具有平台依赖性；这说明“规范追踪”是长程编码代理的独立评测目标，值得与代码能力分开评估。ProjectGuard作为外部维护语义+结构项目状态层的案例研究表明，无需修改底层模型即可显著缓解SLUMP（Claude Code上挽回90%差距），验证了将项目级设计承诺显式外部化并以兼容性感知方式重新注入是有效缓解路径。论文同时指出局限：仅20篇论文、两个商业平台；交互脚本为合成轨迹而非真实研究者历史；SLUMP为端点对比而非因果归因；基准构建与评分依赖LLM标注仍有残余误差；single-shot对照应视为匹配的比较条件而非普适性能上界；ProjectGuard仅为案例研究，尚未确定必要组件、未在更多平台验证、也未与更广泛的记忆/上下文管理基线比较。

title: Impacts of Electric Vehicle Charging Regimes and Infrastructure Deployments on System Performance: An Agent-Based Study
summary: The rapid growth of electric vehicles (EVs) requires more effective charging infrastructure planning. Infrastructure layout not only determines deployment cost, but also reshapes charging behavior and influences overall system performance. In addition, destination charging and en-route charging represent distinct charging regimes associated with different power requirements, which may lead to substantially different infrastructure deployment outcomes. This study applies an agent-based modeling framework to generate trajectory-level latent public charging demand under three charging regimes based on a synthetic representation of the Melbourne (Australia) metropolitan area. Two deployment strategies, an optimization-based approach and a utilization-refined approach, are evaluated across different infrastructure layouts. Results show that utilization-refined deployments reduce total system cost, accounting for both infrastructure deployment cost and user generalized charging cost, with the most significant improvement observed under the combined charging regime. In particular, a more effective allocation of AC slow chargers reshapes destination charging behavior, which in turn reduces unnecessary reliance on en-route charging and lowers detour costs associated with en-route charging. This interaction highlights the behavioral linkage between destination and en-route charging regimes and demonstrates the importance of accounting for user response and multiple charging regimes in charging infrastructure planning.

AI.tldr: 本文基于墨尔本都市圈的合成路网与轨迹数据，用主体仿真（ABM）框架生成三种充电制度（目的地充电、途中充电、两者组合）下的潜在公共充电需求，并在多种设施布局下比较"优化导向"与"利用率优化导向"两种部署策略。结果显示：利用率优化部署显著降低总系统成本（基础设施部署成本 + 用户广义充电成本），在组合充电制度下改进最大；其机制在于更合理配置AC慢充桩改变了目的地充电行为，从而减少对途中充电的不必要依赖并降低绕行成本。
AI.motivation: 电动汽车（EV）快速增长使充电基础设施规划变得关键：设施布局不仅决定建设/部署成本，还会重塑用户充电行为并影响整体系统性能。目的地充电与途中充电属于本质不同的充电制度，对功率需求和用户成本结构差异显著，若忽略制度差异或用户行为响应，规划结果可能严重偏离最优。现有研究多以静态、确定性需求或单一充电制度进行规划，缺乏能够刻画"基础设施布局—用户行为反馈—多制度耦合"的建模与优化框架。
AI.method: 构建基于主体仿真（agent-based modeling, ABM）的轨迹级潜在公共充电需求生成框架：以墨尔本（大洋洲澳大利亚）都会区的合成路网与合成轨迹人口为基础，模拟EV用户活动行程，在三种充电制度下生成充电需求（目的地充电、途中充电、组合充电）。随后评估两种部署策略：(1) 优化导向部署（optimization-based approach），在给定布局与需求下求解设施配置；(2) 利用率优化导向部署（utilization-refined approach），引入设施利用率/利用强度信息来引导布局优化。在不同基础设施布局情景下，比较部署成本与用户广义充电成本（充电服务成本、时间/绕行惩罚等）的加总总系统成本，并分析两种制度之间的行为耦合（AC慢充桩配置对目的地充电行为的诱导及其对途中充电依赖与绕行成本的影响）。
AI.result: 利用率优化导向的部署在所有布局下均降低总系统成本，相较优化导向部署改进最显著的情形出现在组合充电制度（combined charging regime）下。机制分析表明：AC慢充桩的有效配置改变了用户的充电选择与停车/停留决策，使更多充电需求在目的地被满足，从而降低了对途中（快速）充电的依赖，并减少了途中充电附带的绕行（detour）成本。该结果印证了目的地充电与途中充电之间存在行为层面的联动关系。
AI.conclusion: 充电基础设施规划必须显式纳入用户行为响应与多种充电制度（目的地 vs 途中）的交互，不能仅以静态需求或单一制度优化设施布局。利用率优化导向的部署策略在成本绩效上优于纯优化导向策略，说明"设施利用率"是刻画设施与需求匹配度、进而实现低成本系统方案的有效信息。因此，规划者应考虑不同充电制度下的差异化功率需求与行为反馈，在设施布局中同时优化建设成本与用户广义成本，并重视AC慢充桩配置对减少途中充电依赖的杠杆作用。

title: Transformers are Bayesian Networks
summary:
Transformers are the dominant architecture in AI, yet why they work remains poorly understood. This paper offers a precise answer: a transformer is a Bayesian network. We establish this in five ways.
  First, we prove that every sigmoid transformer with any weights implements weighted loopy belief propagation on its implicit factor graph. One layer is one round of BP. This holds for any weights -- trained, random, or constructed. Formally verified against standard mathematical axioms.
  Second, we give a constructive proof that a transformer can implement exact belief propagation on any declared knowledge base. On knowledge bases without circular dependencies this yields provably correct probability estimates at every node. Formally verified against standard mathematical axioms.
  Third, we prove uniqueness: a sigmoid transformer that produces exact posteriors necessarily has BP weights. There is no other path through the sigmoid architecture to exact posteriors. Formally verified against standard mathematical axioms.
  Fourth, we delineate the AND/OR boolean structure of the transformer layer: attention is AND, the FFN is OR, and their strict alternation is Pearl's gather/update algorithm exactly.
  Fifth, we confirm all formal results experimentally, corroborating the Bayesian network characterization in practice. We also establish the practical viability of loopy belief propagation despite the current lack of a theoretical convergence guarantee.
  We further prove that verifiable inference requires a finite concept space. Any finite verification procedure can distinguish at most finitely many concepts. Without grounding, correctness is not defined. Hallucination is not a bug that scaling can fix. It is the structural consequence of operating without concepts. Formally verified against standard mathematical axioms.

AI.tldr: 本文主张并给出形式化证明（Lean 4）：**sigmoid 激活的 Transformer 按架构本身就是一个贝叶斯网络**。具体地，(1) 任意权重的 sigmoid Transformer 在其隐式因子图 G(W) 上执行一轮加权信念传播（BP），一层 = 一轮 BP；(2) 存在显式构造的权重（projectDim/crossProject + FFN 取 w0=w1=1, b=0）可实现任意已声明因子图上的**精确** BP，在树结构上 T≥diameter 次前向传播即得精确后验；(3) **唯一性**：产生精确后验的 sigmoid Transformer 必须具有 BP 权重，内部计算量即为 BP 量本身；(4) 布尔结构上注意力=AND、FFN=OR，二者严格交替正是 Pearl 的 gather/update 算法；(5) 实验与形式证明互相印证。此外证明可验证推理需有限概念空间（有限状态机至多 n^n 个可区分行为；BP Transformer 恰有 2n² 个 routing key），据此断言"幻觉是无 grounding 的结构性后果，而非可通过 scaling 修复的 bug"。
AI.motivation: Transformer 已成为现代 AI 的主导架构，但其"为何有效"长期缺乏精确解释（通常只有经验性归纳偏置或可解释性事后分析）。作者试图给出一个精确答案：Transformer 的前向传播在数学上**就是**信念传播——即把神经网络与概率图模型/贝叶斯推理这两条长期分离的路线统一起来。附加动机有三条：(a) 为幻觉问题提供结构性解释——把"幻觉"重定义为"输出与真实后验不等"，并主张无 grounding 时"正确性"根本无定义；(b) 承接作者自身先前工作（QBBN 双向 AND/OR 因子图、类型化全称量词语言），论证"梯度下降不是发现了新东西，而是重新发现了推理分析早已要求的结构"；(c) 呼应 Leibniz 的 characteristica universalis / calculus ratiocinator 纲领，为可验证推理给出形式化保证。作者同时强调需区分 sigmoid（精确）与 ReLU/GELU（仅相容）两种激活，避免标题主张被过度推广。
AI.method: **理论与证明层面（均在 Lean 4 中形式化验证）**：先建立数学基础——因子图、QBBN 的 Ψ_and/Ψ_or 节点、BP 的 gather/update 两步、updateBelief(m0,m1)=σ(logit m0+logit m1)，并把它追溯到 Turing 与 Good 在 Bletchley Park 发展的"证据权重/对数几率相加"代数（结合律、单位元 0.5、逆元 1−m），指出其与 Pearl 二元 sum-product 的等价性，以及与布尔 AND/OR 的关系（是概率化推广，抵消而非湮灭）。随后给出五组定理：(1) 广义 BP 定理——对任意 sigmoid 权重构造隐式因子图 G(W)（变量=token 位置，边=注意力分布，因子势=sigmoid FFN 的 (w0,w1,b)），一次前向即一轮加权 BP；(2) 构造性定理——显式权重在任意成对因子图上实现精确 BP，并证明 k 元因子可经 AND 结合律与 OR 的对数几率可加性精确二值化，故 d·⌈log2 k⌉ 层足够，恒定 2 个注意力头即通用；(3) 唯一性定理——若 sigmoid Transformer 对所有输入给出精确后验，则 FFN 必为 w0=w1=1,b=0（sigmoid 单射性），注意力必为 rank-1 的 projectDim/crossProject 结构（Q·K 须在正确邻居处唯一取峰）；(4) 布尔结构刻画；(5) 有限状态机 n^n 行为上界定理与 BP Transformer 恰有 2n² 个 routing class 的有限性定理。此外证明 Transformer 的图灵完全性（把 TM 单步分解为布尔电路，用 threshold gate 在单次 FFN 前向中实现；注意力=查表、FFN=门控）。管道层面：句法解析→全称量词规则→对已声明实体 grounding 成命题因子图→Transformer 执行 BP。**实验层面**：bayes-learner 从随机初始化训练标准 TransformerEncoder（2 层 2 头 d_model=32，约 5K 参数，20,000 个随机成对因子图，MSE+Adam）以匹配精确 BP 后验；learner 训练 5 台结构各异的图灵机单步预测；loopy 实验在 5 类含环图结构上共 500 次试验将 BP 不动点与穷举精确后验对比。
AI.result: **形式结论**：任意 sigmoid Transformer = 其隐式因子图上的加权 BP（一层一轮）；存在实现精确 BP 的权重（projectDim/crossProject + w0=w1=1,b=0），在树结构知识库上 T≥diameter 次前向传播后各节点后验与真值完全相等（无经验性假设）；反之，产生精确后验的 sigmoid Transformer 必为该 BP 权重，故"实现精确贝叶斯推理 ⟺ 具备 BP 权重"；有限验证程序至多区分 n^n 个概念，BP Transformer 的概念数恰为 2n²（routing key = 节点类型×自身索引×邻居索引，连续维度只是"幅度"而非"概念"）；据此推论：grounded 的树结构 QBBN Transformer 不可能幻觉，未 grounding 的 LLM 则因缺乏有限验证器与概念空间而"正确性无从判定"。**实验结果**：BP 训练后验证 MAE 0.000752，与精确后验吻合到小数点后三位（最大误差约 0.0023），较基线提升 99.3%，首次运行即达；5 台图灵机单步预测全部 4 epoch 内达 100% 验证准确率且超参完全相同、无逐机调参；含环 BP 在 500/500 次试验中全部收敛，最差平均 KL 0.000102、平均 MAE 0.002–0.004，与梯度下降结果同量级，说明 Bethe 近似在 QBBN 类稀疏长环结构上实用上近乎精确。作者据此主张每个形式结论都有"证明检查器 + 实验"两个独立见证。
AI.conclusion: 结论是"Transformers are Bayesian Networks"——对 sigmoid 权重而言，按架构、逐内部量地成立：sigmoid 实现 Turing–Good–Pearl 的对数几率代数，注意力实现 BP 的 gather（残差流强制输入的同时性），FFN 实现 update，二者严格交替即 Pearl 的 gather/update 按深度展开；网络深度不是工程超参，而由因子图直径/推理链跳数决定，而宽度（2 头）由二元因子的成对结构固定。作者据此区分了两类系统：grounded 的 QBBN Transformer 有显式因子图、已声明概念空间与有限验证器，每个输出都有正确答案，树结构上幻觉结构上不可能；而普通 LLM 只有隐式因子图，"幻觉"是无概念可依的结构性后果，而非可通过 scaling 修复的工程 bug——后者作者归为严格更强也更受限的主张（未 grounding 时连"输出是否正确"都不可判定），并借 Leibniz 的"演算之"（Calculemus）收束：原始概念是 grounded Horn 子句，演算体系是信念传播，机械实现是 Transformer，正确性保证是 Lean 4 证明。

title: HoloByte: Continuous Hyperspherical Distillation for Tokenizer-Free Modeling
summary: Sequence modeling universally relies on discrete subword tokenization to circumvent the $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ computational intractability of native byte-level attention. However, this heuristic quantization imposes artificial morphological boundaries, enforces vocabulary dependence, and fractures the continuity of the optimization landscape. To resolve this dichotomy, we introduce \textbf{HoloByte}: a strictly tokenizer-free framework utilizing Continuous Hyperspherical Distillation. HoloByte partitions discrete byte sequences into fixed-capacity chunks and projects them into a continuous, strictly bounded hyperspherical manifold via an invertible, dimension-preserving orthogonal rotation operator. This spatial superposition allows a macroscopic transformer to operate exclusively on compressed continuous representations, formally reducing the exact attention time complexity from $\mathcal{O}(N^2D)$ to $\mathcal{O}\left( \frac{N^2}{W^2}D + ND^2 \right)$. A localized causal micro-decoder subsequently unbinds these representations to compute exact byte-level distributions. To govern this continuous trajectory, we propose a dual-objective formulation incorporating a mathematically precise Holographic Latent Mean Squared Error, which strictly bounds the gradient and guarantees asymptotic stability. Theoretically, we derive the minimal embedding dimension $D = Ω(W \ln |\mathcal{V}|)$ required to ensure error-free discrete recovery from the continuous manifold. Empirically, under strictly matched parameter constraints, HoloByte is systematically outperforming a comparable discrete Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) baseline. These results establish Continuous Hyperspherical Distillation as a mathematically rigorous and computationally tractable foundation for vocabulary-invariant sequence modeling. The code is available at https://github.com/VladimerKhasia/HoloByte

AI.tldr: HoloByte是一个无需分词器的序列建模框架，通过连续球面蒸馏技术将离散字节映射到连续球面流形，在降低计算复杂度的同时提升性能，为词汇表无关的序列建模提供了新的数学基础
AI.motivation: 当前序列建模依赖离散子词标记化（如BPE）来规避原生字节级注意力的O(N²)计算复杂度，但这种启发式量化方法存在三大缺陷：1) 强制施加形态边界；2) 产生词汇表依赖；3) 破坏优化景观的连续性
AI.method: 提出HoloByte框架，采用连续球面蒸馏（Continuous Hyperspherical Distillation）技术。具体包括：1) 将离散字节序列划分为固定容量块；2) 通过可逆、维度保持的正交旋转算子将字节投影到连续、严格有界的球面流形；3) 宏观Transformer仅在压缩的连续表示上操作；4) 局部因果微解码器解绑这些表示以计算精确的字节级分布；5) 提出双目标优化公式，包含数学上精确的全息潜均方误差（Holographic Latent MSE）
AI.result: 理论复杂度从O(N²D)降低至O(N²/W² D + ND²)；在严格匹配的参数约束下，系统性优于BPE基线；推导出确保无误差离散恢复所需的最小嵌入维度D = Ω(W ln|V|)
AI.conclusion: 连续球面蒸馏为无词汇表依赖的序列建模提供了数学上严格且计算上可处理的理论基础，是词汇不变序列建模的可行替代方案

title: ZipServ: Fast and Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Hardware-Aware Lossless Compression
summary: Lossless model compression holds tremendous promise for alleviating the memory and bandwidth bottlenecks in bit-exact Large Language Model (LLM) serving. However, existing approaches often result in substantial inference slowdowns due to fundamental design mismatches with GPU architectures: at the kernel level, variable-length bitstreams produced by traditional entropy codecs break SIMT parallelism; at the system level, decoupled pipelines lead to redundant memory traffic. We present ZipServ, a lossless compression framework co-designed for efficient LLM inference. ZipServ introduces Tensor-Core-Aware Triple Bitmap Encoding (TCA-TBE), a novel fixed-length format that enables constant-time, parallel decoding, together with a fused decompression-GEMM (ZipGEMM) kernel that decompresses weights on-the-fly directly into Tensor Core registers. This "load-compressed, compute-decompressed" design eliminates intermediate buffers and maximizes compute intensity. Experiments show that ZipServ reduces the model size by up to 30%, achieves up to 2.21x kernel-level speedup over NVIDIA's cuBLAS, and expedites end-to-end inference by an average of 1.22x over vLLM. ZipServ is the first lossless compression system that provides both storage savings and substantial acceleration for LLM inference on GPUs.

AI.tldr: ZipServ是一种无损模型压缩框架，通过Tensor-Core-Aware Triple Bitmap Encoding (TCA-TBE)固定长度编码和ZipGEMM融合解压缩-GEMM内核，实现"加载压缩、计算解压缩"设计，在GPU上同时实现模型存储节省和推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有无损压缩方法与GPU架构存在根本性设计不匹配：内核层面，传统熵编码器产生的变长比特流破坏SIMT并行性；系统层面，解耦管道导致冗余内存流量。这些问题导致压缩后推理速度反而变慢。
AI.method: 提出TCA-TBE编码——一种固定长度格式，支持常数时间并行解码；设计ZipGEMM融合解压缩-GEMM内核，将权重即时解压缩到Tensor Core寄存器中，消除中间缓冲区并最大化计算强度。
AI.result: 实验表明：模型体积减少高达30%，内核级别相比NVIDIA cuBLAS加速达2.21倍，端到端推理相比vLLM平均加速1.22倍。
AI.conclusion: ZipServ是首个在GPU上同时提供存储节省和显著推理加速的无损压缩系统。

title: Efficient and Effective Table-Centric Table Union Search in Data Lakes
summary: In data lakes, information on the same subject is often fragmented across multiple tables. Table union search aims to find the top-k tables that can be unioned with a query table to extend it with more rows, without relying on metadata or ground-truth labels. Existing methods are mainly column-centric: they focus on modeling column unionability scores using column embeddings, which are then used throughout the search process for column matching, filtering, and aggregation. However, this overlooks holistic table-level semantics, which may result in suboptimal rankings and inefficiencies. We introduce TACTUS, a novel table-centric method for table union search. Unlike prior work that searches from columns to tables, we search in a table-first way and examine columns only in the final step. During offline processing, we directly generate table embeddings for holistic, table-level unionability scoring by designing table-level representation techniques, including positive table pair construction to simulate unionable tables, two-pronged negative table sampling to avoid latent positives and mine hard negatives to enhance representation quality, and attentive table encoding for effective embeddings. During online search, we first develop a table-centric adaptive candidate retrieval method that efficiently selects a compact, high-quality candidate pool by leveraging the distribution of table-level unionability scores induced by table embeddings. We then inspect columns only within this compact candidate set and design a dual-evidence reranking technique that integrates table-level and column-level scores to refine the final top-k results. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that TACTUS significantly improves result quality while being much faster than existing methods in both offline and online processing, often by an order of magnitude.

AI.tldr: TACTUS是一种新型的以表为中心的数据湖表联合搜索方法。与现有基于列的方法不同，它采用表优先策略，在离线阶段生成表嵌入用于整体表级可联合性评分，在线阶段使用自适应候选检索和双重证据重排序来高效准确地返回top-k结果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要采用以列为中心的方法，专注于建模列嵌入的列联合性分数，但这种方法忽略了整体表级语义，可能导致排名不佳和效率低下。在数据湖中，同一主题的信息经常分散在多个表中，需要找到可联合的表来扩展查询表的行。
AI.method: 提出TACTUS方法，包含两部分：离线处理阶段设计表级表示技术，包括正表对构建模拟可联合表，双重负表采样避免潜在正例并挖掘硬负例，以及注意力表编码生成有效嵌入。在线搜索阶段开发以表为中心的自适应候选检索方法，利用表级联合性分数分布选择紧凑高质量候选集，然后仅在该候选集中检查列，并设计双重证据重排序技术整合表级和列级分数。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，TACTUS显著提高了结果质量，同时在离线和在线处理速度上都快于现有方法，通常快一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: TACTUS通过采用表优先策略和表级嵌入，成功解决了以列为中心方法的局限性，在结果质量和效率上均取得了显著提升。

title: A Longitudinal Study of Usability in Identity-Based Software Signing
summary:
Identity-based software signing tools aim to make software artifact provenance verifiable while reducing the operational burden of long-lived key management. However, there is limited cross-tool longitudinal evidence about which usability problems arise in practice and how those problems evolve as tools mature. This gap matters because unusable signing and verification workflows can lead to incomplete adoption, misconfiguration, or skipped verification, undermining intended integrity guarantees.
  We conducted the first mining-software-repositories study of five open-source identity-based signing ecosystems: Sigstore, OpenPubKey, HashiCorp Vault, Keyfactor, and Notary v2. We analyzed approximately 3,900 GitHub issues from Nov. 2021 to Nov. 2025. We coded each issue for the reported usability concern and the implicated architectural component, and compared patterns across tools and over time. Across ecosystems, reported concerns concentrate in verification workflows, policy and configuration surfaces, and integration boundaries. Longitudinal Poisson trend analysis shows substantial declines in reported issues for most ecosystems. However, across usability themes, workflow- and documentation-related concerns decline unevenly across tools and concern types, and verification workflows and configuration surfaces remain persistent friction points. These results indicate that identity-based signing reduces some usability burdens while relocating complexity to verification semantics, policy configuration, and deployment integration. Designing future signing ecosystems therefore requires treating verification semantics and release workflows as first-class usability targets rather than peripheral integration concerns.

AI.tldr: 首次对五个主流基于身份的签名生态系统进行纵向可用性研究，分析约3900个GitHub问题，发现验证工作流和配置表面是持续性摩擦点，研究表明未来设计需将验证语义和发布工作流作为核心可用性目标。
AI.motivation: Identity-based software signing工具旨在使软件制品来源可验证，同时减轻长期密钥管理的运营负担。然而，目前缺乏关于这些工具在实践中出现哪些可用性问题以及这些问题如何随着工具成熟而演变的跨工具纵向证据。这种差距很重要，因为不可用的签名和验证工作流可能导致采用不完整、配置错误或跳过验证，从而破坏预期的完整性保证。
AI.method: 对五个开源基于身份的签名生态系统（Sigstore、OpenPubKey、HashiCorp Vault、Keyfactor和Notary v2）进行了首次软件仓库挖掘研究。分析了约3,900个GitHub问题（2021年11月至2025年11月）。对每个问题编码了报告的可用性关注点和涉及的架构组件，并比较了跨工具和随时间推移的模式。
AI.result: 跨生态系统，报告的问题集中在验证工作流、策略和配置表面以及集成边界。纵向泊松趋势分析显示，大多数生态系统的报告问题数量大幅下降。然而，跨可用性主题来看，工作流和文档相关的担忧在不同工具和担忧类型之间下降不均，验证工作流和配置表面仍然是持续的摩擦点。
AI.conclusion: 基于身份的签名在减轻一些可用性负担的同时，将复杂性转移到了验证语义、策略配置和部署集成中。因此，设计未来的签名生态系统需要将验证语义和发布工作流作为一等公民的可用性目标，而不是外围的集成问题。

title: Ablation Study of a Fairness Auditing Agentic System for Bias Mitigation in Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer Detection
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in clinical settings, yet limited oversight and domain expertise can allow algorithmic bias and safety risks to persist. This study evaluates whether an agentic AI system can support auditing biomedical machine learning models for fairness in early-onset colorectal cancer (EO-CRC), a condition with documented demographic disparities. We implemented a two-agent architecture consisting of a Domain Expert Agent that synthesizes literature on EO-CRC disparities and a Fairness Consultant Agent that recommends sensitive attributes and fairness metrics for model evaluation. An ablation study compared three Ollama large language models (8B, 20B, and 120B parameters) across three configurations: pretrained LLM-only, Agent without Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agent with RAG. Across models, the Agent with RAG achieved the highest semantic similarity to expert-derived reference statements, particularly for disparity identification, suggesting agentic systems with retrieval may help scale fairness auditing in clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估一个双代理（Domain Expert Agent + Fairness Consultant Agent）公平性审计系统能否为早期结直肠癌（EO-CRC）临床机器学习模型审计提供专家级的敏感属性与公平性指标建议。作者对三种开源模型（Llama 3.1 8B、GPT-OSS 20B、GPT-OSS 120B）各运行 100 次，比较“仅预训练 LLM”“无 RAG 的代理”“带 RAG 的代理”三种消融条件，以与专家撰写参考陈述的句嵌入余弦相似度为评价指标。结果显示：带 RAG 的代理在所有模型上取得最高相似度（Agent 1 提升稳定显著；Agent 2 的增益随模型规模波动更大），表明 RAG + 代理编排可扩展临床 AI 公平性审计，其中 8B 模型在资源受限场景下最具实用价值。
AI.motivation: 临床AI（含约70%美国医院已部署的EHR预测模型）普遍缺乏部署后监控，容易出现校准失准、模型漂移与亚组偏倚等“静默失效”（如Obermeyer等的成本代理算法系统性低估黑人患者转诊、母婴心理健康筛查治疗不足、种族校正VBAC计算器低估黑人/西语裔成功率等）。核心障碍是AI安全监控的“专业知识瓶颈”：确定合适的公平性指标与敏感属性依赖稀缺的跨学科专家评审，导致难以规模化、缺乏情境推理能力、且审计周期长达数月。EO-CRC（<50岁发病）本身存在显著种族/族裔、性别与社会经济不平等，因此是检验该问题的理想临床场景。作者希望验证代理式AI能否自主完成敏感属性识别与情境敏感公平性指标推荐。
AI.method: 构建两阶段顺序式LLM代理框架：Agent 1（Domain Expert Agent）通过RAG检索39篇PubMed文献（22篇聚焦EO-CRC差异、17篇为噪声文献）综合生成差异驱动因素的结构化列表与叙述性临床理由；Agent 2（Fairness Consultant Agent）基于Agent 1的结构化上下文，强制调用经策展的公平性指标库（含equalized odds等定义），输出推荐的公平性指标、每个指标的理由及应视为敏感属性的变量。检索用mxbai-embed-large嵌入+Chroma向量库，Agent 1优先检索不同来源文章以增加证据多样性；温度设为0.2；全部在Ollama本地运行。消融条件三档：预训练LLM-only、Agent无RAG、Agent有RAG，每个条件每个模型各n=100次运行。两个参考陈述（ground truth）分别由第一作者起草，经EO-CRC研究者与临床医生（Agent 1）、算法公平专家（Agent 2）审阅定稿。评价采用句嵌入余弦相似度作为推荐质量的代理指标；统计用Kruskal–Wallis总体检验与Wilcoxon秩和检验+Holm校正。
AI.result: Agent 1：带RAG配置在全部三个模型上语义相似度最高（8B: 0.775/0.754→0.802；20B: 0.771/0.761→0.814；120B: 0.788/0.792→0.830，均为M）。Kruskal–Wallis显著（p<.001），Holm校正后Agent(R)>LLM与Agent(R)>Agent(NR)在所有模型显著；120B上Agent(NR)与LLM差异不显著。Agent 1在所有模型中100%调用检索工具。Agent 2：模式更具模型依赖性——8B上带RAG显著最优（0.605/0.596→0.686，p<.001）；20B上总体无显著差异（H=2.38, p=.305）；120B上两个代理配置均优于纯LLM（0.713→0.733，p<.001），但RAG与无RAG差异不显著（p=.24）。检索调用率方面Agent 2在GPT-OSS 120B上仅约85%，其余近100%，作者据此解释大模型已有较多公平性先验知识、较少依赖外部检索。总体而言模型规模越大绝对相似度越高（120B最佳），但RAG带来的增益主要体现在Agent 1的差异识别任务上。
AI.conclusion: 结论：RAG能提升代理输出与专家参考标准之间的语义一致性，对需要外部知识支撑的任务（Agent 1的不平等识别）效果最强且最稳定；对Agent 2这类偏重内部推理与指标选择的任务，增益更依赖模型规模。实践建议：资源受限场景下Llama 3.1 8B + 代理框架 + RAG是可落地的实用选择（可本地笔记本运行）；资源充足时GPT-OSS 120B配合RAG表现最佳。局限包括：以语义相似度作为质量代理，无法直接衡量事实正确性、推理有效性与临床适宜性，需引入幻觉/事实接地基准；仅覆盖有限LLM与单一临床领域，缺乏专家直接评价；当前仅基于文献检索，未接入EHR数据与真实部署工作流，未来需与分层性能报告对接，并结合数据治理、隐私与机构审查。此外，该系统为概念验证（proof-of-concept），尚不能证明其能真正减少偏倚或改善模型。

title: Cascade-Aware Multi-Agent Routing: Spatio-Temporal Sidecars and Geometry-Switching
summary:
A common architectural pattern in advanced AI reasoning systems is the symbolic graph network: specialized agents or modules connected by delegation edges, routing tasks through a dynamic execution graph. Current schedulers optimize load and fitness but are geometry-blind: they do not model how failures propagate differently in tree-like versus cyclic regimes. In tree-like delegation, a single failure can cascade exponentially; in dense cyclic graphs, failures tend to self-limit. We identify this observability gap, quantify its system-level cost, and propose a lightweight mitigation.
  We formulate online geometry control for route-risk estimation on time-indexed execution graphs with route-local failure history. Our approach combines (i) a Euclidean spatio-temporal propagation baseline, (ii) a hyperbolic route-risk model with temporal decay (and optional burst excitation), and (iii) a learned geometry selector over structural features. The selector is a compact MLP (9->12->1) using six topology statistics plus three geometry-aware signals: BFS shell-growth slope, cycle-rank norm, and fitted Poincare curvature. On the Genesis 3 benchmark distribution, adaptive switching improves win rate in the hardest non_tree regime from 64-72% (fixed hyperbolic variants) to 92%, and achieves 87.2% overall win rate.
  To measure total system value, we compare against Genesis 3 routing without any spatio-temporal sidecar, using only native bandit/LinUCB signals (team fitness and mean node load). This baseline achieves 50.4% win rate overall and 20% in tree-like regimes; the full sidecar recovers 87.2% overall (+36.8 pp), with +48 to +68 pp gains in tree-like settings, consistent with a cascade-sensitivity analysis. Overall, a 133-parameter sidecar substantially mitigates geometry-blind failure propagation in one high-capability execution-graph system.

AI.tldr: 针对AI推理系统中调度器几何盲视问题，提出一种133参数的时空边车模块，通过双曲路线风险模型和几何选择器动态适应图结构，将系统胜率从50.4%提升至87.2%，树状设置中提升尤为显著（+48-68pp）。
AI.motivation: 当前调度器优化负载和适应度但几何盲视：未建模失败在树状与循环 regime 中的不同传播方式。树状委托中单次失败呈指数级传播；密集循环图中失败倾向于自限。需要识别这一可观测性差距并量化其系统级成本。
AI.method: 提出在线几何控制方法，结合(i)欧几里得时空传播基线，(ii)带时间衰减（及可选突发激励）的双曲路线风险模型，(iii)基于结构特征学习的几何选择器（9->12->1 MLP）。选择器使用6个拓扑统计量+3个几何感知信号（BFS壳增长斜率、循环秩范数、拟合庞加莱曲率）。
AI.result: 在Genesis 3基准上，自适应切换在最难的non_tree regime中将胜率从64-72%（固定双曲变体）提升至92%，总体胜率87.2%。相比仅使用原生bandit/LinUCB信号的基线（总体50.4%，树状20%），完整边车恢复87.2%（+36.8pp），树状设置中增益+48至+68pp，与级联敏感性分析一致。
AI.conclusion: 一个133参数的轻量级边车（sidecar）模块能够有效缓解几何盲点导致的失败传播问题，在树状设置中提升48-68个百分点，在非树状最难设置中从64-72%提升至92%，总体胜率达到87.2%。

title: MHPO: Modulated Hazard-aware Policy Optimization for Stable Reinforcement Learning
summary: Regulating the importance ratio is critical for the training stability of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) based frameworks. However, prevailing ratio control methods, such as hard clipping, suffer from non-differentiable boundaries and vanishing gradient regions, failing to maintain gradient fidelity. Furthermore, these methods lack a hazard-aware mechanism to adaptively suppress extreme deviations, leaving the optimization process vulnerable to abrupt policy shifts. To address these challenges, we propose Modulated Hazard-aware Policy Optimization (MHPO), a novel framework designed for robust and stable reinforcement learning. The proposed MHPO introduces a Log-Fidelity Modulator (LFM) to map unbounded importance ratios into a bounded, differentiable domain. This mechanism effectively prevents high-variance outlier tokens from destabilizing the loss landscape while ensuring global gradient stability. Complementarily, a Decoupled Hazard Penalty (DHP) integrates cumulative hazard functions from survival analysis to independently regulate positive and negative policy shifts. By shaping the optimization landscape with hazard-aware penalties, the proposed MHPO achieves fine-grained regulation of asymmetric policy shifts simultaneously mitigating mode collapse from over-expansion and preventing policy erosion from catastrophic contraction within a stabilized trust region. Extensive evaluations on diverse reasoning benchmarks across both text-based and vision-language tasks demonstrate that MHPO consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving superior performance while significantly enhancing training stability.

AI.tldr: MHPO通过引入对数保真调制器(LFM)和解耦危险惩罚(DHP)机制，解决了GRPO训练中重要性比率控制的梯度消失和极端偏差问题，在文本和视觉-语言推理任务上实现了更稳定的训练和更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有组相对策略优化(GRPO)框架中的比率控制方法(如硬裁剪)存在非可微边界和梯度消失区域，无法保持梯度保真度；同时缺乏危险感知机制来自适应抑制极端偏差，导致优化过程容易受到突变策略的影响。
AI.method: 提出MHPO框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 对数保真调制器(LFM)将无界重要性比率映射到有界可微域，防止高方差异常token破坏损失景观并确保全局梯度稳定性；2) 解耦危险惩罚(DHP)整合生存分析中的累积危险函数，独立调节正负策略偏移，通过危险感知惩罚塑造优化景观。
AI.result: 在多种文本和视觉-语言推理基准测试上的广泛评估表明，MHPO始终优于现有方法，在显著提升训练稳定性的同时实现卓越性能。
AI.conclusion: MHPO通过LFM和DHP机制实现细粒度的非对称策略偏移调节，同时缓解模式崩溃和策略侵蚀问题，在稳定信任域内完成鲁棒优化，是GRPO框架的有效改进。

title: On the generic information capacity of relational schemas with a single binary relation
summary: We consider database schemas consisting of a single binary relation, with key constraints and inclusion dependencies. Over this space of 20 schemas, we completely characterize when one schema is generically dominated by another schema. Generic dominance, a classical notion for measuring information capacity, expresses that every instance of a schema can be uniquely represented in the dominating schema, through application of a deterministic, generic data transformation. Our investigation is motivated both by current interest in schema design for graph databases, as well as by intrinsic scientific interest. We also consider the ternary case, but without inclusion dependencies, and discuss how the notions change in the presence of object identifiers.

AI.tldr: 研究针对仅含二元关系、键约束和包含依赖的数据库模式空间，完全刻画了.generic dominance（_generic dominance）的判定条件，并推广到三元情况及对象标识符场景。
AI.motivation: 研究动机源于两方面：(1) 图数据库模式设计的实际需求；(2) 该问题本身的科学内在价值——generic dominance作为衡量信息容量的经典概念，表达了可通过对模式应用确定性、通用的数据转换来唯一表示另一个模式中每个实例的能力。
AI.method: 在20个模式的空间中，通过完全枚举和形式化分析的方法，逐一分析模式间的generic dominance关系。研究还扩展到不含包含依赖的三元关系情况，以及讨论对象标识符（object identifiers）对相关概念的影响。
AI.result: 给出了在所定义的模式空间内何时一个模式会被另一个模式generic dominance的完整刻画（characterization）。对三元情况（无包含依赖）获得了类似结果，并讨论了object identifiers存在时概念的变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为图数据库模式设计提供了理论指导，帮助理解不同模式设计选择的信息容量差异，同时丰富了数据库理论中关于模式等价性和信息容量方面的研究。

title: Intent Formalization: A Grand Challenge for Reliable Coding in the Age of AI Agents
summary: Agentic AI systems can now generate code with remarkable fluency, but a fundamental question remains: \emph{does the generated code actually do what the user intended?} The gap between informal natural language requirements and precise program behavior -- the \emph{intent gap} -- has always plagued software engineering, but AI-generated code amplifies it to an unprecedented scale. This article argues that \textbf{intent formalization} -- the translation of informal user intent into a set of checkable formal specifications -- is the key challenge that will determine whether AI makes software more reliable or merely more abundant. Intent formalization offers a tradeoff spectrum suitable to the reliability needs of different contexts: from lightweight tests that disambiguate likely misinterpretations, through full functional specifications for formal verification, to domain-specific languages from which correct code is synthesized automatically. The central bottleneck is \emph{validating specifications}: since there is no oracle for specification correctness other than the user, we need semi-automated metrics that can assess specification quality with or without code, through lightweight user interaction and proxy artifacts such as tests. We survey early research that demonstrates the \emph{potential} of this approach: interactive test-driven formalization that improves program correctness, AI-generated postconditions that catch real-world bugs missed by prior methods, and end-to-end verified pipelines that produce provably correct code from informal specifications. We outline the open research challenges -- scaling beyond benchmarks, achieving compositionality over changes, metrics for validating specifications, handling rich logics, designing human-AI specification interactions -- that define a research agenda spanning AI, programming languages, formal methods, and human-computer interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场/综述型文章（Microsoft Research），提出"意图形式化"（intent formalization）——将非正式自然语言用户意图自动翻译为可检查的形式化规约（测试、代码契约、逻辑契约、领域特定语言），并将其定位为决定 AI 编程是"让软件更可靠"还是"只是更泛滥"的核心瓶颈；文章给出形式化光谱框架、综述早期证据（TiCoder、ClassInvGen、Auto-Verus、VeriStruct、3DGen），并提出七项开放研究挑战与跨学科研究议程。
AI.motivation: AI 生成代码的"可信性悖论"：代码"看起来对"但"并非构造上正确"（plausible by construction, not correct by construction）。以"去重列表"的经典歧义为例，LLM 的统计模式匹配给出 [1,2,3,2,4]→[1,2,3,4]，而用户可能想要 [1,3,4]。AI 放大了意图鸿沟（intent gap）的两方面机制：(1) 生成速度远超人工审查速率，人工评审防线被绕过（vibe coding 中人从"作者"退化为"监督者/消费者"）；(2) 表面流畅性掩盖语义错误。攻击面同时爆炸（AI 代码进入安全关键与安全敏感系统）。关键前提：验证技术（SMT 求解器、证明助手、验证感知语言）已就绪，而 LLM 也已具备生成规约的能力，首次形成"生成代码—生成规约—相互验证"的闭环可行性；作者明确指出问题不应再问"AI 能否写代码"，而应问"AI 能否帮我们规约代码该做什么并验证其确实如此"。
AI.method: 1) 提出形式化光谱（Figure 2）：测试/IO 示例（动态检查）→ 代码契约（断言、前后置条件、类不变量，动态检查）→ 逻辑契约（Dafny、F*、Verus，量词/ghost 变量/递归谓词，需 SMT 静态验证）→ DSL（完整规约，经验证编译/合成产生可证明正确的代码）。强调各层互补而非互斥：测试可验证后置条件，后置条件引导不变量发现，不变量锚定完整证明；测试预言机本身也是意图形式化的一个实例。2) 区分"规约 vs. 验证"：测试（有限输入）、运行时检查（每次执行）、证明（全输入，数学保证）；意图形式化专注于规约侧供给，验证基础设施已就位但因缺少规约而闲置。3) 提出以测试为基础的自动化规约质量度量：可靠性（soundness，规约不拒绝合法实现）与完备性（completeness，规约能拒绝错误实现，以变异输出检出率衡量以容纳非确定性），两者均可在无代码时通过具体测试输入求值；对含量词/递归谓词的规约使用符号执行技术（如将蕴含 ==> 判为应为双蕴含 <==> 的空列表平凡满足反例）。4) 交互式意图形式化流程（TiCoder）：LLM 生成候选代码与候选测试 → 测试优先瞄准"不同候选产生不同输出"的歧义点 → 用户以 Yes/No/Undef 分类 → 批准测试通过执行剪枝候选、排序输出，并作为回归测试留存。5) 端到端验证流水线（3DGen）：多智能体将非正式 RFC 散文转为 3D DSL 规约，符号测试生成提供迭代反馈，经 EverParse 验证编译为内存安全的 C/Rust 解析器。6) 跨学科定位：与规约挖掘（Daikon）、LLM 代码生成（HumanEval/pass@k）、形式验证、LLM 辅助验证等方向对比，指出意图形式化补上"规约生成"这一缺失输入。
AI.result: 早期证据：① LLM 能生成有意义规约——GPT-4 生成的后置条件在 Defects4J 上捕获 1/8 真实缺陷（含 Daikon 漏检者），soundness/completeness 显著优于 GPT-3.5 与 CodeLlama；ClassInvGen 为 C++ 生成类不变量，优于直接提示与 Daikon；VeriStruct 扩展到 Verus 中整个数据结构模块，11 个模块（含链表、哈希表、B 树）几乎全部函数通过验证。② 自动化度量可超越专家评审——GPT-4 生成的"common elements"Dafny 规约被专家标为 strong，自动完备性指标发现其应为双蕴含；对被测规格发现 3 处误标与 2 处因复制粘贴导致的不一致，均为人工标注遗漏。③ 度量可反哺证明自动化——Auto-Verus 用 soundness/completeness 过滤 LLM 生成的规约与证明并自演化积累训练数据，Rust/Verus 证明准确率比 GPT-4o 零样本高 3.6 倍。④ 交互式形式化提升开发者判断力——15 名专业开发者小规模对照研究中，正确评估 AI 代码的比例约翻倍（p<0.001），认知负荷显著下降（p=0.007），多数参与者偏好 TiCoder；相关评测中 AI 代码正确评估率从 40% 提升至 84%。⑤ 端到端流水线——3DGen 已为 20 种标准网络协议格式（DNS、TLS 扩展、QUIC）生成经验证的解析器，实现"散文→DSL→可证明正确可部署代码"。结论性判断："意图鸿沟是瓶颈；能否弥合将决定 AI 是让软件更可靠还是仅更泛滥。"
AI.conclusion: 意图形式化应被列为"一等研究优先事项"：AI 时代可靠性的关键不在于更好的代码生成，而在于把用户意图显式化、可检查化、可执行化；规约在 vibe coding 范式下将成为人类意图与机器行为之间的"主要接口"。需要跨 AI、编程语言（PL）、形式化方法、人机交互（HCI）的持续投入、专门基准与协作。七项开放挑战：(1) 从基准走向真实系统——处理副作用、可变状态、并发与依赖；(2) 变更意图与组合性——规约需与既有代码/测试/规约组合，并支撑如 C→Rust 的代码翻译（SpecTra 等工作为起点）；(3) 以成本效益识别"该问什么"——按预期防Bug能力对规约排序，避免穷举候选实现；(4) 无预言机的规约验证自动化度量——需结合测试/变异分析代理信号、针对性用户反馈与跨制品（代码、docstring、形式注解）交叉校验；(5) 丰富逻辑与量词——LLM 不擅长量词/递归谓词/ghost 变量，且验证器在具体测试输入上展开递归谓词能力有限；(6) 人机规约交互设计——自然语言解释形式性质、置信度校准建议、规约模板等 HCI 空间基本空白；(7) 融入开发者工作流——从 issue 创建、代码评审到 CI/CD 中的智能体持续发现与验证规约。

title: Agentic Cognitive Profiling: Realigning Automated Alzheimer's Disease Detection with Clinical Construct Validity
summary: Automated Alzheimer's Disease (AD) screening has predominantly followed the inductive paradigm of pattern recognition, which directly maps the input signal to the outcome label. This paradigm sacrifices construct validity of clinical protocol for statistical shortcuts. This paper proposes Agentic Cognitive Profiling (ACP), an agentic framework that realigns automated screening with clinical protocol logic across multiple cognitive domains. Rather than learning opaque mappings from transcripts to labels, the framework decomposes standardized assessments into atomic cognitive tasks and orchestrates specialized LLM agents to extract verifiable scoring primitives. Central to our design is decoupling semantic understanding from measurement by delegating all quantification to deterministic function calling, thereby mitigating hallucination and restoring construct validity. Unlike popular datasets that typically comprise around a hundred participants under a single task, we evaluate on a clinically-annotated corpus of 402 participants across eight structured cognitive tasks spanning multiple cognitive domains. The framework achieves 90.5% score match rate in task examination and 85.3% accuracy in AD prediction, surpassing popular baselines while generating interpretable cognitive profiles grounded in behavioral evidence. This work demonstrates that construct validity and predictive performance need not be traded off, charting a path toward AD screening systems that explain rather than merely predict.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体认知侧写"（ACP）框架，用多智能体工作流把 MoCA-SL 与 HKLLT 标准化测验拆解为原子认知任务，由专职 LLM 审查智能体抽取"计分基元"，所有量化交由确定性函数完成，并通过校验智能体迭代纠错，从而恢复临床构念效度。在 402 名受试者、8 项任务的内部粤语语料上，取得 90.5% 的计分一致率（SMR）与 85.3% 的 AD 筛查准确率（监督），零样本即达 82.4%，均优于手工特征、BERT/RoBERTa 与 LLM-CoT 基线。
AI.motivation: 当前自动化阿尔茨海默病（AD）筛查多采用"归纳式模式识别"范式，直接将语音转录映射到诊断标签，牺牲了临床协议本身的构念效度（construct validity），转而拟合方言、音响等构念无关变量，存在"Clever Hans"捷径学习与可靠性问题。临床范式则是"演绎式"逻辑：标准化测验（MoCA、HKLLT）作为因果探针，将表现缺损归因到具体认知域（记忆、执行、语言等），产出可核验的诊断证据。论文的核心问题即：如何在自动化筛查中恢复临床协议的测量效度，而不必牺牲预测性能；同时现有公开基准（如 ADReSS，N=156）仅含单一任务，无法覆盖多认知域，难以检验自动化计分本身的有效性。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) 施测——采集人口学信息（年龄、受教育年限）与八项标准化任务的口语应答：MoCA-SL 六项口语子任务（图片命名、数字广度、连续减7、句子重复、动物命名流畅性、抽象概念，总分13）与 HKLLT Trial-4/5（10分钟、30分钟延迟回忆，各16词）。(2) 检查——多智能体工作流：Assigner 将每个任务转录路由给带任务专属提示的 Examiner 智能体（提示含任务介绍、注意事项、输出格式、示例四段式）；核心设计是"语义理解与测量解耦"，LLM 只负责语义解析（去口语填充、识别粤语变体、抽取回答），一切计数/判定量化交由确定性函数（list_length()、keyword_check()、parse_hkllt() 等工具调用）完成，从而抑制数值幻觉；随后 verifier 智能体拿原始转录与 Examiner 输出比对，发现幻觉或解析错误则反馈并重生成，最多 3 轮（经验分析显示 N_max=3 精度与效率平衡）。(3) 推断——将基元按临床协议聚合为任务分与测验分，按年龄-教育分层常模归一化（MoCA-SL 常模由完整 MoCA 常模按 13/30 线性缩放得到，在三种估计方案中表现最佳）；预测包括零样本（MoCA-SL 低于第16百分位或 HKLLT 延迟回忆 z<-1.0 判为 AD）与监督（SVM/MLP 输入 20 项计分基元）两种；最终由 Meta Analyst 智能体基于临床协议文档生成按记忆/执行/注意与工作记忆/语言四域组织的可解释认知侧写报告，报告与预测共用同一份证据。骨干模型为本地部署的 Qwen3-8B（vLLM，temperature 0.3/0.1）。基线包括 13 维手工语言学特征、未微调的中文 BERT/RoBERTa、以及同骨干的 LLM-CoT 直读转录基线。
AI.result: 计分层面：加权平均 SMR 90.5%、MAE 0.10；图片命名 97.0%、数字广度 98.5%、动物命名 98.5%（近天花板）；HKLLT Trial-4 94.1%、Trial-5 92.6%；句子重复 89.7%（因发音层面歧义）；抽象概念 82.3%、连续减7 82.4%（高推断任务）。消融显示：移除 verifier 后加权 SMR 降至 85.5%（抽象概念 82.3%→64.7%，连续减7 82.4%→70.6%）；移除函数调用则降至 79.2%，HKLLT 计数类任务崩塌（Trial-4 94.1%→27.9%，Trial-5 92.6%→23.5%）。筛查层面：零样本 82.4% 准确率/F1 80.2%，已超最佳基线 BERT-SVM 79.4%；监督 SVM 达 85.3% 准确率（F1 78.3），全系统最高；LLM-CoT 仅 70.6%。移除组件后零样本降至 79.4%/69.1%，监督降至 77.9%/82.4%。分析：MoCA-SL 与完整 MoCA 强相关（Pearson r=0.829, p<0.001），验证子集效度；SHAP 显示 HKLLT 记忆类特征（n_hkllt4_recall）最重要，其次为 MoCA-SL 任务分，受教育年限与预测风险负相关（认知储备效应），与临床标记一致。误差分析：低推断任务错误源于模型幻觉且 verifier 只能"剔除"而无法"找回"遗漏答案；高推断任务错误多在边界语义判断（如"用轮子行"是否算抽象概念），且 verifier 判断有时与人类评估者不一致。
AI.conclusion: 结论与局限：ACP 证明构念效度与预测性能并非零和——零样本临床协议逻辑本身即可超越在任务转录上训练的 PLM 基线，而 SHAP 显示最重要特征正是情景记忆延迟回忆，说明抽取的计分基元捕获的是真实认知构念而非统计捷径；框架能同时给出可审计的认知域解释与风险标签，为"能解释而非仅预测"的 AD 筛查系统提供原则性基础。局限包括：框架受限于预定义评分规则与既定任务所覆盖的认知域；语义解析能力受 8B 级别 LLM 理解力制约（作者认为更大模型或更稳定）；因 IRB 与隐私限制语料无法公开，难以直接复现（但架构与语言无关，仅需重写提示与常模表即可迁移至其他语言/语种）。

title: How Clued up are LLMs? Evaluating Multi-Step Deductive Reasoning in a Text-Based Game Environment
summary: Deducing whodunit proves challenging for LLM agents. In this paper, we implement a text-based multi-agent version of the classic board game Clue as a rule-based testbed for evaluating multi-step deductive reasoning, with six agents drawn from GPT-4o-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash. We further investigate whether fine-tuning on structured logic puzzles transfers to improved in-game reasoning and gameplay. Across 18 simulated games, agents achieve only four correct wins, indicating difficulty in maintaining consistent deductive reasoning over the course of a full game. Additionally, we find that fine-tuning does not reliably improve performance and, in some cases, appears to increase reasoning volume without improving reasoning precision.

AI.tldr: 本文将经典桌游Clue实现为基于规则的多智能体测试平台，用于评估大语言模型的逐步推理能力。研究使用GPT-4o-mini和Gemini-2.5-Flash共6个智能体，在18场模拟游戏中测试其推理表现。结果显示智能体仅获得4次正确胜利，表明在完整游戏过程中维持一致的演绎推理存在困难。此外，微调并未可靠提升性能，在某些情况下反而可能增加推理量而未提高推理精度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在推断"元凶"(whodunit)方面面临挑战，需要一个基于规则的测试平台来评估多步骤演绎推理能力。现有推理评估缺乏能够测试智能体在完整游戏流程中保持逻辑一致性的真实场景。
AI.method: 将经典桌游Clue实现为基于文本的多智能体系统，使用6个来自GPT-4o-mini和Gemini-2.5-Flash的智能体进行18场模拟游戏实验，并研究在结构化逻辑谜题上进行微调是否能迁移到游戏中改善推理和游戏表现。
AI.result: 在18场模拟游戏中，智能体仅获得4次正确胜利。微调未能可靠提升性能，在某些情况下反而增加推理量而不提高推理精度。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体在完整游戏过程中难以维持一致的演绎推理。结构化逻辑谜题的微调不能可靠迁移到Clue游戏中的推理任务，可能存在推理深度与精度之间的权衡。

title: Integrating Explainable Machine Learning and Mixed-Integer Optimization for Personalized Sleep Quality Intervention
summary: Sleep quality is influenced by a complex interplay of behavioral, environmental, and psychosocial factors, yet most computational studies focus mainly on predictive risk identification rather than actionable intervention design. Although machine learning models can accurately predict subjective sleep outcomes, they rarely translate predictive insights into practical intervention strategies. To address this gap, we propose a personalized predictive-prescriptive framework that integrates interpretable machine learning with mixed-integer optimization. A supervised classifier trained on survey data predicts sleep quality, while SHAP-based feature attribution quantifies the influence of modifiable factors. These importance measures are incorporated into a mixed-integer optimization model that identifies minimal and feasible behavioral adjustments, while modelling resistance to change through a penalty mechanism. The framework achieves strong predictive performance, with a test F1-score of 0.9544 and an accuracy of 0.9366. Sensitivity and Pareto analyses reveal a clear trade-off between expected improvement and intervention intensity, with diminishing returns as additional changes are introduced. At the individual level, the model generates concise recommendations, often suggesting one or two high-impact behavioral adjustments and sometimes recommending no change when expected gains are minimal. By integrating prediction, explanation, and constrained optimization, this framework demonstrates how data-driven insights can be translated into structured and personalized decision support for sleep improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合可解释机器学习与混合整数优化的个性化预测-处方框架，用于睡眠质量干预。该框架使用监督分类器预测睡眠质量，通过SHAP特征归因识别可改变因素的影响，并利用混合整数优化模型找出最小可行的行为调整方案。实验表明该框架具有优异的预测性能（F1=0.9544，准确率=0.9366），同时能够生成个性化、简洁的干预建议。
AI.motivation: 现有计算研究主要关注睡眠质量的预测风险识别，而缺乏将预测洞察转化为实际干预策略的方法。机器学习模型虽能准确预测主观睡眠结果，但难以将预测转化为可操作的干预措施。
AI.method: 1) 使用监督分类器基于调查数据预测睡眠质量；2) 基于SHAP的特征归因量化可改变因素的影响；3) 将特征重要性纳入混合整数优化模型，通过惩罚机制模拟改变阻力；4) 识别最小可行的行为调整方案。
AI.result: 框架达到强预测性能，测试F1分数为0.9544，准确率为0.9366。敏感性和Pareto分析揭示了预期改善与干预强度之间的明确权衡，随着额外改变的引入呈边际效益递减。在个体层面，模型生成简洁建议，通常建议1-2个高影响力行为调整，或在预期收益较小时建议不改变。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合预测、解释和约束优化，该框架展示了如何将数据驱动的洞察转化为结构化、个性化的睡眠改善决策支持。

title: Halo: Domain-Aware Query Optimization for Long-Context Question Answering
summary:
Long-context question answering (QA) over lengthy documents is critical for applications such as financial analysis, legal review, and scientific research. Current approaches, such as processing entire documents via a single LLM call or retrieving relevant chunks via RAG have two drawbacks: First, as context size increases, response quality can degrade, impacting accuracy. Second, iteratively processing hundreds of input documents can incur prohibitively high costs in API calls. To improve response quality and reduce the number of iterations needed to get the desired response, users tend to add domain knowledge to their prompts. However, existing systems fail to systematically capture and use this knowledge to guide query processing. Domain knowledge is treated as prompt tokens alongside the document: the LLM may or may not follow it, there is no reduction in computational cost, and when outputs are incorrect, users must manually iterate.
  We present Halo, a long-context QA framework that automatically extracts domain knowledge from user prompts and applies it as executable operators across a multi-stage query execution pipeline. Halo identifies three common forms of domain knowledge - where in the document to look, what content to ignore, and how to verify the answer - and applies each at the pipeline stage where it is most effective: pruning the document before chunk selection, filtering irrelevant chunks before inference, and ranking candidate responses after generation. To handle imprecise or invalid domain knowledge, Halo includes a fallback mechanism that detects low-quality operators at runtime and selectively disables them. Our evaluation across finance, literature, and scientific datasets shows that Halo achieves up to 13% higher accuracy and 4.8x lower cost compared to baselines, and enables a lightweight open-source model to approach frontier LLM accuracy at 78x lower cost.

AI.tldr: Halo是一个长文本问答框架，通过自动从用户提示中提取领域知识并将其作为可执行运算符应用于多阶段查询管道来解决长文档问答问题。该框架在文档修剪、分块过滤和响应排序三个阶段应用领域知识，并包含运行时回退机制。实验表明其准确率最高提升13%，成本降低4.8倍。
AI.motivation: 长文本问答在金融分析、法律审查和科学研究等应用中至关重要。现有方法（通过单一LLM调用处理完整文档或通过RAG检索相关分块）存在两个缺陷：随着上下文增大，响应质量下降影响准确性；迭代处理数百个输入文档会产生高昂的API成本。虽然用户倾向于在提示中添加领域知识来改善响应质量和减少迭代次数，但现有系统无法系统性地捕获和使用这些知识来指导查询处理。
AI.method: Halo是一个长文本问答框架，它自动从用户提示中提取领域知识，并将其作为可执行运算符应用于多阶段查询执行管道。框架识别三种常见领域知识形式并在最有效的管道阶段应用：1）在分块选择前进行文档修剪；2）在推理前过滤无关分块；3）在生成后对候选响应进行排序。此外，Halo包含回退机制，可在运行时检测低质量运算符并选择性禁用。
AI.result: 在金融、文学和科学数据集上的评估表明，Halo相比基线方法实现了最高13%的准确率提升和4.8倍的成本降低，并使轻量级开源模型能够以78倍更低的成本接近前沿LLM的准确率。
AI.conclusion: Halo通过系统性地捕获和应用领域知识，成功解决了现有方法的局限性。该框架在保持高准确率的同时显著降低了计算成本，使轻量级开源模型能够以78倍更低的成本接近前沿LLM的准确率。

title: Energy Flow Graph: Modeling Software Energy Consumption
summary: The growing energy demands of computational systems necessitate a fundamental shift from performance-centric design to one that treats energy consumption as one of the primary design considerations. Current approaches treat energy consumption as an aggregate, deterministic property, overlooking the path-dependent nature of computation, where different execution paths through the same software consume dramatically different energy. We introduce the Energy Flow Graph (EFG), a formal model that represents computational processes as state-transition systems with energy costs for both states and transitions. EFG enables various applications in software engineering, including static analysis of energy-optimal execution paths and a multiplicative cascade model that predicts combined optimization effects without exhaustive testing. Our early experiments demonstrate EFG's versatility across domains: in software programs validated through 3.5 million executions, 15.6% of solutions exhibit high path-dependent variance (CV $>$ 0.1), while structural optimization reveals up to 705$\times$ energy reduction. In AI pipelines, the cascade model predicts optimization combinations within 5.1% error, enabling selection from 4.2 million possibilities using only 22 measurements. The EFG transforms energy optimization from trial-and-error to systematic analysis, providing a foundation for green software engineering across computational domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出能量流图(EFG)形式化模型，将计算过程表示为带能量成本的状态转换系统，解决现有方法忽略计算路径依赖能源消耗的问题，实现静态分析能量最优路径和组合优化效果预测。
AI.motivation: 当前计算系统的能源需求不断增长，需要从以性能为中心的设计转向以能源消耗为主要设计考虑；现有方法将能源消耗视为aggregate、确定性属性，忽略了计算的路径依赖特性——同一软件的不同执行路径消耗的能量差异显著。
AI.method: 提出能量流图(EFG)形式化模型，将计算过程表示为具有状态和转换能量成本的状态转换系统；开发静态分析方法分析能量最优执行路径；构建乘法级联模型预测组合优化效果而无需穷举测试。
AI.result: 软件程序验证中，15.6%的解决方案表现出高路径依赖方差(CV>0.1)，结构性优化可实现最高705倍能量减少；AI流水线中，级联模型预测优化组合的误差仅为5.1%，仅需22次测量即可从420万种可能性中选择最优方案。
AI.conclusion: EFG为绿色软件工程提供了系统化分析基础，能够在软件程序和AI流水线中实现显著的节能优化。该方法将能源优化从试错模式转变为系统分析，支持静态分析和组合优化预测，为跨计算领域的能源效率提升奠定了理论基础。

title: In Trust We Survive: Emergent Trust Learning
summary:
We introduce Emergent Trust Learning (ETL), a lightweight, trust-based control algorithm that can be plugged into existing AI agents. It enables these to reach cooperation in competitive game environments under shared resources. Each agent maintains a compact internal trust state, which modulates memory, exploration, and action selection. ETL requires only individual rewards and local observations and incurs negligible computational and communication overhead.
  We evaluate ETL in three environments: In a grid-based resource world, trust-based agents reduce conflicts and prevent long-term resource depletion while achieving competitive individual returns. In a hierarchical Tower environment with strong social dilemmas and randomised floor assignments, ETL sustains high survival rates and recovers cooperation even after extended phases of enforced greed. In the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, the algorithm generalises to a strategic meta-game, maintaining cooperation with reciprocal opponents while avoiding long-term exploitation by defectors. Code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种轻量级的基于信任的控制算法ETL，可嵌入现有AI智能体，在竞争性游戏环境中实现合作。该算法只需个体奖励和局部观测，具有极低的计算和通信开销。
AI.motivation: 在共享资源的竞争性游戏环境中，智能体之间存在社会困境，需要解决如何在个体利益与集体利益之间取得平衡，实现可持续的合作。
AI.method: 每个智能体维护一个紧凑的内部信任状态，该状态调节记忆、探索和动作选择。ETL只需要个体奖励和局部观测即可运行。
AI.result: 在三种环境中验证：(1)网格资源世界中，基于信任的智能体减少冲突、防止长期资源耗竭并获得竞争性个体回报；(2)层级塔楼环境中，ETL维持高存活率并在强制贪婪阶段后恢复合作；(3)迭代囚徒困境中，算法可推广到战略元游戏，与reciprocal对手维持合作同时避免被defector长期剥削。
AI.conclusion: ETL是一种有效的轻量级信任学习算法，能够在多种竞争性环境中促进合作，具有低开销、易嵌入的特点，适用于现有AI智能体的扩展。

title: AI Scientist via Synthetic Task Scaling
summary: With the advent of AI agents, automatic scientific discovery has become a tenable goal. Many recent works scaffold agentic systems that can perform machine learning research, but don't offer a principled way to train such agents -- and current LLMs often generate plausible-looking but ineffective ideas. To make progress on training agents that can learn from doing, we provide a novel synthetic environment generation pipeline targeting machine learning agents. Our pipeline automatically synthesizes machine learning challenges compatible with the SWE-agent framework, covering topic sampling, dataset proposal, and code generation. The resulting synthetic tasks are 1) grounded in real machine learning datasets, because the proposed datasets are verified against the Huggingface API and are 2) verified for higher quality with a self-debugging loop. To validate the effectiveness of our synthetic tasks, we tackle MLGym, a benchmark for machine learning tasks. From the synthetic tasks, we sample trajectories from a teacher model (GPT-5), then use the trajectories to train a student model (Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B). The student models trained with our synthetic tasks achieve improved performance on MLGym, raising the AUP metric by 9% for Qwen3-4B and 12% for Qwen3-8B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种合成环境生成pipeline用于训练机器学习智能体，通过自动合成基于真实ML数据集的任务，并使用教师-学生范式（GPT-5→Qwen3）进行训练，在MLGym基准上实现了显著的性能提升（AUP提升9-12%）。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体的出现，自动科学发现成为可行目标。现有的工作主要构建能够执行机器学习研究的智能体系统，但缺乏训练这些智能体的原则性方法。当前的大语言模型倾向于生成看起来合理但实际无效的想法，需要一种新的训练范式来培养能够从实践中学习的智能体。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的合成环境生成pipeline，包含三个核心模块：主题采样、数据集提案和代码生成。该pipeline通过HuggingFace API验证确保任务基于真实的ML数据集，并采用自调试循环(self-debugging loop)提高任务质量。实验采用教师-学生范式：使用GPT-5生成合成任务的轨迹作为训练数据，训练Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型。
AI.result: 在MLGym基准上，使用合成任务训练的模型取得了显著性能提升：Qwen3-4B的AUP指标提升9%，Qwen3-8B的AUP指标提升12%。这验证了合成任务训练方法的有效性。
