AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种针对机器学习智能体的合成环境生成pipeline，能够自动合成与SWE-agent框架兼容的ML挑战任务。通过使用GPT-5作为教师模型生成轨迹来训练Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B学生模型，在MLGym基准上取得了显著的提升，证明了合成任务训练方法的有效性。该方法为训练能够"从实践中学习"的智能体提供了新的思路。

title: Minimum-Action Learning: Energy-Constrained Symbolic Model Selection for Physical Law Identification from Noisy Data
summary: Identifying physical laws from noisy observational data is a central challenge in scientific machine learning. We present Minimum-Action Learning (MAL), a framework that selects symbolic force laws from a pre-specified basis library by minimizing a Triple-Action functional combining trajectory reconstruction, architectural sparsity, and energy-conservation enforcement. A wide-stencil acceleration-matching technique reduces noise variance by 10,000x, transforming an intractable problem (SNR ~0.02) into a learnable one (SNR ~1.6); this preprocessing is the critical enabler shared by all methods tested, including SINDy variants. On two benchmarks -- Kepler gravity and Hooke's law -- MAL recovers the correct force law with Kepler exponent p = 3.01 +/- 0.01 at ~0.07 kWh (40% reduction vs. prediction-error-only baselines). The raw correct-basis rate is 40% for Kepler and 90% for Hooke; an energy-conservation-based criterion discriminates the true force law in all cases, yielding 100% pipeline-level identification. Basis library sensitivity experiments show that near-confounders degrade selection (20% with added r^{-2.5} and r^{-1.5}), while distant additions are harmless, and the conservation diagnostic remains informative even when the correct basis is absent. Direct comparison with noise-robust SINDy variants, Hamiltonian Neural Networks, and Lagrangian Neural Networks confirms MAL's distinct niche: interpretable, energy-constrained model selection that combines symbolic basis identification with dynamical rollout validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"最小作用量学习"（Minimum-Action Learning, MAL）：一个可微分框架，在预置符号基函数库中通过最小化"三重作用量"损失（轨迹重建 I_max + 架构稀疏 E_min + 能量守恒 L_Symmetry）来识别带噪数据中的物理力 law。作者以开普勒引力与胡克弹性为基准，报告 Kepler 指数 p=3.01±0.01、能耗约 0.07 kWh、能量守恒准则下 100% 的管线级识别率。
AI.motivation: 从含噪观测数据中反演力学基本定律是科学机器学习的核心难题：数值微分会把噪声灾难性放大（σ_a² ∝ σ_pos²/Δt⁴），使标准符号回归、SINDy、PINN 等方法失效；而 HNN/LNN 虽内嵌守恒结构却只学到黑箱能量函数，无法给出可解释的符号形式。同时"物理理解 vs. 统计相关"的辨别、模型选择的能量效率等问题也缺乏物理依据的判据。MAL 试图把最小作用量原理反转为可微正则化器：既做符号基选择，又做动力学 rollout 验证与能量约束的稀疏化。
AI.method:
1) Noether 力基：SO(2) 旋转对称下把力写成径向形式 F(r)=-[Σ A_i θ_i φ_i(r)] r̂/r，基库 φ_i∈{r^-2, r^-1, r, 1, r^-3}，门控 A_i=softmax(ℓ_i/τ)，温度退火实现软到离散选择；嵌入 velocity-Verlet 积分器（Δt_model=0.01）。
2) 三重作用量损失 L=α_I L_Imax + α_E L_Emin + α_S L_Symmetry；L_Imax=轨迹 MSE + 广步长加速度匹配（L_accel 用 stride s=10 的中心二阶差分估计）；L_Emin=Var[E]（能量守恒）+ 系数稀疏 ⟨|A_i θ_i|⟩（λ=0.01）+ 门熵（λ=0.5）；L_Symmetry=Var[E]。
3) 广步长降噪：噪声方差按 s⁴ 缩减，s=10 时 SNR 从 0.016→1.6，系统误差 O(s²Δt²)<0.3%。
4) 两阶段训练：warmup(1–50 epoch, α_E=0.01, τ=1.0) → sparsification(51–200, α_E→1.0 线性, τ→0.05 指数衰减)；Adam lr=1e-3, batch=4；训练后用最小二乘投影重新标定主基系数（抵消 L1 造成的偏差）。
5) 数据：16 条 2D 开普勒轨道（a∈[0.5,5] AU 对数均匀，e∈[0,0.3]），辛积分 Δt=1e-3 后降采样到 0.05，位置噪声 σ=1%中位半径，70/15/15 划分。
6) 验证指标：T²∝a^p 自相关峰周期回归、5 个轨道周期长时 rollout 的 Hamiltonian 方差 σ_H²、门集中度 C_gate（HHI 归一化）；并与 SINDy 变体、HNN、LNN、Qwen2-Math、PINN、纯 teacher-forcing 基线对比，以及基库敏感性实验（加近干扰项 r^-2.5/r^-1.5、远项 r²/r^-4/ln r、移除正确基）与门初始化偏置实验。
AI.result:
1) 开普勒：主运行直接选中 r^-2（A=1.000），10 个种子中 4/10 直接正确（3 个选 r^-3、3 个选 r^-1）；但 10 个种子全部给出 p∈[2.995,3.006]，说明单靠 p≈3 不足以判别，需跨种子用能量守恒准则（正确基比 r^-1 好 3×、比 r^-3 好 6×），管线级识别率 100%；恢复 GM=0.936（误差 6.4%），p=3.01±0.01，训练 835 s、约 0.07 kWh，比仅用预测误差的基线省能 40%。
2) 降噪：s=1 时 SNR=0.016 训练失败；s=5→0.40 部分成功；s=10→1.6 成功；s=20→6.4。
3) 胡克：9/10 直接选中 r，k̂=0.980±0.001（误差 2%），唯一异常种子被能量守恒判据以 >3× 方差差拒绝；管线率 100%。
4) 内在时标：结晶跨度 Δt_span=36.2±4.1 epoch（胡克 42.5±1.6），几何增长率 γ=1.137±0.013/epoch（λ≈0.128），与初始化和胜出基无关；门集中度 C_gate=0.99±0.02 对比 teacher-forcing 基线 0.14±0.04（Mann–Whitney U=100，p<1e-4）。
5) 干预实验：延长 warmup（4/10）、降噪至 σ=0.005（4/10）均无效；偏置初始化 α_logits=[1.5,0,0,0,0] 达到 10/10，说明瓶颈在 warmup 门竞争动力学而非噪声或探索时间。
6) 对比：同用广步长预处理时 vanilla SINDy 10/10、ensemble-SINDy 10/10、GP-SINDy 8/10（且 <1 s，约为 MAL 成本的 1%），表明"广步长是关键使能器，算法本身并非"；HNN（17K 参数、113 s、σ_H=4.1e-4）为黑箱 Hamiltonian，LNN（242 s）因质量矩阵病态导致验证损失发散到 1e6；数学 LLM 在逆问题 0%；PINN 需预指定方程（85%）；纯 teacher-forcing 门停在 45% 且能耗高 77%。
7) 基库敏感性：加入近干扰项使正确率从 50% 降到 20%，远项无影响，移除正确基时系统在备选间分裂，但守恒诊断始终保持信息量。
AI.conclusion: MAL 证明了三项主要贡献：(i) 广步长二阶差分将噪声方差降低 10⁴ 倍，把 SNR≈0.02 的不可解问题变为 SNR≈1.6 的可解问题，是所有方法（含 SINDy）的共同前提；(ii) 能量最小化驱动的软-离散门锐化实现了符号基选择，且暴露出与初始化无关的普适结晶时标，物理先验偏置初始化可达 10/10；(iii) 基于长时 Hamiltonian 守恒的模型选择判据可跨种子区分"数值拟合好但物理错误"的模型（3–6× 方差差）。总体定位是：把 SINDy 的符号可解释性与 HNN 的动力学/守恒验证整合到同一可微框架，并附带 40% 能效提升。作者同时明确承认局限：必须预置含正确答案的基库（故为模型选择而非开放式发现）、仅 2D 中心力两个合成基准、无偏置初始化时开普勒直接正确率仅 40%、LNN 需处理质量矩阵奇异性、以及 α_E/τ 经过整数比与门跃迁的"巧合"可能仅源于有理数稠密性，尚需扰动实验验证。展望方向包括非中心力（磁场）、耗散系统、高维与多体耦合、真实星历数据，以及与开放式符号回归/LLM 引导搜索结合以实现自主发现。

title: Talk is Cheap, Logic is Hard: Benchmarking LLMs on Post-Condition Formalization
summary: Formal specifications, such as pre- and post-conditions provide a solid basis for performing thorough program verification. However, developers rarely provide such formal specifications, hence if AI could help in constructing them, it would make formal verification possible or at least make automated testing much more effective. This paper presents a study on the ability of LLMs in generating formal FULL pre- and post-conditions of a program, given its natural language description. 24 state-of-the-art LLMs were evaluated on a freshly prepared dataset of 40 tasks. The paper investigates specifications of varying difficulty and discusses a set of more refined performance metrics in addition the general accept@1 performance. It also investigates the impact of using automatically generated tests for validation of the solutions proposed by LLMs. The results of the experiment reveal that, in general LLMs can produce valid pre- and post-conditions based on natural language descriptions of programs. Incorrect solutions from proprietary models are also often near correct. A closer inspection shows that open-source models tend to result in a higher proportion of erroneous results while proprietary models tend to have slightly higher false negative rates. Interestingly, the results also show that augmenting the manually prepared dataset with automatically generated tests leads to the exposure of wrong solutions, which would have otherwise been accepted as correct. In general, LLMs perform better in formalizing pre-conditions than on post-conditions and proprietary models perform better than open ones. However, none of the LLMs were able to correctly formalize all the tasks in our benchmark. Overall, the effectiveness and reliability of LLMs in formalizing pre- and post-conditions could be greatly improved by using a good test suite that checks the correctness of the LLM generated formalizations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究24个LLM根据程序自然语言描述生成形式化前置和后置条件的能力，在40个任务的基准数据集上进行评估。结果表明LLM整体可行，专有模型优于开源模型，前置条件处理优于后置条件，配合自动生成测试可有效验证正确性。
AI.motivation: 开发者很少提供形式化规范（如前置和后置条件），如果AI能帮助构建这些规范，就可以使形式化验证成为可能，或至少使自动化测试更加有效。
AI.method: 评估24个最先进的LLM在40个任务数据集上的表现，研究不同难度级别的规范，使用除accept@1之外的更精细的性能指标，并使用自动生成的测试来验证LLM提出的解决方案。
AI.result: LLM可以根据程序的自然语言描述生成有效的前置和后置条件。专有模型的不正确解决方案通常接近正确；开源模型产生错误结果的比例更高，而专有模型的假阴性率略高。自动生成的测试能够暴露原本会被接受的错误解决方案。LLM在形式化前置条件方面优于后置条件，专有模型优于开源模型，但没有LLM能正确完成所有任务。
AI.conclusion: LLM在形式化前置和后置条件方面的有效性和可靠性可以通过使用良好的测试套件来检查生成的形式化规范的正确性而得到极大提高。目前没有LLM能正确完成所有任务，但结合自动生成测试的验证机制可以有效暴露错误解决方案。

title: Governed Memory: A Production Architecture for Multi-Agent Workflows
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables, 7 appendices. Code and datasets: https://github.com/personizeai/governed-memory
summary: Enterprise AI deploys dozens of autonomous agent nodes across workflows, each acting on the same entities with no shared memory and no common governance. We identify five structural challenges arising from this memory governance gap: memory silos across agent workflows; governance fragmentation across teams and tools; unstructured memories unusable by downstream systems; redundant context delivery in autonomous multi-step executions; and silent quality degradation without feedback loops. We present Governed Memory, a shared memory and governance layer addressing this gap through four mechanisms: a dual memory model combining open-set atomic facts with schema-enforced typed properties; tiered governance routing with progressive context delivery; reflection-bounded retrieval with entity-scoped isolation; and a closed-loop schema lifecycle with AI-assisted authoring and automated per-property refinement. We validate each mechanism through controlled experiments (N=250, five content types): 99.6% fact recall with complementary dual-modality coverage; 92% governance routing precision; 50% token reduction from progressive delivery; zero cross-entity leakage across 500 adversarial queries; 100% adversarial governance compliance; and output quality saturation at approximately seven governed memories per entity. On the LoCoMo benchmark, the architecture achieves 74.8% overall accuracy, confirming that governance and schema enforcement impose no retrieval quality penalty. The system is in production at Personize.ai.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「Governed Memory（受治理记忆）」这一面向企业多智能体工作流的生产级共享记忆与治理架构，系统识别出「记忆治理缺口」导致的五大结构性问题（记忆孤岛、治理碎片化、非结构化记忆无法被下游消费、上下文冗余重复注入、缺乏反馈导致质量静默退化），并用四层机制逐一应对：双记忆模型（开放集原子事实 + Schema 强制类型化属性）、分层治理路由与渐进式上下文交付、反思有界检索与实体级隔离、闭环 Schema 生命周期（AI 辅助编写 + 逐属性自动精化）。实验基于合成数据（N=250，5类内容）与 LoCoMo 基准：事实召回 99.6%、治理路由精确率 92%/召回 88%、渐进式交付节省 50.3% token、500 条对抗查询下零跨实体泄漏、对抗性治理合规率 100%、输出质量在每实体约 7 条治理记忆处饱和；LoCoMo 总体准确率 74.8%（人类基线 87.9%），说明治理与 Schema 强制不带来检索质量惩罚。系统已在 Personize.ai 生产部署。
AI.motivation: 企业 AI 部署并非单个智能体，而是分布在富化管线、外呼序列、客服自动化、评分模型、研究智能体等数十个自治节点上，它们作用于同一批实体（客户、公司、商机），却既无共享记忆也无共同治理层。由此产生五类结构性挑战：①工作流间的记忆孤岛（富化智能体发现的洞察无法传给数小时后的外呼节点）；②跨团队/工具的治理碎片化（品牌语气、合规规则分散在系统提示、Notion 文档与不同工作流中，法务更新无法传播到 14 个智能体配置）；③非结构化记忆成为下游死路（可按相似度检索并拼入提示，但无法按购买阶段过滤、按交易额排序、路由到条件工作流或同步 CRM）；④自治多步执行中的上下文冗余（每步独立触发治理路由，同一合规策略被反复注入，挤占上下文并与新指令争夺注意力）；⑤缺乏反馈闭环导致的静默质量退化（Schema 老化、模型更新、内容类型漂移，无逐属性准确率监控、抽取置信度追踪或漂移检测，往往在 CRM 字段错了三个月后才被发现）。作者将此称为「记忆治理缺口」：缺少一层基础设施来治理智能体存什么、信息如何类型化与查询、哪些组织策略送达哪个智能体、上下文如何跨自治步骤交付、以及系统是否可靠运行。作者同时指出 RAG 只是「检索原语」而非基础设施层（假设单智能体、单查询、静态文档库），SimpleMem/Mem0 等是「记忆原语」，均未覆盖组织级治理需求。
AI.method: 四层可独立配置/关闭的架构，均按 orgId 分区并通过标准 MCP 接口与 SDK 暴露。Layer 1 双记忆存储：单次 LLM 调用同时产出开放集原子事实与 Schema 强制类型化属性值（含置信度与更新语义），抽取提示强制五项不变量（完备性、自足性、共指消解、时间锚定、原子性），并计算三个轻量质量门（coreference/self-containment/temporal anchoring）作为预警信号；写入前按余弦阈值 0.92 去重，后台整合用更高阈值 0.95 以降低误合并，并带「唯一记忆保护」。属性选择在抽取前用内容-属性元数据嵌入相似度加阈值与数量上限筛选，避免把数百个无关属性塞给模型。Layer 2 治理路由：治理变量以结构化元数据（名称、描述、标签、标题层级、内容感知嵌入）存储，创建/更新时并行执行三步富化——HyPE（假想提示增强，借鉴文档扩展查询预测与 HyDE 的命名）、治理范围推断（是否 always-on、触发关键词）、内容感知嵌入。Fast 模式（约 850ms）用嵌入相似度+关键词重叠+always-on 加权的复合打分，无 LLM 调用；Full 模式（约 2–5s）先嵌入预筛再由 LLM 四步结构化分析（任务理解→质量维度识别→任务精化→逐变量选择优先级/模式/理由），支持章节级抽取与 fallback 提升；Auto 模式按库特征自动选择。渐进式交付维护会话状态记录（24 小时 TTL），已交付变量在后续轮次排除，仅注入增量；supplementary 项不记录以便任务演变时升级为 critical。Layer 3 受治理检索：查询嵌入→组织分区内向量检索并按 CRM key 做实体过滤→按人物/实体/地点/时间范围/记忆类型后置过滤→可选反思循环（默认最多 2 轮：低温 0.1 判定证据完整性，不完整则中温 0.3 生成 1–2 条定向追问，按 id 合并结果）→合并去重→可选 LLM 答案合成与来源标注；另有独立实体上下文注入端点，按 token 预算编译 Properties/Observations 两段，优先 schema 属性后开放集记忆（按时间倒序）。Layer 4 Schema 生命周期与质量反馈：自然语言→流式生成完整 Schema 定义；交互式逐属性/批量增强；基于领域 rubric 的 LLM-as-judge 评分（default/sales/support/research 四预设，100 分归一，可自定义），配合执行日志（会话摘要、工具调用日志、记忆召回与创建日志、治理上下文有用度评分）实现可诊断归因；三阶段自动精化——抽取回放出基线→逐属性分析（extracted/missed/low_confidence/inaccurate/unavailable）→并行逐属性优化并标注变更。安全侧：存储与传输加密、组织分区键硬隔离、治理变量可见性与访问级别 API 层控制、两阶段 PII 脱敏（抽取前用类型化占位符、抽取后再扫描防止模型重建），四层实体检测（密钥/金融 PII/身份 PII/联系 PII），支持 redact/mask/hash 三种匿名化策略。
AI.result: 抽取质量（E1）：250 样本 5 类内容总体事实召回 99.6%（会议记录/文档/邮件/转录均 100%，聊天 98%）。质量门消融（E9）：40 样本下输出缺陷率由 8.4% 降至 6.3%（相对降 25%），时间准确率提升 6.8pp（88.4%→95.2%），信噪比由 1.1:1 提升到 4.2:1，判定精确率 94.5%。双模态互补性（E12）：34% 两者均捕获、38% 仅开放集捕获、12% 仅 Schema 捕获、16% 均漏检，合并召回 82.8%。治理路由（E3/E13）：25 个变量/5 类别上精确率 92%、召回 88%（20 类任务）；良构变量比劣构变量可发现性高 20–50pp，5 类中有 3 类劣构变量发现率为 0%。反思消融（E10）：手动多跳 2 轮完整度 62.8% vs 无反思 37.1%（+25.7pp），API 托管 1 轮仅 +3.3pp，单轮手动 61.2% 已接近两轮上限。实体隔离（E11）：100 个高度重叠实体、500 查询×5 类型共 3,800 条结果零真实跨实体泄漏，2.74% 标记（104 条）全为姓名 token 造成的假阳性。语义冲突（E14）：30 对冲突中冲突检出率 83.3%，严格陈旧抑制 33.3%，错误陈旧 3.3%，15 个 both_present 案例均以前置新主张呈现新值（半衰期 38 天指数衰减）。端到端消融（E8，10 客户×3 轮，销售 rubric）：A 无记忆 79.5、B 原始记忆 85.2（+5.7）、C 开放集+治理 86.4（+6.9）、D 完整受治理记忆 85.9（+6.4）。对抗治理（E15）：50 个对抗场景 100% 合规，护栏激活率 96%（48/50），零策略泄漏。LoCoMo（272 会话、1,542 问题/10 段对话）：总体 74.8%，单跳 78.7%、多跳 51.7%、时间 64.6%、开放式 83.6%（超人类基线 75.4% 达 +8.2pp），总体低于人类 87.9% 13.1pp；文中对照独立评测的 Mem0 64–67%、Zep 42–66%、OpenAI 内置记忆约 53%，并声明方法学（文本匹配优先/LLM 判官兜底，1,153 个正确答案中 950 即 82.4% 由文本匹配给出）不完全可比。附录实验：记忆密度曲线显示 0 条 69.3 → 3 条 86.0（相对 +24%）→ 7 条 88.0 后饱和，20/30 条不增反微降；渐进式交付总 token 31,167→15,484（节省 50.3%），重入型步骤节省 50–90%、跨新领域步骤节省 0%；写侧去重在 5 个重叠源下存 33 条唯一记忆、跳过 162 条重复（83.1% 去重率）且零假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心论断是：企业级多智能体系统需要一层超越 RAG 与单智能体记忆原语的「受治理记忆」基础设施；治理与 Schema 强制本身不构成检索质量税——在生产 API 上以合成基准与外部 LoCoMo 双重验证，74.8% 总体准确率、100% 对抗治理合规、零跨实体泄漏、99.6% 事实召回、约 7 条治理记忆/实体的质量饱和点，构成了智能体部署的实用操作基准。论文同时提出「治理记忆、治理路由、渐进式交付、记忆质量门、Schema 生命周期管理」等术语作为生产记忆系统社区的参照概念。作者明确承认局限：质量门为模式启发式而非深层语义分析，自评存在 LLM-as-judge 偏差，去重阈值为经验调参，脱敏为正则覆盖，E14 仅验证时序冲突而未验证多智能体并发写入冲突（列为开放问题）；设计张力包括开放集与 Schema 的重叠是刻意保留、反思收益受应用层查询策略主导（API 托管反思 +3.3pp vs 手动多跳 +25.7pp）、24 小时会话 TTL 不能完全消除陈旧风险；未来工作包括跨组织验证与并发写冲突检测、自动 Schema 扩展、语义+关键词+RRF 的混合检索、以及基于 Transformer NER 的机器学习增强脱敏。伦理方面提示记忆累积形成人物画像带来的 GDPR/CCPA 与数据主体权利责任，以及模型与运营者定义 Schema 共同引入的偏见风险，治理层的作用在于把组织策略变成显式可审计工件。

title: Draft-and-Prune: Improving the Reliability of Auto-formalization for Logical Reasoning
summary: Auto-formalization (AF) translates natural-language reasoning problems into solver-executable programs, enabling symbolic solvers to perform sound logical deduction. In practice, however, AF pipelines are currently brittle: programs may fail to execute, or execute but encode incorrect semantics. While prior work largely mitigates syntactic failures via repairs based on solver feedback, reducing semantics failures remains a major bottleneck. We propose Draft-and-Prune (D&P), an inference-time framework that improves AF-based logical reasoning via diversity and verification. D&P first drafts multiple natural-language plans and conditions program generation on them. It further prunes executable but contradictory or ambiguous formalizations, and aggregates predictions from surviving paths via majority voting. Across four representative benchmarks (AR-LSAT, ProofWriter, PrOntoQA, LogicalDeduction), D&P substantially strengthens AF-based reasoning without extra supervision. On AR-LSAT, in the AF-only setting, D&P achieves 78.43% accuracy with GPT-4 and 78.00% accuracy with GPT-4o, significantly outperforming the strongest AF baselines MAD-LOGIC and CLOVER. D&P then attains near-ceiling performance on the other benchmarks, including 100% on PrOntoQA and LogicalDeduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D&P框架，通过多样化草拟和剪枝策略提升自动形式化逻辑推理性能，在四个基准上取得显著提升，无需额外监督。
AI.motivation: 当前自动形式化(AF)管道脆弱：程序可能执行失败或编码错误的语义。先前工作主要通过基于求解器反馈的修复来减轻句法失败，但减少语义失败仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Draft-and-Prune(D&P)框架，包含：(1)基于多个自然语言计划草拟程序并约束程序生成；(2)修剪可执行但矛盾或模糊的形式化；(3)通过多数投票聚合幸存路径的预测。
AI.result: 在AR-LSAT上，使用GPT-4达到78.43%准确率，使用GPT-4o达到78.00%准确率，显著优于最强基线MAD-LOGIC和CLOVER；在其他基准上接近天花板性能，PrOntoQA和LogicalDeduction达到100%。
AI.conclusion: D&P框架通过多样性和验证机制显著提升了基于自动形式化的逻辑推理性能，在AR-LSAT上超越MAD-LOGIC和CLOVER，在PrOntoQA和LogicalDeduction上达到接近完美的准确率，且无需额外监督。

title: Formal verification of tree-based machine learning models for lateral spreading
summary: Machine learning models for geotechnical hazard prediction can achieve high accuracy while learning physically inconsistent relationships from sparse or biased training data. Current remedies (post-hoc explainability, such as SHAP and LIME, and training-time constraints) either diagnose individual predictions approximately or restrict model capacity without providing exhaustive guarantees. This paper encodes trained tree ensembles as logical formulas in a Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solver and checks physical specifications across the entire input domain, not just sampled points. Four geotechnical specifications (water table depth, PGA monotonicity, distance safety, and flat-ground safety) are formalized as decidable logical formulas and verified via SMT against both XGBoost ensembles and Explainable Boosting Machines (EBMs) trained on the 2011 Christchurch earthquake lateral spreading dataset (7,291 sites, four features). The SMT solver either produces a concrete counterexample where a specification fails or proves that no violation exists. The unconstrained EBM (80.1% accuracy) violates all four specifications. A fully constrained EBM (67.2%) satisfies three of four specifications, demonstrating that iterative constraint application guided by verification can progressively improve physical consistency. A Pareto analysis of 33 model variants reveals a persistent trade-off, as none of the variants studied achieve both greater than 80% accuracy and full compliance with the specified set. SHAP analysis of specification counterexamples shows that the offending feature can rank last, demonstrating that post-hoc explanations do not substitute for formal verification. These results establish a verify-fix-verify engineering loop and a formal certification for deploying physically consistent ML models in safety-critical geotechnical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将SMT（可满足性模理论）形式化验证引入岩土工程机器学习：把训练好的树集成（XGBoost、EBM）编码为Z3求解器中的嵌套ITE逻辑公式，在整个输入域（而非采样点）上对四条岩土物理规格（地下水埋深、PGA单调性、距离安全、平地安全）做可判定判定，求解器要么给出具体反例，要么证明无违例。2011年基督城侧向扩展数据集（7,291样本、4特征）上：无约束XGBoost（82.5%）、无约束EBM（80.1%）均违反全部四条规格；单调约束XGBoost（69.3%）仅修复B；全约束EBM（67.2%）满足B、C、D，A仍以极小幅度被违反。33个变体的Pareto分析显示：无一模型能同时做到精度>80%且完全合规，存在10–15个百分点的稳定精度代价；SHAP将违规特征排在最后，说明事后解释不能替代形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 侧向扩展（lateral spreading）预测的ML模型在稀疏/偏置的岩土数据上可学到与物理规律矛盾的映射：Hsiao等发现XGBoost在部分区域给出"随PGA增大侧向扩展概率反而下降"的非物理关系，却仍有约84%精度，且错误恰好集中在最需要可靠预测的数据稀疏区。现有补救手段均有硬缺陷：(1) SHAP/LIME等事后解释是近似的——Huang和Marques-Silva已证明SHAP可给无关特征非零重要度、给相关特征零重要度，它只能"提示"失效而不能"认证"失效；(2) 训练期单调约束逐特征生效，无法表达复合条件（如"远离自由面且弱震动不应预测高风险"），也无法给出全域满足性证明。Maurer和Sanger对75篇液化AI文献的综述也指出该领域缺乏穷尽性的模型保障工具。作者的目标是提供一个与训练方式无关的"模型审计"环节——在部署前确定训练好的模型是否满足指定物理一致性条件。
AI.method: 1）规格形式化：将输入x=(g,ℓ,s,p)（GWD、自由面距离L、坡度、PGA）记为logit输出f(x)，预测类为1[f(x)>0]。四条全称一阶规格定义在有界域X=[0.37,6.05]×[0,3.29]×[0,10.5]×[0.33,0.57]上：A 为 g>5.0⇒f≤0（依据Geyin等：GWD>3–4 m后液化地表表现可忽略，取保守5 m）；B 为 p1≤p2⇒f(g,ℓ,s,p1)≤f(g,ℓ,s,p2)；C 为 (ℓ>2.5 ∧ p<0.35)⇒f≤0（2.5 km超过已知最大扩展距离，0.35 g低于已确认扩展的最小PGA 0.37 g）；D 为 C 前件再加 s<0.1%，属C的更弱子集，作为诊断项。2）SMT编码：递归解析XGBoost JSON树转储，每棵树编码为ITE表达式（split形如x_j<θ），集成logit为β0+Σ h_t(x)；100树×depth5产生2380个叶项。EBM则将单变量形状函数编码为按bin边界的ITE链（4043 bins合并至约2900节点），成对交互编码为二维嵌套ITE（约23400节点）。关键实现细节：base score β0须单独计入，否则所有logit产生常数偏移；XGBoost用32位浮点而SMT用精确算术，故阈值与特征一律cast为float32以防精度失配；所有反例均回代真实模型核验logit完全一致。3）判定流程：断言规格的否定式，¬(∀x:P(x))≡∃x:¬P(x)；内联ITE后得到4个自由实变量的QF_LRA公式（带域约束），用Z3判定sat（给出反例）/unsat（证明成立）；QF_LRA判定过程完备，求解必然终止。A/C/D单次查询通常<5 s（EBM的C查询需专用QF_LRA求解器，1331 s）。4）单调性加速：提出命题1（加性分解），若加性模型每个分量对x_j单调非减则整体单调非减，据此把集成单调性化为T个独立单树查询（每查询<1 s，100树共0.6 s），对比直接双份集成编码的480 s；EBM用逐项score数组分解。5）verify-fix-verify循环：训练→形式化验证取反例→反例诊断→施加定向单调约束→重新验证；并计算形式化溯因解释（最小充分特征子集）以与SHAP top-k对比。6）Pareto分析：XGBoost深度{3,5,7,9}×估计器{20,50,100}共24变体，EBM交互项{0,3,5,10}共9变体，合计33个模型变体，用120条PGA扫描剖面的规格B经验合规率作代理指标。7）基线对照：每特征均匀网格搜索（n=30至200，总计最高16亿次评估）检测规格C/D违例。
AI.result: 无约束XGBoost（d=5,n=100，测试精度82.5%，10折CV 83.2±1.4%）四条规格全部被违反，A反例为GWD=5.001 m、logit +0.065（52%），B反例显示PGA由0.42升至0.52 g使logit下降0.15，C反例为L=2.501 km、PGA=0.33 g、logit +0.169（54%），D反例斜率0.05%。单调约束XGBoost（GWD−、L−、PGA+，69.3%）修复B，但A/C/D仍sat，A反例logit升至+0.221。无约束EBM（80.1%）同样违反全部四条，A反例logit高达+1.68（84%），PGA形状函数存在272个非单调段，C查询耗时1331 s；仅约束PGA的EBM（70.5%）修复B但A仍违反（logit +0.14）。全约束EBM（67.2%，代价12.9 pp）为合规度最高者：B/C/D均被证明成立，A仍以极薄幅度被违反（GWD=5.003 m、L=0.003 km、坡度2.5%、PGA=0.46 g，概率50.3%，logit仅+0.012），原因是单调性只约束效应"方向"而非输出"绝对阈值"。网格对照极具说服力：n=200（16亿次评估，184 s）未发现任何规格C违例，而SMT 0.19 s即给出反例——违规区为L∈[2.500,2.505] km、坡度<0.05%的比网格步长更薄的窄缝。Pareto分析：无约束族精度74.0–84.2%但B合规率0%；约束族68.3–70.5%且100%合规；无一变体同时达到>80%精度与完全合规，10–15 pp的差距在所有族与超参下持续存在。SHAP对比：在规格A反例（GWD=5.65 m，预测91%，logit +2.31）中，SHAP给出L +1.67、PGA +0.61、坡度 +0.52、GWD仅−0.12，把真正的违规特征GWD排到第4位，工程师据此会认为预测合理；PGA依赖图也显示0.42–0.52 g区间SHAP值骤降，证实形式化验证发现的非单调性。阈值敏感性显示无约束模型在3.0–6.0 m各水位阈值下均违反规格A。
AI.conclusion: 形式化验证与训练期约束是互补关系：约束缩小假设空间，验证审计已训练模型并判定约束是否足够；仅施加约束而不做验证，A、C、D的残余违例将永远无法被发现。由此建立的verify-fix-verify工程循环使物理一致性成为"被证明"而非"被假设"的属性，为安全关键岩土ML的部署前形式化认证提供了方法基础与可量化的精度代价基准（10–15 pp）。作者明确界定结论边界：四条规格是必要条件而非充分条件，合规模型仍可能在规格集之外学到非物理模式；确定性保证针对模型而非物理系统本身，不回答模型是否正确预测真实灾害；阈值（如5 m、2.5 km、0.35 g）是Christchurch场地特定工程界限，迁移到其他场地必须重新标定；方法仅适用于树模型，神经网络需MILP编码且代价更高；D维数增加时需借助抽象/数据感知验证等可扩展性技术。作者强调本文贡献是方法论的工作流而非新的预测器，未来的扩展方向包括反例引导的数据增强、事后输出截断、与共形预测等概率校准结合，以及将框架推广到预测位移幅值的回归模型与更丰富的CPT-based液化判据规格库。代码与模型开源（github.com/geoelements-dev/2026-formal-verify-liq）。

title: Revisiting Vulnerability Patch Identification on Data in the Wild
summary: Attacks can exploit zero-day or one-day vulnerabilities that are not publicly disclosed. To detect these vulnerabilities, security researchers monitor development activities in open-source repositories to identify unreported security patches. The sheer volume of commits makes this task infeasible to accomplish manually. Consequently, security patch detectors commonly trained and evaluated on security patches linked from vulnerability reports in the National Vulnerability Database (NVD). In this study, we assess the effectiveness of these detectors when applied in-the-wild. Our results show that models trained on NVD-derived data show substantially decreased performance, with decreases in F1-score of up to 90\% when tested on in-the-wild security patches, rendering them impractical for real-world use. An analysis comparing security patches identified in-the-wild and commits linked from NVD reveals that they can be easily distinguished from each other. Security patches associated with NVD have different distribution of commit messages, vulnerability types, and composition of changes. These differences suggest that NVD may be unsuitable as the \textit{sole} source of data for training models to detect security patches. We find that constructing a dataset that combines security patches from NVD data with a small subset of manually identified security patches can improve model robustness.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了基于NVD（国家漏洞数据库）训练的安全补丁检测器在真实环境中的有效性。结果显示，这些模型在测试野外安全补丁时，F1分数下降高达90%，表明NVD数据作为唯一的训练来源存在局限性。NVD关联的安全补丁与野外发现的补丁在提交信息、漏洞类型和变更组成上存在显著差异。通过将NVD数据与少量手动识别的安全补丁结合，可提高模型的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 安全研究人员需要通过监控开源仓库中的开发活动来识别未公开披露的安全补丁，以检测零日和一 day漏洞。由于提交量巨大，人工检测不可行。当前安全补丁检测器通常使用NVD中漏洞报告关联的安全补丁进行训练和评估，但这些模型在真实环境中的有效性尚未得到验证。
AI.method: 1. 使用NVD衍生的数据训练安全补丁检测模型；2. 在野外安全补丁上测试这些模型的性能；3. 对比分析NVD关联补丁与野外发现补丁的特征差异（提交信息、漏洞类型、变更组成）；4. 测试将NVD数据与少量手动识别的安全补丁结合构建数据集的效果。
AI.result: 在野外安全补丁上测试时，模型性能显著下降，F1分数下降高达90%。NVD关联的补丁与野外发现的补丁在分布上存在明显差异：提交信息、漏洞类型和变更组成均不同。构建结合NVD数据与少量手动识别安全补丁的数据集可提高模型鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: NVD作为安全补丁检测模型训练的唯一数据来源可能是不合适的。混合使用NVD数据与手动识别的安全补丁可以提高模型在真实环境中的检测性能，使其更适用于实际应用。

title: Graph-Native Cognitive Memory for AI Agents: Formal Belief Revision Semantics for Versioned Memory Architectures
summary: While individual components for AI agent memory exist in prior systems, their architectural synthesis and formal grounding remain underexplored. We present Kumiho, a graph-native cognitive memory architecture grounded in formal belief revision semantics. The structural primitives required for cognitive memory -- immutable revisions, mutable tag pointers, typed dependency edges, URI-based addressing -- are identical to those required for managing agent-produced work as versionable assets, enabling a unified graph-native architecture that serves both purposes. The central formal contribution is a correspondence between the AGM belief revision framework and the operational semantics of a property graph memory system, proving satisfaction of the basic AGM postulates (K*2--K*6) and Hansson's belief base postulates (Relevance, Core-Retainment). The architecture implements a dual-store model (Redis working memory, Neo4j long-term graph) with hybrid fulltext and vector retrieval. On LoCoMo (token-level F1), Kumiho achieves 0.565 overall F1 (n=1,986) including 97.5% adversarial refusal accuracy. On LoCoMo-Plus, a Level-2 cognitive memory benchmark testing implicit constraint recall, Kumiho achieves 93.3% judge accuracy (n=401); independent reproduction by the benchmark authors yielded results in the mid-80% range, still substantially outperforming all published baselines (best: Gemini 2.5 Pro, 45.7%). Three architectural innovations drive the results: prospective indexing (LLM-generated future-scenario implications indexed at write time), event extraction (structured causal events preserved in summaries), and client-side LLM reranking. The architecture is model-decoupled: switching the answer model from GPT-4o-mini (~88%) to GPT-4o (93.3%) improves end-to-end accuracy without pipeline changes, at a total evaluation cost of ~$14 for 401 entries.

AI.tldr: Kumiho是一个基于形式化信念修正语义（AGM框架）的图原生认知记忆架构，将认知记忆与版本化资产管理统一于图结构中。在LoCoMo基准上达到0.565整体F1（n=1,986），在LoCoMo-Plus上达到93.3%准确率（n=401），显著优于所有已发布基线。
AI.motivation: AI智能体记忆的各个组件虽已存在于先前系统中，但其架构整合与形式化基础尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1.形式化框架：建立AGM信念修正框架与属性图内存系统操作语义之间的对应关系，验证K*2-K*6基本AGM公设和Hansson信念库公设（相关性、核心保留）的满足性；2.架构实现：双存储模型（Redis工作记忆+Neo4j长期图），混合全文和向量检索；3.三项创新：预期索引（LLM生成的未来场景含义在写入时索引）、事件提取（摘要中保留结构化因果事件）、客户端LLM重排序
AI.result: LoCoMo基准：token级F1达0.565（n=1,986），对抗性拒绝准确率97.5%；LoCoMo-Plus基准：判断准确率93.3%（n=401），基准作者独立复现结果在80%中期范围，仍显著优于所有已发布基线（最佳：Gemini 2.5 Pro，45.7%）。模型解耦效果：从GPT-4o-mini（~88%）切换到GPT-4o（93.3%）无需改变管道，401条目的评估成本约14美元
AI.conclusion: 通过将AGM信念修正框架形式化并采用图原生设计，Kumiho在认知记忆基准上实现了最先进性能，证明了形式化语义与工程架构结合的有效性，且架构与模型解耦，可灵活切换底层LLM

title: Integrating Inductive Biases in Transformers via Distillation for Financial Time Series Forecasting
summary: Transformer-based models have been widely adopted for time-series forecasting due to their high representational capacity and architectural flexibility. However, many Transformer variants implicitly assume stationarity and stable temporal dynamics -- assumptions routinely violated in financial markets characterized by regime shifts and non-stationarity. Empirically, state-of-the-art time-series Transformers often underperform even vanilla Transformers on financial tasks, while simpler architectures with distinct inductive biases, such as CNNs and RNNs, can achieve stronger performance with substantially lower complexity. At the same time, no single inductive bias dominates across markets or regimes, suggesting that robust financial forecasting requires integrating complementary temporal priors. We propose TIPS (Transformer with Inductive Prior Synthesis), a knowledge distillation framework that synthesizes diverse inductive biases -- causality, locality, and periodicity -- within a unified Transformer. TIPS trains bias-specialized Transformer teachers via attention masking, then distills their knowledge into a single student model with regime-dependent alignment across inductive biases. Across four major equity markets, TIPS achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming strong ensemble baselines by 55%, 9%, and 16% in annual return, Sharpe ratio, and Calmar ratio, while requiring only 38% of the inference-time computation. Further analyses show that TIPS generates statistically significant excess returns beyond both vanilla Transformers and its teacher ensembles, and exhibits regime-dependent behavioral alignment with classical architectures during their profitable periods. These results highlight the importance of regime-dependent inductive bias utilization for robust generalization in non-stationary financial time series.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TIPS框架，通过知识蒸馏将因果性、局部性和周期性三种归纳偏置整合到统一Transformer中，解决金融时间序列的非平稳性和regime转换问题，在四大股票市场实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 金融市场的特征是 regime 转换和非平稳性，现有的Transformer变体隐含假设平稳性和稳定的时间动态，这与金融市场实际情况不符。实证表明，最先进的时序Transformer在金融任务上甚至不如 vanilla Transformers，而具有不同归纳偏置的简单架构（如CNN和RNN）可以用更低的复杂度获得更强的性能。没有单一的归纳偏置在所有市场或 regime 下占优，因此需要整合互补的时间先验。
AI.method: TIPS采用知识蒸馏框架，通过注意力掩码训练专门针对不同归纳偏置的Transformer教师模型，然后将知识蒸馏到单一学生模型中，实现跨归纳偏置的 regime-dependent 对齐。
AI.result: TIPS在四个主要股票市场实现了最先进性能，在年化收益、夏普比率和卡玛比率上分别优于强集成基线55%、9%和16%，同时仅需38%的推理时间计算。进一步分析显示，TIPS产生了统计学上显著的超额收益，并展现出与经典架构在它们盈利期间的 regime-dependent 行为对齐。
AI.conclusion: TIPS通过知识蒸馏框架成功将多种归纳偏置整合到单一Transformer模型中，在四个主要股票市场实现了最先进性能。模型展现出与经典架构的 regime-dependent 行为对齐特性，突出了在非平稳金融时间序列中 regime-dependent 归纳偏置利用的重要性。

title: MLmisFinder: A Specification and Detection Approach of Machine Learning Service Misuses
summary: Machine Learning (ML) cloud services, offered by leading providers such as Amazon, Google, and Microsoft, enable the integration of ML components into software systems without building models from scratch. However, the rapid adoption of ML services, coupled with the growing complexity of business requirements, has led to widespread misuses, compromising the quality, maintainability, and evolution of ML service-based systems. Though prior research has studied patterns and antipatterns in service-based and ML-based systems separately, automatic detection of ML service misuses remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose MLmisFinder, an automatic approach to detect ML service misuses in software systems, aiming to identify instances of improper use of ML services to help developers properly integrate ML components in ML service-based systems. We propose a metamodel that captures the data needed to detect misuses in ML service-based systems and apply a set of rule-based detection algorithms for seven misuse types. We evaluated MLmisFinder on 107 software systems collected from open-source GitHub repositories and compared it with a state-of-the-art baseline. Our results show that MLmisFinder effectively detects ML service misuses, achieving an average precision of 96.7\% and recall of 97\%, outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline. MLmisFinder also scaled efficiently to detect misuses across 817 ML service-based systems and revealed that such misuses are widespread, especially in areas such as data drift monitoring and schema validation.

AI.tldr: 提出MLmisFinder，一种自动检测软件系统中ML服务误用的方法，通过元模型和7种基于规则的检测算法识别ML服务的不当使用，在107个GitHub开源系统上验证，精确率达96.7%，召回率达97%，并扩展到817个系统进行大规模分析。
AI.motivation: ML云服务（Amazon、Google、Microsoft等提供）虽便于集成ML组件，但快速采用伴随业务需求复杂性增加，导致ML服务误用广泛出现，损害了ML服务系统的质量、可维护性和演进。虽已有研究分别分析服务型系统和ML型系统中的模式和反模式，但自动检测ML服务误用仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个捕获ML服务系统误用检测所需数据的元模型，应用7种基于规则的检测算法针对7种误用类型进行检测，在从GitHub开源仓库收集的107个软件系统上评估，并与先进基线方法进行比较。
AI.result: MLmisFinder有效检测ML服务误用，平均精确率96.7%，召回率97%，优于先进基线方法。在817个ML服务系统上扩展检测并表现出良好可扩展性，揭示此类误用广泛存在，尤其在数据漂移监控和模式验证领域。
AI.conclusion: MLmisFinder是一种有效的ML服务误用自动检测方法，能够帮助开发者正确集成ML组件，提升ML服务系统的质量和可维护性，为大规模代码库中的ML服务误用检测提供了可行方案。

title: Contrastive Reasoning Alignment: Reinforcement Learning from Hidden Representations
summary: We propose CRAFT, a red-teaming alignment framework that leverages model reasoning capabilities and hidden representations to improve robustness against jailbreak attacks. Unlike prior defenses that operate primarily at the output level, CRAFT aligns large reasoning models to generate safety-aware reasoning traces by explicitly optimizing objectives defined over the hidden state space. Methodologically, CRAFT integrates contrastive representation learning with reinforcement learning to separate safe and unsafe reasoning trajectories, yielding a latent-space geometry that supports robust, reasoning-level safety alignment. Theoretically, we show that incorporating latent-textual consistency into GRPO eliminates superficially aligned policies by ruling them out as local optima. Empirically, we evaluate CRAFT on multiple safety benchmarks using two strong reasoning models, Qwen3-4B-Thinking and R1-Distill-Llama-8B, where it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art defenses such as IPO and SafeKey. Notably, CRAFT delivers an average 79.0% improvement in reasoning safety and 87.7% improvement in final-response safety over the base models, demonstrating the effectiveness of hidden-space reasoning alignment.

AI.tldr: CRAFT是一个红队对抗框架，通过利用模型的推理能力和隐藏表示来提高对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。该方法在隐藏状态空间上优化目标，使大语言模型生成安全感知的推理轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有防御方法主要在输出层面操作，无法从根本上提升模型对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。需要在推理层面进行安全对齐，使模型能够识别和拒绝有害请求。
AI.method: CRAFT结合对比表示学习与强化学习，分离安全和不安全的推理轨迹，构建支持鲁棒推理级安全对齐的潜在空间几何。同时将潜在文本一致性纳入GRPO，消除表面对齐的策略。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Thinking和R1-Distill-Llama-8B两个推理模型上，CRAFT在多个安全基准上优于IPO和SafeKey等先进防御方法。
AI.conclusion: 推理安全平均提升79.0%，最终响应安全平均提升87.7%，证明了隐藏空间推理对齐的有效性。

title: Transformers Can Learn Rules They've Never Seen: Proof of Computation Beyond Interpolation
summary: A central question in the LLM debate is whether transformers can infer rules absent from training, or whether apparent generalisation reduces to similarity-based interpolation over observed examples. We test a strong interpolation-only hypothesis in two controlled settings: one where interpolation is ruled out by construction and proof, and one where success requires emitting intermediate symbolic derivations rather than only final answers. In Experiment 1, we use a cellular automaton with a pure XOR transition rule and remove specific local input patterns from training; since XOR is linearly inseparable, each held-out pattern's nearest neighbours have the opposite label, so similarity-based predictors fail on the held-out region. Yet a two-layer transformer recovers the rule (best 100%; 47/60 converged runs), and circuit extraction identifies XOR computation. Performance depends on multi-step constraint propagation: without unrolling, accuracy matches output bias (63.1%), while soft unrolling reaches 96.7%. In Experiment 2, we study symbolic operator chains over integers with one operator pair held out; the model must emit intermediate steps and a final answer in a proof-like format. Across all 49 holdout pairs, the transformer exceeds every interpolation baseline (mean 41.8%, up to 78.6%; mean KRR 4.3%; KNN and MLP score 0% on every pair), while removing intermediate-step supervision degrades performance. Together with a construction showing that a standard transformer block can implement exact local Boolean rules, these results provide an existence proof that transformers can learn rule structure not directly observed in training and express it explicitly, ruling out the strongest architectural form of interpolation-only accounts: that transformers cannot in principle discover and communicate unseen rules, while leaving open when such behaviour arises in large-scale language training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究transformer是否能推断训练中未出现的规则，而非仅依赖相似性插值。通过两个受控实验测试强插值假说：XOR元胞自动机（实验1）和整数符号运算符链（实验2）。
AI.motivation: LLM争论的核心问题是：transformer能否推断训练中不存在的规则，还是看似泛化仅归结为对观测样本的相似性插值？需要通过受控实验验证强插值假说。
AI.method: 实验1：使用纯XOR转换规则的元胞自动机，从训练中移除特定局部输入模式，由于XOR线性不可分，最近邻标签相反，使相似性预测失败。两层transformer进行多步约束传播（软展开）。实验2：整数符号运算符链，保留一个运算符对，模型需生成中间步骤和最终答案的证明格式。
AI.result: 实验1：最佳100%（47/60次收敛），电路提取识别出XOR计算；无展开准确率仅63.1%（输出偏置），软展开达96.7%。实验2：49个保留运算符对均超过所有插值基线（平均41.8%，最高78.6%；KRR平均4.3%；KNN和MLP均为0%）。移除中间步骤监督后性能下降。
AI.conclusion: Transformer能学习训练中未直接观察到的规则结构并明确表达，否定了最强形式的"插值唯一"解释（认为transformer原则上无法发现和传达未见规则）。但未明确这种行为在大型语言模型训练中的产生条件。

title: Bootstrapping Coding Agents: The Specification Is the Program
summary: A coding agent can bootstrap itself. Starting from a 926-word specification and a first implementation produced by an existing agent (Claude Code), a newly generated agent re-implements the same specification correctly from scratch. This reproduces, in the domain of AI coding agents, the classical bootstrap sequence known from compiler construction, and instantiates the meta-circular property known from Lisp. The result carries a practical implication: the specification, not the implementation, is the stable artifact of record. Improving an agent means improving its specification; the implementation is, in principle, regenerable at any time.

AI.tldr: 研究展示了AI编码智能体的自举能力：基于926词规范，新智能体能从头正确重新实现规范，证明了规范（而非实现）是稳定的记录工件，改进智能体即改进规范。
AI.motivation: 在AI编码智能体领域实现类似编译器构造中的经典自举序列，以及Lisp中已知的元循环特性，证明规范的稳定性而非实现的稳定性。
AI.method: 从926词的规范开始，使用现有智能体（Claude Code）生成第一个实现，然后新生成的智能体从头正确地重新实现相同规范。
AI.result: 新生成的智能体能够从头正确地重新实现相同规范，验证了自举在AI编码智能体领域的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了AI编码智能体的自举能力，证明了规范而非实现才是稳定的记录工件。这为智能体的改进提供了新范式：改进智能体意味着改进其规范，实现可以在任何时候重新生成。

title: InfoDensity: Rewarding Information-Dense Traces for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) with extended reasoning capabilities often generate verbose and redundant reasoning traces, incurring unnecessary computational cost. While existing reinforcement learning approaches address this by optimizing final response length, they neglect the quality of intermediate reasoning steps, leaving models vulnerable to reward hacking. We argue that verbosity is not merely a length problem, but a symptom of poor intermediate reasoning quality. To investigate this, we conduct an empirical study tracking the conditional entropy of the answer distribution across reasoning steps. We find that high-quality reasoning traces exhibit two consistent properties: low uncertainty convergence and monotonic progress. These findings suggest that high-quality reasoning traces are informationally dense, that is, each step contributes meaningful entropy reduction relative to the total reasoning length. Motivated by this, we propose InfoDensity, a reward framework for RL training that combines an AUC-based reward and a monotonicity reward as a unified measure of reasoning quality, weighted by a length scaling term that favors achieving equivalent quality more concisely. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that InfoDensity matches or surpasses state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy while significantly reducing token usage, achieving a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InfoDensity奖励框架，通过结合AUC奖励、单调性奖励和长度缩放项来解决LLM推理过程中的冗长性问题。实验表明该方法在数学推理基准上达到与最先进方法相当或更好的准确率，同时显著减少token使用量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在扩展推理能力时往往生成冗长且重复的推理轨迹，造成不必要的计算成本。现有强化学习方法仅优化最终响应长度，忽视了中间推理步骤的质量。研究者认为冗长性不仅是长度问题，而是中间推理质量差的表现。
AI.method: 通过跟踪推理步骤中答案分布的条件熵进行实证研究，发现高质量推理轨迹具有两个一致属性：低不确定度收敛和单调进展。基于此，提出InfoDensity奖励框架，结合AUC奖励和单调性奖励作为统一的推理质量度量，并使用长度缩放项优先考虑更简洁地达到同等质量。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，InfoDensity在准确率上匹配或超越最先进的基线方法，同时显著减少token使用量，实现了良好的准确率-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: InfoDensity通过关注推理步骤的信息密度有效解决了LLM推理中的冗长性问题，提供了一种平衡准确率和效率的推理质量统一度量方法。

title: Do Understanding and Generation Fight? A Diagnostic Study of DPO for Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models share a language model backbone for both understanding and generating images. Can DPO align both capabilities simultaneously? We present the first systematic study of this question, applying DPO to Janus-Pro at 1B and 7B parameters under seven training strategies and two post-hoc methods. The central finding is negative: generation quality resists DPO alignment across all tested conditions on this architecture. No method improves generation CLIPScore at 7B (|Delta| < 0.2, p > 0.5 at n=200 per seed, 3 seeds); at 1B, all methods degrade generation, and the result holds across preference data types (real-vs-generated and model-vs-model) and the data volumes tested (150-288 pairs). Gradient analysis reveals why: understanding and generation gradients are near-orthogonal (cos ~ 0) with ~11-14x magnitude imbalance driven by VQ token count asymmetry (576 generation tokens vs. ~30-100 text tokens). This imbalance is the dominant interference mechanism in multi-task DPO; magnitude-balancing yields directionally positive understanding deltas (+0.01-0.04 VQA, though individually not significant), but the generation gap persists regardless. We identify discrete VQ tokenization as a likely structural bottleneck -- supported by the generation DPO loss converging to ln(2) -- and provide practical guidance for practitioners working with VQ-based unified models.

AI.tldr: 首次系统研究DPO能否同时对齐统一多模态模型的图像理解和生成能力，对Janus-Pro (1B/7B)进行7种训练策略和2种后验方法测试。核心发现为否定：生成质量在所有测试条件下均抵制DPO对齐。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型使用语言模型backbone同时处理图像理解和生成，但尚不清楚DPO能否同时对齐这两种能力。该研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在Janus-Pro 1B和7B参数规模下实施7种训练策略和2种后验方法，使用真实-vs-生成和模型-vs-模型两种偏好数据类型，数据量150-288对，3个随机种子，每种子200样本进行CLIPScore评估，并进行梯度分析。
AI.result: 7B参数下无方法改善生成CLIPScore (|Delta| < 0.2, p > 0.5)；1B参数下所有方法均导致生成质量下降。梯度分析揭示原因：理解和生成梯度近乎正交(cos ~ 0)且存在11-14倍量级不平衡，由VQ token数量不对称驱动(576生成token vs ~30-100文本token)。量级平衡可改善理解(+0.01-0.04 VQA)但生成差距仍存在。生成DPO损失收敛至ln(2)，表明离散VQtokenization是结构瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: VQ tokenization的不对称性是DPO在统一多模态模型中进行多任务对齐时的主要干扰机制。理解与生成梯度正交且量级失衡使得同时对齐难以实现。需要重新设计架构或对齐方法以解决此结构性问题。

title: Requirements Volatility in Software Architecture Design: An Exploratory Case Study
comment: International Conference on Software and System Process 2017
summary: Requirements volatility is a major issue in software (SW) development, causing problems such as project delays and cost overruns. Even though there is a considerable amount of research related to requirement volatility, the majority of it is inclined toward project management aspects. The relationship between SW architecture design and requirements volatility has not been researched widely, even though changing requirements may for example lead to higher defect density during testing. An exploratory case study was conducted to study how requirements volatility affects SW architecture design. Fifteen semi-structured, thematic interviews were conducted in the case company, which provides the selection of software products for business customers and consumers. The research revealed the factors, such as requirements uncertainty and dynamic business environment, causing requirements volatility in the case company. The study identified the challenges that requirements volatility posed to SW architecture design, including scheduling and architectural technical debt. In addition, this study discusses means of mitigating the factors that cause requirements volatility and addressing the challenges posed by requirements volatility. SW architects are strongly influenced by requirement volatility. Thus understanding the factors causing requirements volatility as well as means to mitigate the challenges has high industrial relevance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过案例研究探讨需求波动性对软件架构设计的影响，发现需求不确定性、动态商业环境等导致需求波动的因素，以及调度延迟和架构技术债务等挑战，并提出相应的缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 软件需求波动是软件开发中的主要问题，导致项目延迟和成本超支。现有研究多关注项目管理方面，而需求波动与软件架构设计之间的关系缺乏深入研究，特别是需求变化可能导致测试期间缺陷密度增加等问题。
AI.method: 在一家为企业和消费者提供软件产品的公司进行了探索性案例研究，采用半结构化主题访谈方式，共进行了15次访谈。
AI.result: 研究揭示了导致需求波动的因素（需求不确定性、动态商业环境等）；识别了需求波动对软件架构设计带来的挑战，包括调度问题和架构技术债务；并讨论了缓解需求波动因素和应对相关挑战的方法。
AI.conclusion: 软件架构设计师强烈受到需求波动的影响。因此，理解导致需求波动的因素以及缓解相关挑战的方法具有重要的工业相关性，有助于提升软件项目的成功率和降低风险。

title: Physics-informed offline reinforcement learning eliminates catastrophic fuel waste in maritime routing
summary: International shipping produces approximately 3% of global greenhouse gas emissions, yet voyage routing remains dominated by heuristic methods. We present PIER (Physics-Informed, Energy-efficient, Risk-aware routing), an offline reinforcement learning framework that learns fuel-efficient, safety-aware routing policies from physics-calibrated environments grounded in historical vessel tracking data and ocean reanalysis products, requiring no online simulator. Validated on one full year (2023) of AIS data across seven Gulf of Mexico routes (840 episodes per method), PIER reduces mean CO2 emissions by 10% relative to great-circle routing. However, PIER's primary contribution is eliminating catastrophic fuel waste: great-circle routing incurs extreme fuel consumption (>1.5x median) in 4.8% of voyages; PIER reduces this to 0.5%, a 9-fold reduction. Per-voyage fuel variance is 3.5x lower (p<0.001), with bootstrap 95% CI for mean savings [2.9%, 15.7%]. Partial validation against observed AIS vessel behavior confirms consistency with the fastest real transits while exhibiting 23.1x lower variance. Crucially, PIER is forecast-independent: unlike A* path optimization whose wave protection degrades 4.5x under realistic forecast uncertainty, PIER maintains constant performance using only local observations. The framework combines physics-informed state construction, demonstration-augmented offline data, and a decoupled post-hoc safety shield, an architecture that transfers to wildfire evacuation, aircraft trajectory optimization, and autonomous navigation in unmapped terrain.

AI.tldr: PIER是一个基于离线强化学习的船舶航路规划框架,结合物理信息状态构建、演示增强的离线数据和解耦的post-hoc安全护盾,在墨西哥湾7条航线的840个回合中实现平均CO2排放减少10%,极端燃料浪费减少9倍,且具有Forecast-independent特性。
AI.motivation: 国际航运产生约3%的全球温室气体排放,但航路规划仍以启发式方法为主,需要更节能、安全的规划方法。
AI.method: PIER框架包含三个核心组件:1)物理信息状态构建,基于历史船舶跟踪数据和海洋再分析产品构建物理校准的环境;2)演示增强的离线数据;3)解耦的post-hoc安全护盾。该方法无需在线模拟器即可学习节能且安全的航路策略。
AI.result: 在墨西哥湾7条航线的2023年全年AIS数据上验证(每种方法840个回合),PIER相对大圆航线减少平均CO2排放10%;极端燃料消耗(>1.5x中位数)从4.8%降至0.5%,减少9倍;每航次燃料方差降低3.5倍(p<0.001),平均节省的bootstrap 95%置信区间为[2.9%, 15.7%]。与实际AIS船舶行为对比,PIER与最快实际过境一致但方差低23.1倍。PIER具有forecast-independent特性,而A*路径优化在现实预报不确定性下波保护降级4.5倍。
AI.conclusion: PIER成功实现了显著的环境和经济效益,其架构可迁移至野火疏散、飞机轨迹优化和未地形域的自主导航等应用领域。

title: SCE-LITE-HQ: Smooth visual counterfactual explanations with generative foundation models
summary: Modern neural networks achieve strong performance but remain difficult to interpret in high-dimensional visual domains. Counterfactual explanations (CFEs) provide a principled approach to interpreting black-box predictions by identifying minimal input changes that alter model outputs. However, existing CFE methods often rely on dataset-specific generative models and incur substantial computational cost, limiting their scalability to high-resolution data. We propose SCE-LITE-HQ, a scalable framework for counterfactual generation that leverages pretrained generative foundation models without task-specific retraining. The method operates in the latent space of the generator, incorporates smoothed gradients to improve optimization stability, and applies mask-based diversification to promote realistic and structurally diverse counterfactuals. We evaluate SCE-LITE-HQ on natural and medical datasets using a desiderata-driven evaluation protocol. Results show that SCE-LITE-HQ produces valid, realistic, and diverse counterfactuals competitive with or outperforming existing baselines, while avoiding the overhead of training dedicated generative models.

AI.tldr: SCE-LITE-HQ是一个利用预训练生成基础模型的可扩展counterfactual解释框架，通过潜在空间操作、平滑梯度和掩码多样化技术，在无需任务特定再训练的情况下生成高质量解释。
AI.motivation: 现有counterfactual解释方法存在两个主要局限：(1)依赖数据集特定的生成模型，泛化性差；(2)计算成本高，难以扩展到高分辨率数据。需要一种可扩展的、能够利用预训练模型的解释框架。
AI.method: 该方法利用预训练生成基础模型的潜在空间进行操作，引入平滑梯度以提高优化稳定性，并应用基于掩码的多样化策略来生成真实且结构多样的counterfactuals。具体包括：在生成器的潜在空间中执行优化、采用平滑梯度技术、结合掩码机制实现多样化。
AI.result: SCE-LITE-HQ在自然和医学数据集上生成了有效的、真实的、多样的counterfactuals，性能与现有基线方法相当或更优，同时避免了训练专用生成模型的开销。
AI.conclusion: SCE-LITE-HQ成功实现了一个无需任务特定再训练的、可扩展的counterfactual生成框架，在自然和医学数据集上生成有效、真实、多样的解释，且性能优于或持平现有基线方法，同时避免了训练专用生成模型的开销。

title: From Symbol to Meaning: Ontological and Philosophical Reflections on Large Language Models in Information Systems Engineering
comment: This paper constitutes a substantially extended version of a conference article to be published in the proceedings of the International Conference on Enterprise Information Systems ICEIS 2026
summary: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) represents a turning point in the theoretical foundations of Information Systems Engineering. Beyond their technical significance, LLMs challenge the ontological, epistemological, and semiotic assumptions that have long structured our understanding of in-formation, representation, and knowledge. This article proposes an integrative reflection on how LLMs reconfigure the relationships among language, meaning, and system design, suggesting that their emergence demands a re-examination of the conceptual foundations of contemporary information systems. Sketching on philosophical traditions from Peirce to Heidegger and Floridi, we investigate how the logic of generative models both extends and destabilises classical notions of ontology and signification. The discussion emphasises the necessity of grounding LLM-based systems in transparent, ethically coherent frameworks that respect the integrity of human-centred knowledge processes. Ultimately, the paper argues that LLMs should be understood not merely as tools for automation but as epistemic agents that reshape the philosophical and semiotic foundations of information systems engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了大语言模型(LLM)如何重塑信息系统工程的哲学与符号学基础,认为LLM不仅是自动化工具,而是重新定义语言、意义与系统设计关系的认知主体。
AI.motivation: LLM的出现挑战了信息系统中关于信息、表示和知识的本体论、认识论和符号学假设,迫使学界重新审视当代信息系统的概念基础。
AI.method: 整合皮尔斯、海德格尔和弗洛里迪的哲学传统,分析生成模型的逻辑如何延伸并动摇经典的本体论和符号意义概念。
AI.result: LLM扩展了 ontology 和 signification 的经典概念,同时带来存在性 destabilisation;需要构建透明、伦理一致的框架以维护人类中心知识过程的完整性。
AI.conclusion: LLM应被理解为不仅仅是自动化工具,而是重塑信息系统工程哲学与符号学基础的认知 agents,需要在伦理框架内谨慎发展。

title: ShuttleEnv: An Interactive Data-Driven RL Environment for Badminton Strategy Modeling
summary: We present ShuttleEnv, an interactive and data-driven simulation environment for badminton, designed to support reinforcement learning and strategic behavior analysis in fast-paced adversarial sports. The environment is grounded in elite-player match data and employs explicit probabilistic models to simulate rally-level dynamics, enabling realistic and interpretable agent-opponent interactions without relying on physics-based simulation. In this demonstration, we showcase multiple trained agents within ShuttleEnv and provide live, step-by-step visualization of badminton rallies, allowing attendees to explore different play styles, observe emergent strategies, and interactively analyze decision-making behaviors. ShuttleEnv serves as a reusable platform for research, visualization, and demonstration of intelligent agents in sports AI. Our ShuttleEnv demo video URL: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hTR4P16U27H2O0-w316bR73pxE2ucczX/view

AI.tldr: ShuttleEnv是一个基于精英球员比赛数据的羽毛球交互式仿真环境，支持强化学习和策略行为分析，无需物理引擎即可实现逼真、可解释的智能体对抗交互。
AI.motivation: 当前羽毛球运动AI研究缺乏专门的数据驱动仿真平台，传统物理模拟方法缺乏真实比赛数据的支撑，难以捕捉专业球员的实际战术模式和决策行为。
AI.method: 基于精英球员比赛数据构建明确的概率模型来模拟回合级动态，采用数据驱动而非物理引擎的仿真方式，实现真实且可解释的智能体-对手交互。
AI.result: 成功构建了ShuttleEnv平台，展示了多个训练好的智能体，提供实时逐步可视化回放，允许用户探索不同打法风格、观察 emergent 策略并交互分析决策行为。
AI.conclusion: ShuttleEnv可作为体育AI领域研究、可视化和智能体演示的可重用平台，为羽毛球及其他对抗性体育的AI研究提供新的技术基础。

title: Early Quantization Shrinks Codebook: A Simple Fix for Diversity-Preserving Tokenization
summary: Vector quantization is a technique in machine learning that discretizes continuous representations into a set of discrete vectors. It is widely employed in tokenizing data representations for large language models, diffusion models, and other generative models. Despite its prevalence, the characteristics and behaviors of vector quantization in generative models remain largely underexplored. In this study, we systematically investigate the issue of collapses in vector quantization, where collapsed representations are observed across discrete codebook tokens and continuous latent embeddings. By leveraging both synthetic and real datasets, we identify the severity of each type of collapses and triggering conditions. Our analysis reveals that random initialization and limited encoder capacity result in tokens collapse and embeddings collapse. Building on these findings, we propose potential solutions aimed at mitigating each collapse. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive study examining representation collapsing problems in vector quantization.

AI.tldr: 首次全面研究向量量化中表示崩溃问题，揭示了token崩溃和embeddings崩溃两种类型，发现随机初始化和有限编码器容量是触发条件，并提出潜在解决方案。
AI.motivation: 向量量化在大型语言模型、扩散模型等生成模型中广泛用于标记化数据表示，但其特征和行为在生成模型中仍缺乏充分探索，特别是崩溃问题。
AI.method: 使用合成数据集和真实数据集系统调查向量量化中的崩溃问题，识别每种崩溃类型的严重程度和触发条件。
AI.result: 发现随机初始化和有限编码器容量导致token崩溃和embeddings崩溃，并确定了两种崩溃类型的严重程度和触发条件。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个全面研究向量量化中表示崩溃问题的论文，为理解和缓解向量量化崩溃提供了理论基础和实践指导。

title: CodeT5-RNN: Reinforcing Contextual Embeddings for Enhanced Code Comprehension
summary: Contextual embeddings generated by LLMs exhibit strong positional inductive biases, which can limit their ability to fully capture long-range, order-sensitive dependencies in highly structured source code. Consequently, how to further refine and enhance LLM embeddings for improved code understanding remains an open research question. To address this gap, we propose a hybrid LLM-RNN framework that reinforces LLM-generated contextual embeddings with a sequential RNN architecture. The embeddings reprocessing step aims to reinforce sequential semantics and strengthen order-aware dependencies inherent in source code. We evaluate the proposed hybrid models on both benchmark and real-world coding datasets. The experimental results show that the RoBERTa-BiGRU and CodeBERT-GRU models achieved accuracies of 66.40% and 66.03%, respectively, on the defect detection benchmark dataset, representing improvements of approximately 5.35% and 3.95% over the standalone RoBERTa and CodeBERT models. Furthermore, the CodeT5-GRU and CodeT5+-BiGRU models achieved accuracies of 67.90% and 67.79%, respectively, surpassing their base models and outperforming RoBERTa-BiGRU and CodeBERT-GRU by a notable margin. In addition, CodeT5-GRU model attains weighted and macro F1-scores of 67.18% and 67.00%, respectively, on the same dataset. Extensive experiments across three real-world datasets further demonstrate consistent and statistically significant improvements over standalone LLMs. Overall, our findings indicate that reprocessing contextual embeddings with RNN architectures enhances code understanding performance in LLM-based models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合LLM-RNN框架，通过将RNN架构（GRU/BiGRU）与LLM生成的上下文嵌入相结合，来增强代码理解能力。该方法在缺陷检测基准数据集上准确率达到67.90%，相比 standalone LLM模型提升了约5.35%。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的上下文嵌入存在位置归纳偏置，限制了其捕获源代码中长距离、对顺序敏感依赖关系的能力。如何进一步优化LLM嵌入以提升代码理解性能仍是一个开放的研究问题。
AI.method: 提出混合LLM-RNN框架，使用RNN架构（GRU/BiGRU）对LLM生成的上下文嵌入进行再处理，以强化顺序语义并增强源代码中的顺序感知依赖关系。测试了RoBERTa-BiGRU、CodeBERT-GRU、CodeT5-GRU、CodeT5+-BiGRU等多种模型组合。
AI.result: 缺陷检测基准数据集结果：RoBERTa-BiGRU达66.40%（↑5.35%），CodeBERT-GRU达66.03%（↑3.95%），CodeT5-GRU达67.90%，CodeT5+-BiGRU达67.79%。CodeT5-GRU的加权F1为67.18%，宏F1为67.00%。三个真实世界数据集上均展现出一致且统计显著的提升。
AI.conclusion: 使用RNN架构对上下文嵌入进行再处理可以增强基于LLM模型的代码理解性能，混合LLM-RNN框架是提升代码理解任务效果的有效方法。

title: A Progressive Visual-Logic-Aligned Framework for Ride-Hailing Adjudication
summary: The efficient adjudication of responsibility disputes is pivotal for maintaining marketplace fairness. However, the exponential surge in ride-hailing volume renders manual review intractable, while conventional automated methods lack the reasoning transparency required for quasi-judicial decisions. Although Multimodal LLMs offer a promising paradigm, they fundamentally struggle to bridge the gap between general visual semantics and rigorous evidentiary protocols, often leading to perceptual hallucinations and logical looseness. To address these systemic misalignments, we introduce RideJudge, a Progressive Visual-Logic-Aligned Framework. Instead of relying on generic pre-training, we bridge the semantic gap via SynTraj, a synthesis engine that grounds abstract liability concepts into concrete trajectory patterns. To resolve the conflict between massive regulation volume and limited context windows, we propose an Adaptive Context Optimization strategy that distills expert knowledge, coupled with a Chain-of-Adjudication mechanism to enforce active evidentiary inquiry. Furthermore, addressing the inadequacy of sparse binary feedback for complex liability assessment, we implement a novel Ordinal-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning mechanism that calibrates decision boundaries against hierarchical severity. Extensive experiments show that our RideJudge-8B achieves 88.41\% accuracy, surpassing 32B-scale baselines and establishing a new standard for interpretable adjudication.

AI.tldr: RideJudge是一个渐进式视觉-逻辑对齐框架，用于解决网约车责任纠纷的自动裁决问题。该框架通过SynTraj合成引擎将抽象责任概念转化为具体轨迹模式，采用自适应上下文优化策略处理监管规则与有限上下文窗口的矛盾，并引入链式裁决机制强化证据询问，最后通过序数敏感强化学习校准决策边界。实验表明RideJudge-8B达到88.41%准确率，超越32B规模基线模型。
AI.motivation: 网约车业务量指数级增长使人工审核变得不可行，传统自动化方法缺乏司法决策所需的推理透明度。多模态大语言模型虽具前景，但在通用视觉语义与严格证据协议之间存在根本性对齐困难，常导致感知幻觉和逻辑松散问题。
AI.method: 提出三项核心技术：(1) SynTraj合成引擎：弥合语义鸿沟，将抽象责任概念 grounding 为具体轨迹模式；(2) 自适应上下文优化+链式裁决机制：蒸馏专家知识解决海量监管规则与有限上下文窗口的矛盾，强制执行主动证据查询；(3) 序数敏感强化学习机制：针对复杂责任评估中稀疏二元反馈的不足，根据层级严重性校准决策边界。
AI.result: RideJudge-8B达到88.41%准确率，超越32B规模基线模型，为可解释裁决建立了新标准。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建了面向网约车责任纠纷的渐进式视觉-逻辑对齐框架，通过多组件协同有效解决了语义对齐、上下文限制和决策校准三大核心挑战，为自动裁决系统的可解释性提供了新范式。

title: PRISM: Demystifying Retention and Interaction in Mid-Training
summary: We present PRISM, a comprehensive empirical study of mid-training design choices for large language models. Through controlled experiments across seven base models spanning four families (Granite, LLaMA, Mistral, Nemotron-H), two architecture types (dense Transformer and attention-Mamba hybrid), and scales from 3B to 24B parameters, we show that mid-training on approximately 27B high-quality tokens yields consistent gains of +15 to +40 points on math, +5 to +12 points on code, and +6 to +13 points on science benchmarks while preserving general performance. The full PRISM to RL pipeline improves macro-average across six reasoning benchmarks from under 12 to 29-42 (a 3-4x improvement), whereas RL applied directly to most of the base models remains substantially less effective, with AIME scores near zero. Data composition matters most at mid-training, not RL: including science data during mid-training unlocks +17 to +28 point GPQA-Diamond gains during RL, while changing the RL mix produces less than 2 point differences. Mechanistically, mid-training densely restructures over 90% of model weights, while RL makes sparse, front-loaded refinements to approximately 5% of parameters. Representation analysis (CKA) confirms that RL consistently preserves mid-training's representational geometry (over 0.998 CKA) across architectures. Crucially, RL applies identical weight changes regardless of starting point, yet only succeeds on mid-trained models, consistent with mid-training placing the model in a configuration from which RL can effectively improve performance. Our results demonstrate that retention-aware mid-training is highly effective for reliable reasoning enhancement and provide practical guidance for designing robust mid-training pipelines.

AI.tldr: PRISM 是一项覆盖 7 个基座模型（4 个家族、稠密 Transformer 与 attention-Mamba 混合架构、3B–24B）的系统性实证研究：在预训练与 RL 之间加入约 270 亿 token 的「中期训练」（mid-training）阶段，可稳定获得数学 +15~40 分、代码 +5~12 分、科学 +6~13 分的提升且基本保持通用能力；中期训练→RL 全流程使六大推理基准宏平均从 12 以下提升至 29–42（3–4 倍）。机制上，中期训练稠密重构 >90% 权重，RL 仅稀疏调整约 5% 参数并保持中期训练建立的表征几何（CKA > 0.998）；数据配比的作用主要发生在中期训练阶段而非 RL 阶段。
AI.motivation: 预训练—对齐的两阶段范式已被「预训练—中期训练—后训练（含 RL）」三阶段取代，但学界对中期训练的若干关键问题缺乏系统答案：应使用什么数据、在何时插入、与下游 RL 如何交互、能否跨架构与规模泛化。已有工作多存在四类局限：(1) 评测狭窄，只报告数学/代码等专项提升，忽视通用能力回归（长上下文扩展类工作只测检索类任务）；(2) 与 RL 的交互缺少受控研究，声称中期训练「有助于 RL」的结论通常局限于小规模单一设置；(3) 未在多家族、多架构、多阶段流水线上做统一评估；(4) 缺乏保留（retention）视角的框架设计。因此需要一个以「保持通用/长上下文能力 + 支撑 RL」为核心的系统性中期训练研究与实用设计指南。
AI.method: 以受控实验为主，分五部分。(1) 数据构建：三类域各配「通用网页」与「领域推理」双源（数学：Nemotron-PT-v1、Megamath-Web-Pro、Open-R1(MoT)；代码：OpenCodeReasoning-2、RefinCode、StarCoder2、Open-R1(MoT)；科学：OpenThoughts3、Open-R1(MoT)），并混入 DCLM-EDU 网页数据与 WildChat-1M/Tulu-3/UltraChat 指令数据以保持通用能力；轻量确定性预处理（DCLM-EDU 质量分 ≥3、OpenCodeReasoning-2 用 QwQ 评判器筛选并抽 6 万 Python + 6 万 C++、GPT-4 生成的 WildChat 对话、问答间单换行拼接）；三档混合比例（Math / Math+Code / Math+Code+Science）。(2) 评测体系：LB-V1/LB-V2 通用榜单 + RULER 长上下文 + LiveCodeBench/Codeforces + AIME24/AIME25/MATH500 + GPQA-Diamond，覆盖 7 个模型（Granite-3.3-8B、Granite-4 Micro 3B、Granite-4-H Micro 3B、Nemotron-H 8B、Mistral-7B、Mistral-Small-24B、LLaMA-3.1-8B）。(3) 设计轴消融：中期训练时机（Phase 3 / Phase 4 / 长上下文扩展后）、域配比、长上下文恢复策略（直接长上下文扩展 vs. 与基座线性合并 15/85，再比较仅训注意力 vs. 全参数）、上下文长度（8k/16k/32k）、token 预算（10.5B–31.5B）。(4) RL 交互：用 GRPO（16 采样/提示、思考格式奖励、KL β=0.05、截断重要性采样、16k 上下文、1000 步），构造非均衡（MC/MCS）与均衡（各域 19k）两套 RL 混合，对比 PRISM→RL 与直接 Base→RL，并在 5×5 权重插值网格上绘制 pass-rate 地形图。(5) 机制分析：逐层归一化 L2 权重散度与更新稀疏度（阈值 0.1%–10% 敏感性）、权重更新向量余弦相似度、线性 CKA 表征对齐（3 模型 × 3 输入分布，bootstrap 20 次）、负对数似然/正确性/长度分析、RL 权重轨迹与活跃参数集演化。
AI.result: 1) 中期训练本身有效：约 270 亿 token 即带来数学 +15~40、代码 +5~12 分，Granite 与混合架构的科学 +6~13 分，通用榜单基本保持（LB-V2 上升，HellaSwag 约 -5、TruthfulQA 小幅下降）。2) 跨家族/架构/规模一致有效：Mistral-7B MATH500 由 1.68→70.71，LLaMA-3.1 AIME24 0.05→16.45，Mistral-Small-24B MATH500 26.92→80.80，混合架构 Nemotron-H 同样显著提升；大模型绝对分更高，小模型相对增益更大。3) 时机：长上下文扩展之后中期训练最优（AIME24 23.59、MATH500 77.44、GPQA 25.93），但仅基于单一 3B 模型且与基座本身强度存在混淆。4) 配比效应：数学数据带来最大单域增益（Math Avg 8.95→36.43），加代码使 Code Avg 2.07→10.71，加科学使 GPQA 19.02→29.12 且不损害其他域。5) 消融：8k 中期训练使 RULER@128k 由 59.09 崩至 6.46，1k 步长上下文扩展可恢复至 38.41（仅训注意力 36.32），「15% 基座 + 85% 中期训练」合并后再扩展最优（42.16，Code 25.54/Math 44.48）；上下文 16k 收益最大、32k 后饱和；token 预算 15B–27B 已近饱和，超过 26B 代码反降。6) RL 交互：中期训练贡献主增益（+13.8~+18.3 AVG），RL 再叠加 +8.4~+12.3，全流程 AVG 由 <12 升至 29–42；直接对基座做 RL 时 AIME24/25 长期接近 0，LLaMA/Mistral 的 GPQA 甚至回退；均衡与非均衡 RL 混合在数学/代码上差异小，但中期训练加入科学数据可在 RL 阶段解锁 +17~+28 的 GPQA 增益（Granite-3.3 达 52.86），而更换 RL 混合仅致 <2 分 AVG 差异；最佳配置因模型而异（MCS+MCS 用于 LLaMA/Mistral，MCS+MC 用于 Granite-3.3）。7) 可解性前沿：RL 持续提升初始不可解代码提示与最难数学提示的通过率，训练曲线数百步后仍不饱和，并在训练后发布的 AIME 2026 上同样提升（33→37%、30→38%）。8) 机制：中期训练稠密改写 >90% 参数（L2 0.112–0.177），RL 仅改 ~5%（L2 0.0003，比值 370–580×），且 RL 的权重足迹与起始点无关（Base→RL 与 MT→RL 各子模块变化率差 ≤1.8 个百分点，V/O 投影最活跃，Mamba A/dt 完全冻结）；MT vs RL 的 CKA > 0.998，Base-MT 与 Base-RL 曲线几乎重合，说明表征重塑全部来自中期训练且其模式随模型而异（Granite 输出层 GSM8K CKA≈0.63、Nemotron-H 深层≈0.41、LLaMA 在 C4 文本上最深）；MC 与 MCS 更新幅度几乎相同但方向余弦相似度仅 0.52/0.62，说明数据配比决定「收敛到何种配置」而非「改变量大小」；权重插值地形图显示从基座→中期训练→RL 单调上升且无障碍；行为上中期训练使输出从 120–452 token 短答扩展到 1,052–2,254 token 推理链并大幅校准负对数似然（0.382→0.138、0.758→0.377），Nemotron-H 在中期训练阶段出现短暂回退（61.6%）后由 RL 恢复至 83.0%；RL 优化前置（前 200–400 步完成大部分权重变化），活跃参数集由 1.5% 渐进增至 5–6%。
AI.conclusion: 中期训练是高效且必要的中间环节：约 270 亿 token 的保留感知（retention-aware）中期训练即可带来 3–4 倍级别的推理能力提升，并为 RL 提供「可被有效优化的权重配置」，这解释了为何 RL 的更新模式与起始点无关却只在中期训练模型上成功。实践指南为：在长上下文扩展之后应用中期训练；采用多域均衡配比（含科学数据），因为配比效应主要发生在中期训练阶段；上下文取 16k、token 预算 15–27B；中期训练后需短程长上下文恢复（合并 + 扩展优于直接扩展）；RL 混合可次要但需含格式奖励与重复惩罚以终止输出。局限与未来方向：RL 提示仅用单一模型（Granite-3.3-8B 中期训练模型）筛选，宜改为模型自适应筛选；域覆盖仅限数学/代码/科学，应扩展至多语言、agentic、工具使用；最大规模 24B，70B+ 待验证；32k+ 长上下文中期训练未探索；中期训练与长上下文预训练的交互在其他设置下可能不同；「中期训练创造有利配置」的因果机制尚未确立。

title: FailureMem: A Failure-Aware Multimodal Framework for Autonomous Software Repair
summary: Multimodal Automated Program Repair (MAPR) extends traditional program repair by requiring models to jointly reason over source code, textual issue descriptions, and visual artifacts such as GUI screenshots. While recent LLM-based repair systems have shown promising results, existing approaches face several limitations: rigid workflow pipelines restrict exploration during debugging, visual reasoning is often performed over full-page screenshots without localized grounding, and failed repair attempts are rarely transformed into reusable knowledge. To address these challenges, we propose FailureMem, a multimodal repair framework that integrates three key mechanisms: a hybrid workflow-agent architecture that balances structured localization with flexible reasoning, active perception tools that enable region-level visual grounding, and a Failure Memory Bank that converts past repair attempts into reusable guidance. Experiments on SWE-bench Multimodal demonstrate FailureMem improves the resolved rate over GUIRepair by 3.7%.

AI.tldr: FailureMem是一个多模态程序修复框架，通过混合工作流-智能体架构、主动感知工具和失败记忆库三大机制，解决了传统方法中工作流僵化、视觉定位粗粒度和失败知识利用不足的问题，在SWE-bench Multimodal上实现3.7%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM修复系统存在三个主要局限：①刚性工作流管道限制调试探索；②视觉推理基于全页面截图缺乏局部锚定；③失败修复尝试很少转化为可重用知识。
AI.method: 提出FailureMem框架，包含三大核心机制：(1)混合工作流-智能体架构，平衡结构化定位与灵活推理；(2)主动感知工具，支持区域级视觉锚定；(3)失败记忆库，将历史修复尝试转化为可重用指导。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Multimodal数据集上，FailureMem相比GUIRepair将修复成功率提升3.7%。
AI.conclusion: FailureMem通过混合工作流-智能体架构、主动感知工具和失败记忆库三个创新机制，有效解决了传统多模态程序修复中的工作流僵化、视觉定位粗粒度和知识利用不足等问题。实验表明该方法在SWE-bench Multimodal上相比GUIRepair提升了3.7%的修复成功率，验证了多模态推理与历史失败知识重用的有效性。

title: Towards Safer Large Reasoning Models by Promoting Safety Decision-Making before Chain-of-Thought Generation
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieved remarkable performance via chain-of-thought (CoT), but recent studies showed that such enhanced reasoning capabilities are at the expense of significantly degraded safety capabilities. In this paper, we reveal that LRMs' safety degradation occurs only after CoT is enabled, and this degradation is not observed when CoT is disabled. This observation motivates us to consider encouraging LRMs to make safety decisions before CoT generation. To this end, we propose a novel safety alignment method that promotes the safety decision-making of LRMs before starting CoT generation. Specifically, we first utilize a Bert-based classifier to extract safety decision signals from a safe model (e.g., a CoT-disabled LRM) and then integrate these signals into LRMs' safety alignment as auxiliary supervision. In this way, the safety gradients can be backpropagated to the LRMs' latent representations, effectively strengthening the LRMs' safety decision-making abilities against CoT generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method substantially improves the safety capabilities of LRMs while effectively maintaining LRMs' general reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大型推理模型（LRMs）在启用思维链（CoT）后安全能力下降的问题，提出了一种新的安全对齐方法。该方法在CoT生成之前促进LRMs的安全决策，利用基于Bert的分类器从安全模型中提取安全决策信号，并将其作为辅助监督集成到安全对齐中，使安全梯度能够反向传播到LRMs的潜在表示，从而有效增强LRMs的安全决策能力。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过思维链（CoT）取得了显著的性能提升，但最近研究表明这种增强的推理能力是以显著降低安全能力为代价的。作者观察到LRMs的安全 degradation仅在启用CoT后发生，禁用CoT时不会发生，这促使他们考虑在CoT生成之前鼓励LRMs做出安全决策。
AI.method: 1. 使用基于Bert的分类器从安全模型（如禁用CoT的LRM）中提取安全决策信号；2. 将这些信号作为辅助监督集成到LRMs的安全对齐中；3. 使安全梯度能够反向传播到LRMs的潜在表示。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法显著提升了LRMs的安全能力，同时有效保持了LRMs的一般推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过将安全梯度反向传播到LRMs的潜在表示，有效增强了LRMs的安全决策能力。实验表明，该方法显著提升了LRMs的安全能力，同时有效保持了LRMs的一般推理性能。

title: CircuitBuilder: From Polynomials to Circuits via Reinforcement Learning
comment: ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI with Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Motivated by auto-proof generation and Valiant's VP vs. VNP conjecture, we study the problem of discovering efficient arithmetic circuits to compute polynomials, using addition and multiplication gates. We formulate this problem as a single-player game, where an RL agent attempts to build the circuit within a fixed number of operations. We implement an AlphaZero-style training loop and compare two approaches: Proximal Policy Optimization with Monte Carlo Tree Search (PPO+MCTS) and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). SAC achieves the highest success rates on two-variable targets, while PPO+MCTS scales to three variables and demonstrates steady improvement on harder instances. These results suggest that polynomial circuit synthesis is a compact, verifiable setting for studying self-improving search policies.

AI.tldr: 研究将多项式电路综合问题建模为单玩家游戏，使用强化学习方法（PPO+MCTS和SAC）自动发现高效算术电路。SAC在双变量目标上成功率最高，PPO+MCTS可扩展到三变量并在更难实例上持续改进。
AI.motivation: 受自动证明生成和Valiant的VP vs. VNP猜想启发，研究旨在发现计算多项式的高效算术电路（使用加法和乘法门）。
AI.method: 将多项式电路综合问题形式化为单玩家游戏，RL智能体在固定操作次数内尝试构建电路。实现了AlphaZero风格的训练循环，比较两种方法：PPO+MCTS和SAC。
AI.result: SAC在双变量目标上实现最高成功率；PPO+MCTS可扩展到三变量，并在更难实例上展现出稳定改进。
AI.conclusion: 多项式电路综合是研究自改进搜索策略的一个紧凑、可验证的设置。

title: CodeScout: An Effective Recipe for Reinforcement Learning of Code Search Agents
summary: A prerequisite for coding agents to perform tasks on large repositories is code localization - the identification of relevant files, classes, and functions to work on. While repository-level code localization has been performed using embedding-based retrieval approaches such as vector search, recent work has focused on developing agents to localize relevant code either as a standalone precursor to or interleaved with performing actual work. Most prior methods on agentic code search equip the agent with complex, specialized tools, such as repository graphs derived from static analysis. In this paper, we demonstrate that, with an effective reinforcement learning recipe, a coding agent equipped with nothing more than a standard Unix terminal can be trained to achieve strong results. Our experiments on three benchmarks (SWE-Bench Verified, Pro, and Lite) reveal that our models consistently achieve superior or competitive performance over 2-18x larger base and post-trained LLMs and sometimes approach performance provided by closed models like Claude Sonnet, even when using specialized scaffolds. Our work particularly focuses on techniques for re-purposing existing coding agent environments for code search, reward design, and RL optimization. We release the resulting model family, CodeScout, along with all our code and data for the community to build upon.

AI.tldr: CodeScout通过强化学习训练编码智能体仅使用Unix终端进行代码定位，在SWE-Bench上取得优异表现，超越2-18倍规模的LLM，接近Claude Sonnet等闭源模型水平。
AI.motivation: 代码定位（code localization）是编码智能体在大型代码库上执行任务的前提，需要识别相关的文件、类和方法。现有的智能体代码搜索方法通常依赖复杂的专门工具（如静态分析生成的代码库图）。本文旨在探索仅使用标准Unix终端的编码智能体是否能在代码定位任务上取得良好表现。
AI.method: 提出了一种有效的强化学习训练方案，具体工作包括：（1）将现有编码智能体环境重新用于代码搜索任务；（2）设计合适的奖励机制；（3）优化强化学习训练流程。模型仅配备标准Unix终端工具，不使用任何复杂的专门工具。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench Verified、Pro和Lite三个基准测试上，CodeScout模型持续取得优越或具有竞争力的表现，超过2-18倍规模的基座模型和后训练LLM，在某些场景下甚至接近使用专门scaffold的闭源模型（如Claude Sonnet）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过有效的强化学习训练方案，仅配备标准Unix终端的编码智能体即可在代码定位任务上实现强劲性能，无需依赖复杂的专门工具。团队发布了CodeScout模型系列及全部代码和数据。

title: From Digital Twins to World Models:Opportunities, Challenges, and Applications for Mobile Edge General Intelligence
summary: The rapid evolution toward 6G and beyond communication systems is accelerating the convergence of digital twins and world models at the network edge. Traditional digital twins provide high-fidelity representations of physical systems and support monitoring, analysis, and offline optimization. However, in highly dynamic edge environments, they face limitations in autonomy, adaptability, and scalability. This paper presents a systematic survey of the transition from digital twins to world models and discusses its role in enabling edge general intelligence (EGI). First, the paper clarifies the conceptual differences between digital twins and world models and highlights the shift from physics-based, centralized, and system-centric replicas to data-driven, decentralized, and agent-centric internal models. This discussion helps readers gain a clear understanding of how this transition enables more adaptive, autonomous, and resource-efficient intelligence at the network edge. The paper reviews the design principles, architectures, and key components of world models, including perception, latent state representation, dynamics learning, imagination-based planning, and memory. In addition, it examines the integration of world models and digital twins in wireless EGI systems and surveys emerging applications in integrated sensing and communications, semantic communication, air-ground networks, and low-altitude wireless networks. Finally, this survey provides a systematic roadmap and practical insights for designing world-model-driven edge intelligence systems in wireless and edge computing environments. It also outlines key research challenges and future directions toward scalable, reliable, and interoperable world models for edge-native agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇系统性综述，论述从"数字孪生"向"世界模型"范式转变在移动边缘通用智能（EGI）中的机遇、挑战与应用。作者澄清两者的概念差异（数字孪生=基于物理规律、中心化、系统级的高保真虚拟镜像；世界模型=数据驱动、去中心化、以智能体为中心的内部认知模型），归纳出世界模型的四大核心组件（编码器/感知、潜在状态表示、动力学模型、基于想象规划的解码器与记忆）与四条技术迁移主线（世界复刻→世界抽象、规则驱动→数据驱动、被动仿真→主动想象、系统中心→智能体中心），并将 ISCC、语义通信、空地一体网络、低空无线网络等经典数字孪生场景逐一映射到世界模型版本。结论是二者互补协同（数字孪生负责离线验证与标定，世界模型负责在线预测与自适应优化），并给出面向边缘原生智能体 AI 的可扩展、可信、可互操作路线图与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 边缘计算正从"任务专用 Edge AI"转向"边缘通用智能（EGI）"：智能体需在算力、存储、带宽受限时长期自主运行于动态、部分可观测环境，形成感知—决策—动作闭环，因而要求内部具备对环境动力学的建模能力。数字孪生虽以显式物理定律、领域方程和专家规则构建高保真虚拟副本，擅长网络规划、配置校验、what-if 分析与离线优化，但存在根本性错配：(1) 依赖预设规则与先验假设，泛化性与自主性不足；(2) 高保真建模带来巨大数据量、计算与存储开销，依赖云端/高性能服务器，难以满足资源受限边缘设备的实时性；(3) 系统中心视角忽视智能体的感知—决策—动作过程，多停留在"静态复制"阶段；(4) 通信与数据集成复杂、缺乏统一开发验证框架，难以大规模部署。因此需要一种面向决策、资源高效、可适应在线自主决策的建模范式——世界模型。
AI.method: 综述方法：(1) 概念澄清与结构化对比——Table I 给出数字孪生与世界模型在技术基础（表示学习/动力学/自监督 vs IoT 感知接入/双向同步/物理仿真）、优势维度上的差异；Table II 给出"DT→WM 赋能 EGI"的机制（DT 持续提供边界数据供在线学习，WM 为边缘节点提供实时前视推理与"决策大脑"，DT 实时校正物理误差以保证可信）；Table III 沿四个维度（复制→抽象、规则→数据、被动→主动、系统中心→智能体中心）逐条对照。(2) 核心组件分解——编码器（多模态高维感知压缩为紧凑潜在状态）、动力学模型（确定性 RNN 类与含随机隐变量的 RSSM 类，学习状态转移并预测多步潜在轨迹）、解码器（重建未来观测与奖励、作为策略评估与反馈信号），配合想象式滚动规划与记忆机制，构成感知—预测—决策闭环。(3) 技术演进分析——从世界复刻到世界抽象（Dreamer 系列等基于 VAE/RSSM 的潜在空间 rollout 提升样本效率）、规则驱动到数据驱动（自监督学习隐式状态转移律，规避高保真数值求解器）、被动仿真到动作条件想象（FSDrive 等在潜在空间生成未来场景以评估策略）、系统中心到智能体中心的局部化建模（模型规模与环境全局复杂度解耦，易于在线持续学习并与 RL/MPC 深度耦合）。(4) 应用映射与协同框架——在 ISCC 中由 DT 离线标定/链路规划/资源预分配 + WM 在线调节感知频率、通信协议参数与卸载比例形成离线—在线协同；在语义通信、空地网络、低空无人机网络中分别对应 UAV 轨迹/信道预测、气象与风速短时预测、路径与资源联合规划。(5) 归纳开放挑战与未来方向。
AI.result: 综述给出：(1) 首个面向无线与边缘系统的 EGI 世界模型系统性综述框架，并厘清世界模型中心 EGI 与传统数字孪生中心设计的边界；(2) 面向无线/边缘场景的世界模型分类体系，涵盖表示学习、动力学建模、观测/动作接口与想象式规划，并从边缘部署约束、通信感知与既有数字孪生基础设施融合角度重新解读机器学习、机器人与控制领域的代表性工作（DriveDreamer-2、GLAM、Drive-OccWorld、SWAP、MoSim、FSDrive、APEG 等）；(3) 量化收益：数字孪生集成框架在仅 2–7% 能耗代价下实现 33% 端到端时延下降与 30% 尾时延下降，世界模型使执行时延再降低 15–20%，两者结合把 ISCC 从"离线静态优化"推进到"在线动态自适应优化"；(4) 归纳出四个关键迁移方向（决策导向抽象建模、数据驱动演化学习、动作条件想象推理、智能体中心局部建模），以及混合物理—数据驱动模型、边缘联邦式世界建模、多智能体与多尺度建模、面向安全关键 EGI 的可解释可信世界模型等未来研究议题。
AI.conclusion: 数字孪生与世界模型并非替代关系而是互补：数字孪生以高保真物理映射提供离线验证、标定基准与风险预判，世界模型以数据驱动潜在抽象提供实时预测、想象规划与前视决策，二者构成"离线规划可靠性 + 在线自适应敏捷性"的统一协同范式。据此，边缘智能体的建模目标应从"复刻世界"转向"面向决策的抽象"，从"系统级全局同步"转向"智能体中心局部建模"，从而在资源受限、动态、部分可观测条件下实现长期自主与自适应。面向边缘原生智能体 AI 的关键挑战包括：混合物理与数据驱动模型的融合、跨节点联邦/分布式世界建模以保护数据隐私、多智能体与多尺度动力学的统一建模、可靠性与可解释性/可验证性、以及缺乏统一标准与开发验证框架导致的互操作性问题。作者为研究者与工程实践者提供了从数字孪生中心设计迈向世界模型中心 EGI 的概念基础与实践路线图。

title: SENSE: Efficient EEG-to-Text via Privacy-Preserving Semantic Retrieval
summary: Decoding brain activity into natural language is a major challenge in AI with important applications in assistive communication, neurotechnology, and human-computer interaction. Most existing Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) approaches rely on memory-intensive fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs) or encoder-decoder models on raw EEG signals, resulting in expensive training pipelines, limited accessibility, and potential exposure of sensitive neural data. We introduce SENSE (SEmantic Neural Sparse Extraction), a lightweight and privacy-preserving framework that translates non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG) into text without LLM fine-tuning. SENSE decouples decoding into two stages: on-device semantic retrieval and prompt-based language generation. EEG signals are locally mapped to a discrete textual space to extract a non-sensitive Bag-of-Words (BoW), which conditions an off-the-shelf LLM to synthesize fluent text in a zero-shot manner. The EEG-to-keyword module contains only ~6M parameters and runs fully on-device, ensuring raw neural signals remain local while only abstract semantic cues interact with language models. Evaluated on a 128-channel EEG dataset across six subjects, SENSE matches or surpasses the generative quality of fully fine-tuned baselines such as Thought2Text while substantially reducing computational overhead. By localizing neural decoding and sharing only derived textual cues, SENSE provides a scalable and privacy-aware retrieval-augmented architecture for next-generation BCIs.

AI.tldr: SENSE是一个轻量级、隐私保护的框架，将非侵入式脑电图(EEG)翻译成文本，无需对大型语言模型进行微调。该框架将解码解耦为两个阶段：设备端语义检索和基于提示的语言生成。
AI.motivation: 将大脑活动解码为自然语言是AI的重大挑战，现有脑机接口(BCI)方法依赖对大型语言模型(LLM)进行内存密集型的微调，导致训练成本高、访问受限，并可能暴露敏感的神经数据。
AI.method: SENSE将解码解耦为两个阶段：1)设备端语义检索：EEG信号在本地映射到离散文本空间，提取非敏感的词袋(BoW)；2)基于提示的语言生成：使用现成LLM以零样本方式合成流畅文本。EEG到关键词模块仅包含约600万个参数，完全在设备端运行。
AI.result: 在128通道EEG数据集(6名受试者)上评估，SENSE在生成质量上匹配或超越完全微调的基线方法(如Thought2Text)，同时显著降低计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过本地化神经解码并仅共享派生的文本线索，SENSE为下一代BCI提供了可扩展且注重隐私的检索增强架构。

title: ArchBench: Benchmarking Generative-AI for Software Architecture Tasks
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, Software Architecture Showcase Track, ICSA 2026
summary: Benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) have progressed from snippet-level function generation to repository-level issue resolution, yet they overwhelmingly target implementation correctness. Software architecture tasks remain under-specified and difficult to compare across models, despite their central role in maintaining and evolving complex systems. We present ArchBench, the first unified platform for benchmarking LLM capabilities on software architecture tasks. ArchBench provides a command-line tool with a standardized pipeline for dataset download, inference with trajectory logging, and automated evaluation, alongside a public web interface with an interactive leaderboard. The platform is built around a plugin architecture where each task is a self-contained module, making it straightforward for the community to contribute new architectural tasks and evaluation results. We use the term LLMs broadly to encompass generative AI (GenAI) solutions for software engineering, including both standalone models and LLM-based coding agents equipped with tools. Both the CLI tool and the web platform are openly available to support reproducible research and community-driven growth of architectural benchmarking.

AI.tldr: ArchBench是首个针对LLM软件架构任务能力的统一基准测试平台，通过CLI工具和Web界面提供标准化评估流程，采用插件架构便于社区贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准测试主要关注实现正确性，缺乏针对软件架构任务的统一评估标准，且难以在不同模型间进行比较。
AI.method: 采用插件架构，每个任务作为独立模块实现；提供命令行工具进行数据集下载、推理和轨迹记录；提供自动化评估和交互式排行榜的Web界面。
AI.result: 构建了首个统一的软件架构任务LLM基准测试平台，支持社区贡献新任务和评估结果。
AI.conclusion: ArchBench是一个有价值的贡献，为LLM在软件架构任务方面的评估提供了统一的平台，有助于推动该领域的研究进展。

title: Proactive Knowledge Inquiry in Doctor-Patient Dialogue: Stateful Extraction, Belief Updating, and Path-Aware Action Planning
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Pilot concept demonstration under a controlled simulated setting
summary: Most automated electronic medical record (EMR) pipelines remain output-oriented: they transcribe, extract, and summarize after the consultation, but they do not explicitly model what is already known, what is still missing, which uncertainty matters most, or what question or recommendation should come next. We formulate doctor-patient dialogue as a proactive knowledge-inquiry problem under partial observability. The proposed framework combines stateful extraction, sequential belief updating, gap-aware state modeling, hybrid retrieval over objectified medical knowledge, and a POMDP-lite action planner. Instead of treating the EMR as the only target artifact, the framework treats documentation as the structured projection of an ongoing inquiry loop. To make the formulation concrete, we report a controlled pilot evaluation on ten standardized multi-turn dialogues together with a 300-query retrieval benchmark aggregated across dialogues. On this pilot protocol, the full framework reaches 83.3% coverage, 80.0% risk recall, 81.4% structural completeness, and lower redundancy than the chunk-only and template-heavy interactive baselines. These pilot results do not establish clinical generalization; rather, they suggest that proactive inquiry may be methodologically interesting under tightly controlled conditions and can be viewed as a conceptually appealing formulation worth further investigation for dialogue-based EMR generation. This work should be read as a pilot concept demonstration under a controlled simulated setting rather than as evidence of clinical deployment readiness. No implication of clinical deployment readiness, clinical safety, or real-world clinical utility should be inferred from this pilot protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文将医患对话建模为部分可观测下的主动知识查询问题，提出结合状态提取、信念更新、缺口感知、混合检索和POMDP规划的框架，在受控pilot评估中展示了一定的有效性，但强调不代表临床部署就绪。
AI.motivation: 现有自动电子病历（EMR）管道仍是输出导向的：仅在问诊后转录、提取和总结，未显式建模已知信息、缺失信息、不确定性重要性或下一步应提出的问题/建议。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合状态化提取、顺序信念更新、缺口感知状态建模、对象化医学知识混合检索和 POMDP-lite 动作规划器的框架，将医患对话建模为部分可观测下的主动知识查询问题。
AI.result: 在10个标准化多轮对话和300个检索查询的pilot评估中，完整框架达到83.3%覆盖率、80.0%风险召回率、81.4%结构完整性，且冗余度低于仅分块和模板化交互基线。
AI.conclusion: 该研究作为概念验证，表明在受控模拟环境下主动询问框架可能具有方法论意义，但 pilot 结果不代表临床部署就绪性或现实世界的临床实用性，需要进一步研究验证。

title: Topology-Preserving Deep Joint Source-Channel Coding for Semantic Communication
comment: Submitted to IEEE Journals for possible publication
summary: Many wireless vision applications, such as autonomous driving, require preservation of global structural information rather than only per-pixel fidelity. However, existing Deep joint source-channel coding (DeepJSCC) schemes mainly optimize pixel-wise losses and provide no explicit protection of connectivity or topology. This letter proposes TopoJSCC, a topology-aware DeepJSCC framework that integrates persistent-homology regularizers to end-to-end training.
