Specifically, we enforce topological consistency by penalizing Wasserstein distances between cubical persistence diagrams of original and reconstructed images, and between Vietoris--Rips persistence of latent features before and after the channel to promote a robust latent manifold. TopoJSCC is based on end-to-end learning and requires no side information. Experiments show improved topology preservation and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and bandwidth-ratio regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TopoJSCC：一个拓扑感知的深度联合信源信道编码（DeepJSCC）框架，将持久同调（persistent homology, PH）正则项直接嵌入端到端训练。在 MSE 失真损失之上，额外加入图像域（超水平集立方复形持久图的 2-Wasserstein 距离）与隐空间域（编码器前后隐向量点云的 Vietoris–Rips 持久图距离）两类拓扑损失，无需任何边信息（side information）。在 Omniglot 与 DeepGlobe 道路提取数据集、AWGN 与 Rayleigh 衰落信道上，低 SNR 与低带宽比（ρ<1）下显著降低持久图失真，同时保持与纯 MSE 的 DeepJSCC 相当的 PSNR，整体优于 BPG+LDPC 与 TopoCode 等数字基线。
AI.motivation: 无线视觉应用（自动驾驶、远程医疗等）中的关键在于接收图像的全局结构与拓扑（连通性、分支、环路）而非逐像素保真；即使 PSNR 较高，道路断裂或视网膜血管分支缺失也会使下游语义模块失效。现有 DeepJSCC 仅优化像素级/几何失真，缺乏对拓扑的显式保护；同时已有工作如 TopoCode 仅把持久图作为边信息叠加在传统数字编码之上，未将 TDA 融入端到端学习的物理层。作者声称尚无将 PH 损失直接集成进 DeepJSCC 的工作，也缺少该场景下拓扑保持的系统性评估，故填补此空白。
AI.method: 系统模型：点对点单天线链路，图像 X∈R^{H×W×C} 经语义编码器 f_θ 输出 2k 维实向量并成对组成 k 个复符号 z，功率约束 (1/k)E[‖z‖²]≤P，带宽比 ρ=k/n<1；信道 y=h·z+n，n~CN(0,N₀I)，含静态 AWGN（h=1）与慢衰落 Rayleigh（h~CN(0,1)，逐图独立），SNR=P/N₀；解码器 g_φ 从 y 的实虚部拼接向量重建图像。损失设计：(1) 图像域拓扑损失——把像素网格视为立方复形，以像素强度 [0,1] 定义有限递减阈值序列 1=τ₀>…>τ_T=0 的超水平集滤流，计算 m∈{0,1} 的持久图，用 p=2 的 Wasserstein 距离（无穷范数、无穷对角线增广）比较原图与重建图，L_top^img = Σ_m d^{img}_m；(2) 隐空间拓扑损失——把一个 mini-batch 的 B 个编码前隐向量 S 与过信道后的隐向量 S̃ 视为 R^{2k} 中的点云，构造 Vietoris–Rips 滤流（欧氏度量、递增尺度 ε），计算 m∈{0,1} 持久图并以同样的 2-Wasserstein 距离衡量信道引入的拓扑形变，L_top^lat = Σ_m d^{lat}_m（批级定义）。总目标 L_batch = 批均值 [L_MSE + λ_img L_top^img] + λ_lat L_top^lat，PH 通过可微层求梯度并与 MSE 联合反传；由于部署时无需任何拓扑计算，推理复杂度不受影响。超参数两阶段选取：先训纯 MSE 基线，在验证集上标定各项损失量级以使加权拓扑项仅占重建损失的小比例，再做小范围网格搜索；采用 λ(t)=λ(1−e^{−t/T}) 的退火调度逐步增强拓扑约束，最终 λ_img=10⁻⁴、λ_lat=10⁻⁵（图像域系数更大，因批级隐空间损失易主导梯度）。实验设置：统一 CNN 自编码器（5 个 5×5 卷积，stride 2,2,1,1,1，PReLU；解码器对称转置卷积 + sigmoid），非可微训练的信道层置于编解码器之间，每个 ρ 单独训练一对编解码器；Adam、lr=10⁻⁴、batch=128、10 次独立运行取均值与阴影；训练时每个 mini-batch 从 {0,5,10,15,20} dB 离散分布随机采样 SNR 以获得 SNR 自适应能力。数据集：Omniglot（50 字母 1623 字符，单通道连续化）与 DeepGlobe Road Extraction（二值道路掩码）。基线：同架构纯 MSE 的 DeepJSCC、BPG+5G LDPC 分离式方案、TopoCode 拓扑保护数字纠错方案。评价指标：PSNR 与原图/重建图持久图间的 2-Wasserstein 距离（Wdist），m∈{0,1}、固定阈值网格；两种扫描：固定 ρ 变 SNR、固定 SNR 变 ρ∈{0.05,…,0.50}。
AI.result: Omniglot（ρ=0.40）SNR 扫描：TopoJSCC 在低 SNR 下 PSNR 优于纯 MSE 的 DeepJSCC（AWGN、SNR=0 dB 时约高 2 dB，比 TopoCode/BPG+LDPC 高 7–8 dB），高 SNR 时与 DeepJSCC 差距在约 0.5 dB 以内；拓扑指标优势更明显，SNR=0 dB（AWGN）时 Wdist 约为 DeepJSCC 与 BPG+LDPC 的 1/4–1/5，接近 TopoCode，而 TopoCode 以显著 PSNR 降级为代价。Rayleigh 下趋势一致。DeepGlobe（SNR=15 dB）带宽扫描：在所有 ρ 与两种信道下 Wdist 显著低于 DeepJSCC 与 BPG+LDPC，ρ=0.05 时 Wdist 仍比数字基线与 MSE-only DeepJSCC 低数倍；极低带宽比下 TopoJSCC 的 PSNR 为所有方案最高，随 ρ 增大各方案差距收敛。定性结果（Fig.4，SNR=5 dB）显示重建中断裂连接与孔洞更少。消融（Omniglot，0 dB，ρ=0.4）：DeepJSCC 22.1 dB/Wdist 415；仅图像域损失 22.9/132；仅隐空间损失 22.4/271；完整 TopoJSCC 23.2/94，说明图像域拓扑损失贡献主要降幅，隐空间损失提供较小但互补的增益，组合最佳。
AI.conclusion: TopoJSCC 首次将持久同调正则化同时注入 DeepJSCC 的图像域与隐空间，使物理层端到端学习显式保护连通性与环路结构，且无需边信息、不增加推理开销。实验表明其在低 SNR 与低带宽比下同时降低持久图失真并取得更优 PSNR，优于 MSE-only DeepJSCC 及 TopoCode/BPG+LDPC 等数字基线，拓扑感知训练可在不牺牲像素保真度的情况下提升对信道扰动的鲁棒性。遗留问题包括：拓扑计算带来的训练开销、λ 的两阶段人工标定与退火调度较为启发式、超参数数目偏多、以及仅在两个合成/单通道数据集上验证，向高分辨率自然图像与更复杂信道（如多径时变、多用户）扩展仍待研究。

title: scicode-lint: Detecting Methodology Bugs in Scientific Python Code with LLM-Generated Patterns
summary: Methodology bugs in scientific Python code produce plausible but incorrect results that traditional linters and static analysis tools cannot detect. Several research groups have built ML-specific linters, demonstrating that detection is feasible. Yet these tools share a sustainability problem: dependency on specific pylint or Python versions, limited packaging, and reliance on manual engineering for every new pattern. As AI-generated code increases the volume of scientific software, the need for automated methodology checking (such as detecting data leakage, incorrect cross-validation, and missing random seeds) grows. We present scicode-lint, whose two-tier architecture separates pattern design (frontier models at build time) from execution (small local model at runtime). Patterns are generated, not hand-coded; adapting to new library versions costs tokens, not engineering hours. On Kaggle notebooks with human-labeled ground truth, preprocessing leakage detection reaches 65% precision at 100% recall; on 38 published scientific papers applying AI/ML, precision is 62% (LLM-judged) with substantial variation across pattern categories; on a held-out paper set, precision is 54%. On controlled tests, scicode-lint achieves 97.7% accuracy across 66 patterns.

AI.tldr: 针对科学Python代码方法论bug检测问题，提出scicode-lint系统，采用前沿大模型生成检测pattern+轻量本地模型执行的两阶段架构，实现自动化方法论检查，在多个评估集上取得良好效果。
AI.motivation: 科学Python代码中的方法论bug会产生看似合理但错误的结果，传统静态分析工具无法检测；现有ML专用linters存在可持续性问题（依赖特定版本、封装性差、手工编码pattern成本高）；AI生成代码增多使得自动化方法论检查需求日益迫切。
AI.method: 提出两阶段架构：构建时使用前沿大模型生成检测pattern，运行时不依赖大模型而使用轻量本地模型执行检测。在Kaggle笔记本数据集和38篇已发表科学论文上评估，preprocessing leakage检测采用人工标注ground truth，论文评估采用LLM评判。
AI.result: 预处理泄漏检测：在Kaggle笔记本上达到65%精确率、100%召回率；38篇已发表论文（应用AI/ML）上精确率62%（LLM评判），不同pattern类别有显著差异；留出论文集上精确率54%；受控测试中66个pattern达到97.7%准确率。
AI.conclusion: scicode-lint通过两阶段架构成功实现了科学Python代码方法论bug的自动检测，在Kaggle数据集上达到65%精确率（100%召回率），在已发表论文上达到62%精确率，在受控测试中达到97.7%准确率。该方法证明了生成式pattern而非手工编码的可行性，为科学AI/ML代码质量保证提供了新范式。

title: When Only the Final Text Survives: Implicit Execution Tracing for Multi-Agent Attribution
summary: When a multi-agent system produces an incorrect or harmful answer, who is accountable if execution logs and agent identifiers are unavailable? Multi-agent language systems increasingly rely on structured interactions such as delegation and iterative refinement, yet the final output often obscures the underlying interaction topology and agent contributions. We introduce IET (Implicit Execution Tracing), a metadata-independent framework that enables token-level attribution directly from generated text and a simple mechanism for interaction topology reconstruction. During generation, agent-specific keyed signals are embedded into the token distribution, transforming the text into a self-describing execution trace detectable only with a secret key. At detection time, a transition-aware scoring method identifies agent handover points and reconstructs the interaction graph. Experiments show that IET recovers agent segments and coordination structure with high accuracy while preserving generation quality, enabling privacy-preserving auditing for multi-agent language systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IET框架，通过在token分布中嵌入密钥信号，实现无需元数据的token级归因和交互拓扑重建，使多智能体语言系统具备可审计性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统产生错误或有害输出时，若缺乏执行日志和智能体标识符，责任归属难以界定。现有多智能体系统的最终输出往往隐藏了底层交互拓扑和智能体贡献，需要一种隐私保护的可审计机制。
AI.method: 在生成过程中将智能体特定的密钥信号嵌入token分布，使文本转化为仅能通过密钥检测的自描述执行 trace。检测时使用过渡感知评分方法识别智能体交接点并重建交互图。
AI.result: 实验表明IET能高精度恢复智能体片段和协作结构，同时保持生成质量，实现多智能体语言系统的隐私保护审计。
AI.conclusion: IET提供了一种无需元数据的token级归因框架，能够重建交互拓扑，为多智能体系统的可审计性和责任追溯提供了有效解决方案。

title: Contextual Preference Distribution Learning
comment: In CPAIOR 2026 (23rd International Conference on the Integration of Constraint Programming, Artificial Intelligence, and Operations Research)
summary: Decision-making problems often feature uncertainty stemming from heterogeneous and context-dependent human preferences. To address this, we propose a sequential learning-and-optimization pipeline to learn preference distributions and leverage them to solve downstream problems, for example risk-averse formulations. We focus on human choice settings that can be formulated as (integer) linear programs. In such settings, existing inverse optimization and choice modelling methods infer preferences from observed choices but typically produce point estimates or fail to capture contextual shifts, making them unsuitable for risk-averse decision-making. Using a bounded-variance score function gradient estimator, we train a predictive model mapping contextual features to a rich class of parameterizable distributions. This approach yields a maximum likelihood estimate. The model generates scenarios for unseen contexts in the subsequent optimization phase. In a synthetic ridesharing environment, our approach reduces average post-decision surprise by up to 114$\times$ compared to a risk-neutral approach with perfect predictions and up to 25$\times$ compared to leading risk-averse baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种序贯学习-优化框架，从人类选择数据中学习偏好分布，并将其用于风险厌恶的下游决策问题。该方法使用有界方差得分函数梯度估计器训练预测模型，将上下文特征映射到参数化分布，在合成共享出行环境中显著降低了决策后惊讶程度。
AI.motivation: 决策问题中的不确定性源于异质性和上下文依赖的人类偏好。现有逆优化和选择建模方法通常只产生点估计，无法捕捉上下文变化，且不适用于风险厌恶决策。
AI.method: 使用有界方差得分函数梯度估计器，训练预测模型将上下文特征映射到一类参数化分布（产生最大似然估计），为后续优化阶段生成未见上下文的场景。
AI.result: 在合成共享出行环境中，该方法相比完美预测的风险中性方法降低平均决策后惊讶程度达114倍，相比领先的风险厌恶基线方法降低25倍。
AI.conclusion: 该序贯学习-优化框架能有效学习上下文依赖的偏好分布，为风险厌恶决策提供场景生成能力，在实际应用中具有重要价值。

title: In Perfect Harmony: Orchestrating Causality in Actor-Based Systems
comment: Accepted at the 19th IEEE International Conference on Software Testing, Verification and Validation (ICST 2026)
summary: Runtime verification has gained popularity as a lightweight approach for increasing assurance in systems under scrutiny. Performing runtime checks enables dynamic monitoring and alerts for unexpected behavior, thereby improving reliability and correctness. Actor-based systems present significant challenges for runtime verification. Properties frequently span multiple actors with complex causal dependencies, while nondeterministic message interleavings can obscure execution semantics. Moreover, most existing monitoring tools are designed for single-process behavior. This paper presents ACTORCHESTRA, a runtime verification framework for Erlang that automatically tracks causality across multi-actor interactions. The framework instruments Erlang systems that comply with OTP guidelines via targeted code injection. This method establishes the orchestration infrastructure required to track causal relationships between actors without requiring manual modifications to the target system. To ease the specification of multi-actor properties, the framework provides WALTZ, a specification language that automatically compiles properties into executable Erlang monitors that integrate with the instrumented system. Three case studies demonstrate ACTORCHESTRA's effectiveness in detecting complex behavioral violations in real-world actor systems. A performance evaluation quantifies the runtime overhead of the monitoring infrastructure and analyzes the trade-offs between added safety guarantees and execution costs.

AI.tldr: ACTORCHESTRA是一个用于Erlang的运行时验证框架，通过代码插桩技术自动跟踪多Actor交互中的因果关系，并提供WALTZ规范语言将属性编译为可执行的Erlang监控器。三个案例研究和性能评估证明了其在检测复杂行为违规方面的有效性和实用性。
AI.motivation: 基于Actor的系统对运行时验证提出了重大挑战：属性通常跨越多个Actor并具有复杂的因果依赖关系，不确定的消息交错可能掩盖执行语义，且现有监控工具主要针对单进程行为设计，缺乏对多Actor因果关系的跟踪能力。
AI.method: 1) 通过目标代码注入技术为符合OTP指南的Erlang系统建立编排基础设施，无需手动修改目标系统即可跟踪Actor间的因果关系；2) 设计WALTZ规范语言，将属性自动编译为与instrumented系统集成的可执行Erlang监控器。
AI.result: 三个案例研究成功演示了在实际Actor系统中检测复杂行为违规的能力；性能评估量化了监控基础设施的运行时开销，并分析了安全保证与执行成本之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: ACTORCHESTRA框架能够有效解决Actor系统运行时验证的难题，通过自动化的因果关系跟踪和属性编译机制，为Erlang Actor系统提供了轻量级的运行时保障方法，在增加安全性的同时保持了可接受的性能开销。

title: Informative Semi-Factuals for XAI: The Elaborated Explanations that People Prefer
summary: Recently, in eXplainable AI (XAI), $\textit{even if}$ explanations -- so-called semi-factuals -- have emerged as a popular strategy that explains how a predicted outcome $\textit{can remain the same}$ even when certain input-features are altered. For example, in the commonly-used banking app scenario, a semi-factual explanation could inform customers about better options, other alternatives for their successful application, by saying "$\textit{Even if}$ you asked for double the loan amount, you would still be accepted". Most semi-factuals XAI algorithms focus on finding maximal value-changes to a single key-feature that do $\textit{not}$ alter the outcome (unlike counterfactual explanations that often find minimal value-changes to several features that alter the outcome). However, no current semi-factual method explains $\textit{why}$ these extreme value-changes do not alter outcomes; for example, a more informative semi-factual could tell the customer that it is their good credit score that allows them to borrow double their requested loan. In this work, we advance a new algorithm -- the $\textit{informative semi-factuals}$ (ISF) method -- that generates more elaborated explanations supplementing semi-factuals with information about additional $\textit{hidden features}$ that influence an automated decision. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that this ISF method computes semi-factuals that are both informative and of high-quality on key metrics. Furthermore, a user study shows that people prefer these elaborated explanations over the simpler semi-factual explanations generated by current methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的可解释人工智能(XAI)方法——信息性半事实(Informative Semi-Factuals, ISF)，该方法在传统半事实解释的基础上补充了关于隐藏特征的信息，解决了现有方法无法解释为何极端值变化不会改变预测结果的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前半事实XAI算法主要关注寻找不改变结果的最大值变化，但无法解释为什么这些极端值变化不会改变结果。例如，在银行贷款场景中，现有方法只能告诉用户"即使你申请双倍贷款金额，你仍然会被接受"，但无法解释是用户的良好信用评分使这一结果成为可能。
AI.method: 提出信息性半事实(ISF)方法，该方法生成更详细的解释，在半事实基础上补充影响自动决策的隐藏特征信息。实验在基准数据集上评估了该方法的性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ISF方法生成的半事实在关键指标上既具有信息性又具有高质量。用户研究表明，人们更偏好这种详细解释而非当前方法生成的简单半事实解释。
AI.conclusion: ISF方法通过揭示隐藏特征来增强半事实解释的信息量，为用户提供了更透明、可理解的决策依据，具有重要的实践应用价值。

title: REAL: Regression-Aware Reinforcement Learning for LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated evaluators that assign numeric scores to model outputs, a paradigm known as LLM-as-a-Judge. However, standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods typically rely on binary rewards (e.g., 0-1 accuracy), thereby ignoring the ordinal structure inherent in regression tasks; for instance, they fail to recognize that predicting 4 is significantly better than predicting 1 when the ground truth is 5. Conversely, existing regression-aware approaches are often confined to Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), limiting their ability to explore optimal reasoning paths. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{REAL} (\underline{RE}gression-\underline{A}ware Reinforcement \underline{L}earning), a principled RL framework designed to optimize regression rewards, and also proven to be optimal for correlation metrics. A key technical challenge is that the regression objective is explicitly policy-dependent, thus invalidating standard policy gradient methods. To address this, we employ the generalized policy gradient estimator, which naturally decomposes optimization into two complementary components: (1) exploration over Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectory, and (2) regression-aware prediction refinement of the final score. Extensive experiments across model scales (8B to 32B) demonstrate that REAL consistently outperforms both regression-aware SFT baselines and standard RL methods, exhibiting significantly better generalization on out-of-domain benchmarks. On Qwen3-32B specifically, we achieve gains of +8.40 Pearson and +7.20 Spearman correlation over the SFT baseline, and +18.30/+11.20 over the base model. These findings highlight the critical value of integrating regression objectives into RL exploration for accurate LLM evaluation.

AI.tldr: REAL是一种将回归目标融入强化学习的新框架，用于优化LLM作为评估器的评分任务。通过广义策略梯度估计器解决回归目标策略依赖的技术挑战，在8B-32B模型上显著优于回归感知SFT和标准RL方法。
AI.motivation: 解决LLM-as-a-Judge范式中标准RL方法使用二元奖励忽视回归任务序数结构的问题。现有回归感知方法局限于监督微调(SFT)，无法探索最优推理路径。
AI.method: 提出REAL框架，使用广义策略梯度估计器将优化分解为两个互补组件：(1)思维链(CoT)轨迹探索；(2)回归感知的最终分数预测优化。
AI.result: 在8B-32B模型规模上持续优于回归感知SFT基线和标准RL方法。Qwen3-32B上相比SFT基线提升+8.40 Pearson和+7.20 Spearman，相比基线模型提升+18.30/+11.20。
AI.conclusion: 证明了将回归目标整合到RL探索中对准确LLM评估具有关键价值，为LLM-as-a-Judge范式提供了新的优化思路。

title: CodeGreen: Towards Improving Precision and Portability in Software Energy Measurement
summary: Accurate software energy measurement is critical for optimizing energy, yet existing profilers force a trade-off between measurement accuracy and overhead due to tight coupling with supported specific hardware or languages. We present CodeGreen, a modular energy measurement platform that decouples instrumentation from measurement via an asynchronous producer-consumer architecture. We implement a Native Energy Measurement Backend (NEMB) that polls hardware sensors (Intel RAPL, NVIDIA NVML, AMD ROCm) independently, while lightweight timestamp markers enable tunable granularity. CodeGreen leverages Tree-sitter AST queries for automated instrumentation across Python, C++, C, and Java, with straightforward extension to any Tree-sitter-supported grammar, enabling developers to target specific scopes (loops, methods, classes) without manual intervention. Validation against "Computer Language Benchmarks Game" demonstrates $R^2 = 0.9934$ correlation with RAPL ground truth and $R^2 = 0.9997$ energy-workload linearity. By bridging fine-grained measurement precision with cross-platform portability, CodeGreen enables practical algorithmic energy optimization across heterogeneous environments. Source code, video demonstration, and documentation for the tool are publicly available at: https://smart-dal.github.io/codegreen/.

AI.tldr: CodeGreen是一个模块化的软件能耗测量平台，通过异步生产者-消费者架构将仪表化与测量解耦。它使用Tree-sitter AST查询实现跨Python、C++、C、Java的自动仪表化，并通过NEMB轮询Intel RAPL、NVIDIA NVML、AMD ROCm硬件传感器。验证表明与RAPL真值的相关性R²=0.9934，能耗-工作负载线性度R²=0.9997。
AI.motivation: 准确测量软件能耗对优化能源效率至关重要，但现有分析工具在测量精度和开销之间存在权衡，且与特定硬件或语言紧密耦合，缺乏跨平台移植性。
AI.method: 提出CodeGreen平台，采用异步生产者-消费者架构解耦仪表化与测量。实现NEMB（本地能耗测量后端）独立轮询硬件传感器（Intel RAPL、NVIDIA NVML、AMD ROCm）。利用Tree-sitter AST查询实现跨Python、C++、C、Java的自动化仪表化，支持针对特定作用域（循环、方法、类）的细粒度测量，时间戳标记提供可调粒度。
AI.result: 在Computer Language Benchmarks Game上验证，与RAPL真值的相关性达到R²=0.9934，能耗-工作负载线性度达到R²=0.9997。
AI.conclusion: CodeGreen通过桥接细粒度测量精度与跨平台移植性，使开发者能够在异构环境中进行实际的算法能耗优化，解决了现有工具的精度-开销权衡和平台限制问题。

title: Per-Domain Generalizing Policies: On Learning Efficient and Robust Q-Value Functions (Extended Version with Technical Appendix)
summary: Learning per-domain generalizing policies is a key challenge in learning for planning. Standard approaches learn state-value functions represented as graph neural networks using supervised learning on optimal plans generated by a teacher planner. In this work, we advocate for learning Q-value functions instead. Such policies are drastically cheaper to evaluate for a given state, as they need to process only the current state rather than every successor. Surprisingly, vanilla supervised learning of Q-values performs poorly as it does not learn to distinguish between the actions taken and those not taken by the teacher. We address this by using regularization terms that enforce this distinction, resulting in Q-value policies that consistently outperform state-value policies across a range of 10 domains and are competitive with the planner LAMA-first.

AI.tldr: 本文提出学习Q值函数替代状态值函数来解决学习规划问题，通过正则化项区分教师规划器采取的行动和未采取的行动，实验表明该方法在10个领域上性能优于状态值策略且可与LAMA-first规划器竞争。
AI.motivation: 标准方法学习状态值函数需要处理每个后继状态，成本较高；而Q值函数只需处理当前状态，评估成本更低。
AI.method: 学习Q值函数而非状态值函数，并引入正则化项来强制区分教师规划器采取的行动和未采取的行动。
AI.result: Q值策略在10个领域上始终优于状态值策略，并与规划器LAMA-first具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过使用正则化项区分教师规划器采取的行动和未采取的行动，Q值策略在10个领域上始终优于状态值策略，并与规划器LAMA-first具有竞争力。

title: Personalized Fall Detection by Balancing Data with Selective Feedback Using Contrastive Learning
summary: Personalized fall detection models can significantly improve accuracy by adapting to individual motion patterns, yet their effectiveness is often limited by the scarcity of real-world fall data and the dominance of non-fall feedback samples. This imbalance biases the model toward routine activities and weakens its sensitivity to true fall events. To address this challenge, we propose a personalization framework that combines semi-supervised clustering with contrastive learning to identify and balance the most informative user feedback samples. The framework is evaluated under three retraining strategies, including Training from Scratch (TFS), Transfer Learning (TL), and Few-Shot Learning (FSL), to assess adaptability across learning paradigms. Real-time experiments with ten participants show that the TFS approach achieves the highest performance, with up to a 25% improvement over the baseline, while FSL achieves the second-highest performance with a 7% improvement, demonstrating the effectiveness of selective personalization for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合半监督聚类和对比学习的个性化跌倒检测框架，通过识别和平衡最有价值的用户反馈样本来解决真实跌倒数据稀缺和样本不平衡问题。实验表明，从头训练(TFS)方法提升最高达25%，少样本学习(FSL)提升7%。
AI.motivation: 个性化跌倒检测模型虽能通过适应个体运动模式提升准确率，但其有效性受限于真实跌倒数据的稀缺性和非跌倒反馈样本的主导地位。这种不平衡导致模型偏向日常活动，降低了对真实跌倒事件的敏感性。
AI.method: 提出一种个性化框架，融合半监督聚类与对比学习技术，用于识别和平衡最具信息量的用户反馈样本。框架在三种再训练策略下进行评估：从头训练(TFS)、迁移学习(TL)和少样本学习(FSL)。
AI.result: 10名参与者的实时实验表明，TFS方法取得最高性能，较基线提升达25%；FSL取得次高性能，提升7%。证明了选择性个性化在实际部署中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过半监督聚类和对比学习相结合的个性化框架能有效解决跌倒检测中的数据稀缺和样本不平衡问题。其中TFS策略表现最优，FSL作为轻量级替代方案也展现出良好性能，为实际应用提供了可行的技术路径。

title: TDAD: Test-Driven Agentic Development - Reducing Code Regressions in AI Coding Agents via Graph-Based Impact Analysis
comment: Toolpaper, 7 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure, 1 algorithm. Submitted to ACM AIWare 2026 (Data and Benchmark Track)
summary: AI coding agents can resolve real-world software issues, yet they frequently introduce regressions, breaking tests that previously passed. Current benchmarks focus almost exclusively on resolution rate, leaving regression behavior under-studied. This paper presents TDAD (Test-Driven Agentic Development), an open-source tool and benchmark methodology that combines abstract-syntax-tree (AST) based code-test graph construction with weighted impact analysis to surface the tests most likely affected by a proposed change. Evaluated on SWE-bench Verified with two local models (Qwen3-Coder 30B on 100 instances and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on 25 instances), TDAD's GraphRAG workflow reduced test-level regressions by 70% (6.08% to 1.82%) and improved resolution from 24% to 32% when deployed as an agent skill. A surprising finding is that TDD prompting alone increased regressions (9.94%), revealing that smaller models benefit more from contextual information (which tests to verify) than from procedural instructions (how to do TDD). An autonomous auto-improvement loop raised resolution from 12% to 60% on a 10-instance subset with 0% regression. These findings suggest that for AI agent tool design, surfacing contextual information outperforms prescribing procedural workflows. All code, data, and logs are publicly available at https://github.com/pepealonso95/TDAD.

AI.tldr: TDAD是一个开源工具和基准测试方法，通过AST构建代码-测试图并结合加权影响分析来识别最可能受代码变更影响的测试，从而减少AI编码智能体的回归问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试几乎只关注解决率，忽略了AI编码智能体引入回归（破坏原本通过的测试）的行为，导致这一重要问题长期被低估。
AI.method: 1)基于抽象语法树(AST)构建代码-测试依赖图；2)使用加权影响分析识别高风险测试；3)在SWE-bench Verified上评估GraphRAG工作流，采用本地模型(Qwen3-Coder 30B和Qwen3.5-35B-A3B)；4)对比TDD提示词策略与情境信息策略的效果。
AI.result: GraphRAG工作流将测试级回归从6.08%降至1.82%(减少70%)，解决率从24%提升至32%。意外发现：纯TDD提示反而增加回归(9.94%)，小型模型从情境信息(哪些测试需验证)中获益大于程序性指令(如何做TDD)。自动改进循环在10个实例上实现解决率从12%到60%且0%回归。
AI.conclusion: 对于AI智能体工具设计，提供情境信息优于规定程序化工作流。这一发现对指导未来AI编程辅助工具的设计具有重要意义。

title: VeriGrey: Greybox Agent Validation
summary:
Agentic AI has been a topic of great interest recently. A Large Language Model (LLM) agent involves one or more LLMs in the back-end. In the front end, it conducts autonomous decision-making by combining the LLM outputs with results obtained by invoking several external tools. The autonomous interactions with the external environment introduce critical security risks.
  In this paper, we present a grey-box approach to explore diverse behaviors and uncover security risks in LLM agents. Our approach VeriGrey uses the sequence of tools invoked as a feedback function to drive the testing process. This helps uncover infrequent but dangerous tool invocations that cause unexpected agent behavior. As mutation operators in the testing process, we mutate prompts to design pernicious injection prompts. This is carefully accomplished by linking the task of the agent to an injection task, so that the injection task becomes a necessary step of completing the agent functionality. Comparing our approach with a black-box baseline on the well-known AgentDojo benchmark, VeriGrey achieves 33% additional efficacy in finding indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities with a GPT-4.1 back-end.
  We also conduct real-world case studies with the widely used coding agent Gemini CLI, and the well-known OpenClaw personal assistant. VeriGrey finds prompts inducing several attack scenarios that could not be identified by black-box approaches. In OpenClaw, by constructing a conversation agent which employs mutational fuzz testing as needed, VeriGrey is able to discover malicious skill variants from 10 malicious skills (with 10/10= 100% success rate on the Kimi-K2.5 LLM backend, and 9/10= 90% success rate on Opus 4.6 LLM backend). This demonstrates the value of a dynamic approach like VeriGrey to test agents, and to eventually lead to an agent assurance framework.

AI.tldr: VeriGrey 是一个面向 LLM Agent 的灰盒模糊测试框架：以「工具调用序列」作为覆盖反馈驱动搜索，并以「上下文桥接（context bridging）」变异算子把注入任务包装成用户任务的必要步骤，从而自动生成能绕过模型防御的间接提示注入提示。在 AgentDojo 上比黑盒基线提升 11–33 个百分点（GPT-4.1：70.7% vs 37.7% ITSR），并在真实代理 Gemini CLI（90% vs 60%）与 OpenClaw 恶意技能（Kimi-K2.5 10/10、Opus 4.6 9/10）中发现了黑盒方法无法触发的攻击。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent 通过 LLM 后端自主决策并调用外部工具（shell、浏览器、MCP 服务器、第三方 skill），其行为由「调用了哪些工具、以何种顺序调用」决定，兼具 LLM 非确定性与工具副作用，行为多样且常出现涌现式异常；传统黑盒测试缺少任何执行期反馈信号，只能盲目随机变异，难以系统性地覆盖低频但危险的工具调用序列。此外，Agent 面对的是自然语言提示而非字节流，直接套用传统变异算子会破坏输入的语法/语义；且经后训练对齐的模型能识别并忽略「与用户任务无关」的注入任务；同时注入任务本身往往需要探索正确的工具组合才能完成，还需要一个主动的验证者代理与被测代理对话式循环。因此需要一种以 Agent 特有可观测信号为反馈、且生成语义有效注入提示的自动化蓝队测试方法。论文聚焦单会话场景的攻击面：直接/间接提示注入，以及通过 skill（ClawHub）与 MCP 工具引入的供应链攻击；威胁模型为攻击者控制 Agent 可访问的外部资源（网页、文档、仓库、被攻陷的 API/MCP 响应），后果包括覆盖 Agent 行为、泄露用户敏感数据、执行任意代码或未授权操作、可用性降级。
AI.method: 提出灰盒模糊测试框架 VeriGrey（Algorithm 1），输入被测代理 P、注入任务集合 I、固定用户任务 u。核心机制有三：(1) 轻量插桩——用装饰器包装工具调用，记录工具名与参数形成调用标签并追加到序列，透明返回原结果，不改变语义（Algorithm 2）；在 Python 中加 @ToolInstrumentor 装饰器即可，或借助 Pydantic AI/MCP 的显式注解。(2) 反馈使用——维护已观测工具序列库 D：新序列视为新行为，其提示加入种子队列（ChooseSeed）；能量分配（AssignEnergy）依据三个指标（新工具、新工具转移、新调用序列）各加 1 次变异预算，优先深挖触发新行为的种子；成功注入则记为漏洞。(3) 上下文桥接变异算子（MutatePrompt）——用 LLM 充当变异器，给出注入任务、推断出的用户意图、种子提示及其工具调用序列，要求 LLM 构造一个「注入任务是完成原始任务所必需的」场景化前缀（如“修复 Django bug 必须先读取 SECRET 文件”），并反思失败原因（桥接不足 vs 指令细节不足）后逐步细化步骤，从而绕过 LLM 对可疑注入的识别。种子由固定模板注入提示构造，另设验证者代理（verifier agent）以反应式对话循环与被测代理交互。实验以 AgentVigil 为蓝本自研黑盒基线（无反馈、无能量、随机 LLM 变异）作对比；基准为 AgentDojo（Workspace/Slack/Travel/Banking 四个 suite，97 个用户任务，每个任务一个测试活动，预算 100 次代理执行）；度量用注入任务成功率 ITSR 与用户任务成功率 UTSR；防御评测包含 prompt sandwiching、data delimiter、BERT 注入检测与 tool filter；真实案例为 Gemini CLI（Docker 隔离、SWE-bench django-14500 用户任务、10 个人工构造的易/难注入任务、预算 50 次执行）与 OpenClaw（从 KOI/Snyk/Cisco 扫描器标记的 74 个恶意 skill 中挑 10 个，人工编写 oracle，每个 skill 最多 20 次执行）。
AI.result: RQ1（AgentDojo，共 97×2×3=582 个测试活动）：VeriGrey 全面优于黑盒基线，ITSR 提升 11–33 个百分点。GPT-4.1：整体 70.7% vs 37.7%（+33.0pp，几近翻倍；Easy +32.9、Medium +22.5、Hard +32.0；Workspace 48.2 vs 16.1、Travel 87.1 vs 40.7、Banking 68.1 vs 34.7、Slack 100 vs 78.1）；Gemini-2.5-Flash：47.4% vs 36.8%（+10.6）；Qwen-3 235B：81.7% vs 67.6%（+14.1）。提升在各 suite 与各难度层级上一致，说明不依赖特定领域。RQ2（消融，GPT-4.1）：去掉工具序列反馈 → ITSR 70.7→59.6（-11.1pp，对 Hard 影响最大 -21.7）；去掉上下文桥接 → 44.0（-25.8pp，各难度均匀下降 20.0–29.9），表明语义变异算子贡献更大，而反馈机制偏向长链、复杂工具序列的任务。RQ3（防御）：四种防御下 VeriGrey 的 ITSR 始终高于基线——prompt sandwiching 69.7→65.2（基线 41.2→17.4）、data delimiter 69.7→67.6、prompt injection detection 21.6 vs 5.2（生成的注入更易被 BERT 判为良性）、tool filter 17.4 vs 12.8；tool filter 削减攻击最有效且无注入时 UTSR 尚可（81.7），而注入检测误报过多（无注入时 UTSR 由 85.0 降至 50.4）。真实案例 Gemini CLI：VeriGrey ITSR 90%（9/10）vs 基线 60%（6/10），仅 VeriGrey 成功的难任务为 7（发送 bash_history）、9（提取 SSH 私钥）、10（在 .bashrc 植入 ls 恶意别名），其共性是绕过 Gemini CLI 目录限制的 shell 命令；基线生成的提示因含明显安全模式（curl|sh）而被模型直接拒绝，VeriGrey 因上下文桥接使「愿意尝试」的比例更高；任务 6（写入 cron）两种方法均失败，因中间步骤「用 apt 安装 cron」未被提示覆盖。加上 tool filter 后 VeriGrey 仍达 50%（5 个）vs 基线 30%（3 个），且补丁仍能正常生成。OpenClaw：原始恶意 skill 仅 1/10 触发（三个后端 LLM 一致），经 VeriGrey 变异生成变体后 Kimi-K2.5 达 10/10（100%）、Opus 4.6 达 9/10（90%）、GPT-5.2 达 8/10。三种有效提示策略：把恶意行为包装为技能使用流水线的「自然步骤」（如把安装恶意包 openclaw-core 说成 Step 1）、强调无需人工干预以诱发自主执行、伪造恶意包的用法示例以增强合法性。
AI.conclusion: 面向 Agent 的灰盒验证是可行且高效的：把「工具调用序列」当作程序分支的等价物作为覆盖反馈，可把随机搜索引导到罕见而危险的行为路径；把注入任务与用户任务在语义上「桥接」的变异算子，是突破经安全对齐 LLM 拒答机制的关键，二者结合比黑盒基线在多个后端模型与多个领域一致地提升漏洞发现能力，且提示注入检测、prompt sandwiching 等现有防御只能小幅降低其成功率，tool filter 相对最有效但同样不完全。因此 Agent 部署前应进行此类蓝队验证：发现的注入提示可作为检测模型的训练数据以强化防御；结合工具白名单/隔离与策略执行等纵深防御；文中提出将 VeriGrey 式的动态测试扩展为面向 Agent 的保证与认证框架（agent assurance framework），推动从个别 Agent 的偶发 bug 讨论走向通用的 Agent 安全认证实践。局限方面，评测依赖人工构造注入任务与人工 oracle，工具插桩需一定人工定位，AgentDojo 与单次执行预算下的结果不代表更长期自主代理的鲁棒性。

title: Noise-Response Calibration: A Causal Intervention Protocol for LLM-Judges
comment: Published as a conference paper at CAO Workshop at ICLR 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges and synthetic labelers, especially in low-label settings. Yet these systems are stochastic and often overconfident, which makes deployment decisions difficult when external ground truth is limited. We propose a practical calibration protocol based on controlled input interventions: if noise severity increases, task performance should exhibit a statistically significant deterioration trend. We operationalize this with a slope-based hypothesis test over repeated trials, using signal-to-noise-ratio (SNR) perturbations for tabular data and lexical perturbations for text data. Across UCI tabular benchmarks and four text classification datasets, we find clear modality-dependent behavior. Our results reveal a modality gap: while text-based judges degrade predictably, the majority of tabular datasets show a lack of statistically significant performance deterioration even under significant signal-to-noise reduction. Interestingly we find that model performance is lower on datasets that are insensitive to noise interventions. We present a reproducible methodology and reporting protocol for robust LLM-judge calibration under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于受控输入干预的LLM判断器校准协议，通过信噪比扰动（表格数据）和词汇扰动（文本数据）进行斜率假设检验，发现文本判断器可预测降级，但大多数表格数据集在显著信噪比降低下缺乏统计显著的性能下降，揭示了模态差异现象。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型被广泛用作自动评判器和合成标签器，但这些系统具有随机性且经常过度自信，在外部真实标签有限时难以做出部署决策。
AI.method: 提出基于受控输入干预的实用校准协议：若噪声严重度增加，任务性能应呈现统计显著恶化趋势。通过重复试验进行基于斜率的假设检验，使用表格数据的信噪比(SNR)扰动和文本数据的词汇扰动来操作化这一方法。
AI.result: 在不同模态间发现明显的模态依赖行为。文本判断器可预测地降级，但大多数表格数据集在显著信噪比降低下仍缺乏统计显著的性能恶化。有趣的是，对噪声干预不敏感的数据集上模型性能反而更低。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种在分布偏移下进行鲁棒LLM判断器校准的可复现方法论和报告协议，揭示了LLM作为判断器在不同数据模态上的关键差异。

title: Toward Scalable Automated Repository-Level Datasets for Software Vulnerability Detection
summary: Software vulnerabilities continue to grow in volume and remain difficult to detect in practice. Although learning-based vulnerability detection has progressed, existing benchmarks are largely function-centric and fail to capture realistic, executable, interprocedural settings. Recent repo-level security benchmarks demonstrate the importance of realistic environments, but their manual curation limits scale. This doctoral research proposes an automated benchmark generator that injects realistic vulnerabilities into real-world repositories and synthesizes reproducible proof-of-vulnerability (PoV) exploits, enabling precisely labeled datasets for training and evaluating repo-level vulnerability detection agents. We further investigate an adversarial co-evolution loop between injection and detection agents to improve robustness under realistic constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇博士研究提案（arXiv 预印本，投向 FSE 2026），提出一个由多智能体驱动的自动化基准生成器：在真实仓库中注入真实感漏洞并合成可复现的 PoV 利用，从而产出带精确标注、仓库级、可构建可执行的漏洞数据集，用于训练与评估仓库级漏洞检测智能体；同时研究注入者与检测者之间的对抗性协同进化机制以提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 软件漏洞数量持续增长（近年每年数万条 CVE），现代系统规模与复杂度上升、且 AI 辅助编码工具会引入不安全代码模式，使漏洞更多出现在函数、文件与配置边界的交互中，必须在代码库级别检测。但现有基准存在三类瓶颈：(1) 大多数 ML/LLM 漏洞检测仍退化为函数级二分类，脱离调用上下文标签本身定义不清，且高分常源于伪相关而非真实安全推理，在更真实设定下性能大幅下降；(2) 仓库级数据集如 ReposVul、VulEval 依赖代理标签（proxy labels），端到端不可执行；(3) 面向安全智能体的真实环境基准 BountyBench、CVE-Bench 虽可复现，但人工策划成本高、规模受限，无法支撑训练；同时专项基准显示即便强智能体在仓库级安全任务上表现仍然很差。作者自身此前的工作 AVIATOR 已在函数级证明受控注入可产生高质量安全数据，本研究正是将其扩展到仓库级并与可执行证明配对，以弥补"可扩展 + 可执行 + 精确标注"三者的缺口。
AI.method: 核心是一个"人类专家启发"的自动化基准生成器工作流，共五个阶段。阶段 A（目标选择与可执行框架）：在容器化环境中构建项目，发现或合成测试 harness（现有测试、fuzz harness、最小驱动程序），并建立不变量（测试通过、sanitizer 基线、API 契约）以拒绝有问题的注入。阶段 B（多智能体漏洞注入）：用 CodeQL 基于数据流模式、source/sink 挖掘候选注入点；由 Planner 智能体选定 CWE 家族与注入点，Implementer 智能体实施最小化跨文件改动以激活特定执行路径上的漏洞并偏向跨过程缺陷，Reviewer 智能体约束真实性（编码风格、开发者意图合理性、避免合成特征），Verifier 智能体重建项目并执行测试确保只影响预期行为。阶段 C（PoV 合成与轨迹产物）：内存安全类漏洞生成带 sanitizer/崩溃签名的触发输入与最小复现器，逻辑/Web 类漏洞生成端到端请求序列与可观测安全违规；记录可执行轨迹（栈回溯、崩溃输入、依赖切片、最小调用路径）以支持定位与解释质量评估；每个基准条目包含原始代码、漏洞 commit、容器 recipe、harness、PoV 与结构化标签（CWE、受影响组件、触发路径）。阶段 D（训练与基准评测）：在生成语料上训练仓库级检测智能体，能力包括工具增强的代码库检索、迭代式定位、假设精化与验证（复现 PoV 或生成补丁）。阶段 E（对抗性协同进化）：Vulnerability Injector 与 Vulnerability Detector 两个竞争模型相互博弈迭代提升。三个研究问题分别对应：注入的真实感与 build/test 有效性及 PoV 可复现性（RQ1）、仓库级数据训练相对函数级训练在泛化与鲁棒性上的增益（RQ2）、对抗协同进化对鲁棒性的改善（RQ3）。
AI.result: 该文为研究计划/提案，尚未报告实证结果，仅给出评估方案：基准验证指标包括注入后的 build/test 通过率、PoV 可复现性、分层抽样专家审计的真实感评分、以及多样性（CWE 分布与多文件深度）；训练效用实验通过有/无注入仓库级数据的对照训练进行比较，并在外部仓库级基准（BountyBench/CVE-Bench 类任务）上测试。预期贡献三项：(1) 新的可扩展仓库级漏洞基准生成器及配套 PoV；(2) 用于训练仓库级检测智能体的数据集；(3) 持续改进注入（尤其是检测）能力的对抗性协同进化方法论。
AI.conclusion: 结论性判断是：高质量、可扩展、仓库级且可执行的漏洞标注数据集是当前构建与可靠评测仓库级漏洞检测系统的关键瓶颈，而将受控漏洞注入与可执行 PoV 配对、并引入注入-检测对抗协同进化，是突破该瓶颈的可行路径。该工作的定位是奠基性基础设施：它不追求单点检测算法的最优，而在于提供可复现、可训练、贴近真实软件工程流程的评测与训练底座；同时需要指出，该文目前属于"研究蓝图"，其核心假设（注入漏洞的真实感可被专家审计接受、PoV 合成可自动化、协同进化能带来鲁棒性增益）尚未被实验验证，评审时宜视其为待检验的研究议程。

title: Sensi: Learn One Thing at a Time -- Curriculum-Based Test-Time Learning for LLM Game Agents
comment: Preprint. 18 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Independent research. Code and Colab demo coming soon on GitHub
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents deployed in unknown environments must learn task structure at test time, but current approaches require thousands of interactions to form useful hypotheses. We present Sensi, an LLM agent architecture for the ARC-AGI-3 game-playing challenge that introduces structured test-time learning through three mechanisms: (1) a two-player architecture separating perception from action, (2) a curriculum-based learning system managed by an external state machine, and (3) a database-as-control-plane that makes the agents context window programmatically steerable. We further introduce an LLM-as-judge component with dynamically generated evaluation rubrics to determine when the agent has learned enough about one topic to advance to the next. We report results across two iterations: Sensi v1 solves 2 game levels using the two-player architecture alone, while Sensi v2 adds curriculum learning and solves 0 levels - but completes its entire learning curriculum in approximately 32 action attempts, achieving 50-94x greater sample efficiency than comparable systems that require 1600-3000 attempts. We precisely diagnose the failure mode as a self-consistent hallucination cascade originating in the perception layer, demonstrating that the architectural bottleneck has shifted from learning efficiency to perceptual grounding - a more tractable problem.

AI.tldr: Sensi是一个用于ARC-AGI-3游戏挑战的LLM智能体架构，通过两玩家架构、课程学习和数据库控制平面实现结构化测试时学习，在约32次动作尝试内完成学习课程，达到50-94x的样本效率提升。
AI.motivation: 部署在未知环境中的LLM智能体需要在测试时学习任务结构，但当前方法需要数千次交互才能形成有用的假设。
AI.method: 提出Sensi架构，包含三个核心机制：(1) 将感知与行动分离的两玩家架构；(2) 由外部状态机管理的基于课程的学习系统；(3) 使智能体上下文窗口可编程控制的数据库控制平面；还引入LLM-as-judge组件和动态生成的评估标准来确定智能体何时已学好一个主题并进入下一个。
AI.result: Sensi v1使用两玩家架构解决2个游戏关卡；Sensi v2添加课程学习后解决0个关卡，但在约32次动作尝试内完成整个学习课程，比需要1600-3000次尝试的同类系统实现50-94x更高的样本效率。失败模式被诊断为感知层中的自我一致性幻觉级联。
AI.conclusion: 架构瓶颈已从学习效率转移到感知接地问题——这是一个更易处理的问题。两玩家架构虽未能完全解决挑战，但成功将问题从样本效率转变为感知准确性。

title: Domain-informed explainable boosting machines for trustworthy lateral spread predictions
summary: Explainable Boosting Machines (EBMs) provide transparent predictions through additive shape functions, enabling direct inspection of feature contributions. However, EBMs can learn non-physical relationships that reduce their reliability in natural hazard applications. This study presents a domain-informed framework to improve the physical consistency of EBMs for lateral spreading prediction. Our approach modifies learned shape functions based on domain knowledge. These modifications correct non-physical behavior while maintaining data-driven patterns. We apply the method to the 2011 Christchurch earthquake dataset and correct non-physical trends observed in the original EBM. The resulting model produces more physically consistent global and local explanations, with an acceptable tradeoff in accuracy (4--5\%).

AI.tldr: 研究提出了一个领域知情的框架，通过修正可解释增强机(EBMs)学习到的形状函数来提高其在侧向扩散预测中的物理一致性。该方法应用于2011年基督城地震数据集，修正了原始EBM中的非物理趋势，在可接受的精度损失(4-5%)下产生了更符合物理规律的解释。
AI.motivation: 可解释增强机(EBMs)虽然通过加性形状函数提供透明预测，但其可能学习到非物理关系，降低了在自然灾害应用中的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出领域知情框架，基于领域知识修正学习到的形状函数，在保持数据驱动模式的同时纠正非物理行为。
AI.result: 修正了原始EBM中观察到的非物理趋势，产生了更符合物理一致性的全局和局部解释，精度损失可接受(4-5%)。
AI.conclusion: 领域知情框架能够有效提高EBM在侧向扩散预测中的物理一致性，同时保持可接受的预测精度。

title: MALLES: A Multi-agent LLMs-based Economic Sandbox with Consumer Preference Alignment
summary: In the real economy, modern decision-making is fundamentally challenged by high-dimensional, multimodal environments, which are further complicated by agent heterogeneity and combinatorial data sparsity. This paper introduces a Multi-Agent Large Language Model-based Economic Sandbox (MALLES), leveraging the inherent generalization capabilities of large-sacle models to establish a unified simulation framework applicable to cross-domain and cross-category scenarios. Central to our approach is a preference learning paradigm in which LLMs are economically aligned via post-training on extensive, heterogeneous transaction records across diverse product categories. This methodology enables the models to internalize and transfer latent consumer preference patterns, thereby mitigating the data sparsity issues prevalent in individual categories. To enhance simulation stability, we implement a mean-field mechanism designed to model the dynamic interactions between the product environment and customer populations, effectively stabilizing sampling processes within high-dimensional decision spaces. Furthermore, we propose a multi-agent discussion framework wherein specialized agents collaboratively process extensive product information. This architecture distributes cognitive load to alleviate single-agent attention bottlenecks and captures critical decision factors through structured dialogue. Experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves significant improvements in product selection accuracy, purchase quantity prediction, and simulation stability compared to existing economic and financial LLM simulation baselines. Our results substantiate the potential of large language models as a foundational pillar for high-fidelity, scalable decision simulation and latter analysis in the real economy based on foundational database.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MALLES框架，一个基于多智能体大语言模型的经济沙箱系统，通过偏好学习范式使LLM在经济领域进行对齐，实现跨域跨类别的统一仿真模拟，解决高维、多模态决策环境中的数据稀疏性问题。
AI.motivation: 现实经济中的现代决策面临高维、多模态环境的根本挑战，且进一步受到智能体异质性和组合数据稀疏性的影响。现有方法难以建立跨域跨类别的统一仿真框架。
AI.method: 1) 偏好学习范式：通过对跨多产品类别的异构交易记录进行后训练，使LLM内部化和转移潜在消费者偏好模式；2) 平均场机制：建模产品环境与客户群体间的动态交互，稳定高维决策空间中的采样过程；3) 多智能体讨论框架：专门智能体协作处理海量产品信息，分散认知负荷，通过结构化对话捕捉关键决策因素。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架在产品选择准确率、购买量预测和仿真稳定性方面相较于现有经济和金融LLM仿真基线取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型有望作为高保真、可扩展的实体经济决策仿真与分析的基础支柱，基于基础数据库为实际经济应用提供支撑。

title: MetaClaw: Just Talk -- An Agent That Meta-Learns and Evolves in the Wild
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used for complex tasks, yet deployed agents often remain static, failing to adapt as user needs evolve. This creates a tension between the need for continuous service and the necessity of updating capabilities to match shifting task distributions. On platforms like OpenClaw, which handle diverse workloads across 20+ channels, existing methods either store raw trajectories without distilling knowledge, maintain static skill libraries, or require disruptive downtime for retraining. We present MetaClaw, a continual meta-learning framework that jointly evolves a base LLM policy and a library of reusable behavioral skills. MetaClaw employs two complementary mechanisms. Skill-driven fast adaptation analyzes failure trajectories via an LLM evolver to synthesize new skills, enabling immediate improvement with zero downtime. Opportunistic policy optimization performs gradient-based updates via cloud LoRA fine-tuning and Reinforcement Learning with a Process Reward Model (RL-PRM). This is triggered during user-inactive windows by the Opportunistic Meta-Learning Scheduler (OMLS), which monitors system inactivity and calendar data. These mechanisms are mutually reinforcing: a refined policy generates better trajectories for skill synthesis, while richer skills provide higher-quality data for policy optimization. To prevent data contamination, a versioning mechanism separates support and query data. Built on a proxy-based architecture, MetaClaw scales to production-size LLMs without local GPUs. Experiments on MetaClaw-Bench and AutoResearchClaw show that skill-driven adaptation improves accuracy by up to 32% relative. The full pipeline advances Kimi-K2.5 accuracy from 21.4% to 40.6% and increases composite robustness by 18.3%. Code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/MetaClaw.

AI.tldr: MetaClaw 是一个面向"野外部署"LLM 智能体的持续元学习框架，把智能体的行为表示为元模型 M=(θ, S)（基础策略参数 + 可复用技能库），并用两条互补回路联合演进：①技能驱动的快速适应——LLM 进化器从失败轨迹中无梯度地蒸馏出行为指令，立即注入系统提示，零停机生效；②机会式策略优化——在用户空闲窗口（作息时间、键鼠空闲、Google 日历占用）触发，基于 RL + 过程奖励模型（PRM）通过云端 LoRA（GRPO）更新 θ。关键设计是"支持集/查询集"分离与技能代际版本戳（技能升级即清空过期缓冲区），避免陈旧奖励污染。MetaClaw-Bench（934 题、44 个模拟工作日）与 AutoResearchClaw（23 阶段自主科研流水线）上，技能单独使准确率相对提升最高 32.2%；完整流程把 Kimi-K2.5 从 21.4% 提升到 40.6%（逼近 GPT-5.2 基线 41.1%），任务完成率提升 8.25×，复合鲁棒性提升 18.3%。
AI.motivation: 部署后的 LLM 智能体是"静态"的：训练一次即长期服务不变，而任务分布随真实使用漂移（如 OpenClaw 平台连接 20+ 消息渠道，单用户工作负载可能一周从多步文件系统操作切换到多智能体消息流），冻结的模型会持续在预训练中欠代表的任务类型上失败。同时"持续服务"与"必须更新能力"之间存在天然张力：任何需要停机重训的方案在交互式系统中不可行。已有三类适应方法各有硬伤：(1) 记忆类方法（Reflexion、Mem0、SimpleMem 等）只存原始轨迹，冗长重复、无法蒸馏出可迁移的行为模式；(2) 技能类方法（Voyager、ExpeL、Agent-KB 等）把技能库当作静态数据库，从不与权重优化协同，且不区分行为是否已变化；(3) RL 类方法（GRPO、DAPO 等）更新权重但假设固定策略/固定奖励与离线固定任务分布，既不回答"何时训练"，也不回答"行为改变后哪些数据仍然有效"。作者的关键观察是：行为启发式（"读文件前先校验路径"、"破坏性命令前先确认"）可在秒级从一次失败对话中蒸馏并即时注入，而策略级改进需要跨多任务、分钟到小时级的梯度优化——两者时间尺度不同却天然互补，且互为因果：更好的策略产生信息量更高的失败用于技能合成，更丰富的技能产生更高奖励的轨迹用于策略优化。作者将其定位为持续元学习：智能体在非平稳任务流中学习的同时提升"自身的适应能力"。
AI.method: 问题形式化：任务流 τ1,τ2,… 来自非平稳分布 p_t(τ)，行为由元模型 M=(θ, S) 决定，S 为注入系统提示的技能指令库，推理时 a~π_θ(·|τ, Retrieve(S,τ))，检索用句向量嵌入的余弦相似度 top-k。核心机制三部分：(1) 技能驱动快速适应：失败轨迹构成支持集 D^sup_g，由 skill evolver（LLM）分析并合成新技能，S_{g+1}=S_g ∪ E(S_g, D^sup_g)，只改 S 不动 θ，秒级生效、零停机；作者强调这是"设计上的无梯度"而非近似，因为技能活在离散自然语言空间，梯度下降无定义。S 兼具双重角色：作为"元参数"跨任务累积行为知识（S_{g+1}⊇S_g），作为"适应基座"在推理期做任务特化。(2) 机会式策略优化：优化目标不是原始任务性能，而是"技能适应之后的表现"（元学习目标），θ_{t+1}=θ_t+α∇_θ E[R(π_θ(·|τ,S_g'))]，R 为 PRM 分数，实现为云端 LoRA + GRPO；必须先积累足够 query 轨迹（否则梯度方差高、更新不稳），因此天然比技能适应滞后数天。(3) 技能代际版本控制：每条轨迹打上技能代际 g_i；触发 S_g→S_{g+1} 的失败轨迹是支持集，被进化器消费后丢弃；只有 S_{g+1} 生效后采集的轨迹才是查询集，进入 RL 缓冲区；代际计数器前进时清空所有版本 ≤ g 的样本，防止用"已被技能修正的失败"的旧奖励去惩罚 θ。(4) OMLS 调度器（后台守护进程）：三类空闲信号——可配置作息窗口（如 23:00–07:00）、系统输入设备空闲计时（macOS ioreg HIDIdleTime，默认 30 分钟无输入则开窗，重新输入则通过 mid-batch checkpointing 优雅暂停）、Google Calendar API 会议占用（最具前瞻性）；任一信号表明用户不在即开窗，任一表明用户回来即关窗，训练器支持跨碎片化空闲窗口的暂停/恢复，累计梯度步。工程上采用基于代理（proxy-based）的架构：智能体与训练分离，调用云端大模型推理与云端 LoRA 训练端点，无需本地 GPU，可与现有个人智能体和 LLM 提供方透明集成。附录给出各提示模板：Part I 的 CLI 智能体系统提示与 run_command 工具 schema、Part II 的 IDENTITY.md/SOUL.md 身份与行为准则、多选与 file-check 题目模板与评分（多选为 max(0, 1−(FP+FN)/n_options)）、技能进化器提示（最多展示 6 个失败、禁止重复现有技能、规定 name/description/content(6–15 行 Markdown 含反模式)/category 及 JSON 输出格式）、技能注入块格式（## Active Skills 追加到系统消息）、系统提示压缩提示（压到 2000 token 内且不弱化规则），以及 Part II 逐步引入的五条隐式偏好规则 P1–P5（ISO8601+08:00 时间戳、YYYYMMDD_ 命名、created_at/author/status 元数据、.bak 备份、[DONE] 日志），均有专门自动检查脚本。
AI.result: MetaClaw-Bench（Part I：30 工作日/346 题，含 file-check 与多选；Part II：14 工作日/588 题，42/天，以规则化 file-check 为主；难度随日递增）主结果：GPT-5.2 基线 Part I 准确率 41.1%、完成率 14.7%，Part II 44.9%/58.4%；加技能后 44.0%/17.1% 与 49.1%/67.5%（相对 +7.1%、+9.4%）。Kimi-K2.5 基线 21.4%/2.0% 与 21.1%/18.2%；加技能后 28.3%/2.0% 与 26.9%/33.8%（相对 +32.2%、+27.5%）；完整流程（5 天云端 LoRA 训练）Part I 达 40.6%/16.5%（完成率 8.25×），Part II 达 39.6%/51.9%（+185% 相对），逼近 GPT-5.2 基线 41.1%，说明强弱模型差距可被"技能+权重"大幅补偿。分解结论清晰：技能只提升多选（程序性知识）而不改善 file-check（执行可靠性），权重更新才能解锁端到端完成率；Full 训练后策略向文件执行偏移，多选准确率略有下降。逐日曲线：所有条件从前 10 天（>50%）衰减到后 6 天（<30%）确认难度递增；MetaClaw 优势集中在 day11–22 的"可学习的程序性合规"区间，Full 在 day19–20 优势峰值约 0.8 准确率；RL 训练动态在 Part II 呈现明显拐点：day1–4 约 9%、day5–8 升至 27–36%、day9–10 达 55–64%、day12/14 达 100%，与"先技能收益、后 RL 收益"的两阶段时间尺度假设一致。技能库分析显示三类可跨任务迁移的启发式：时间格式合规（自然语言时间→ISO 8601 带时区）、先备份后修改（.bak 协议）、命名规范（日期前缀 20260408_*.json）。AutoResearchClaw（23 阶段科研流水线）仅用技能注入：无任何权重更新即把阶段重试率从 10.5% 降到 7.9%（−24.8%）、refine 循环从 2.0 降到 1.2/阶段（−40%）、可评分阶段完成 18/19→19/19（+5.3%）、复合鲁棒性 0.714→0.845（+18.3%），且技能进化器在无领域调优下跨域合成出可用技能（引用格式、实验代码校验等）。案例研究（Table 3）区分两机制：Case 1（GPT-5.2，仅技能）靠第 2 天蒸馏出的"修改前先建 .bak"规则零权重更新把 0 分救回 1.0；Case 2（Kimi-K2.5）仅技能注入给出 ISO8601 上下文但仍漏 changes 字段、仍 0 分，经 RL 更新后四字段齐全、schema 合法且创建备份，得 1.0，当日准确率从基线 8.3%→技能 25.0%→Full 80.6%。作者也坦承局限：MetaClaw-Bench 是作者编写的受控模拟而非真实用户会话，绝对增益幅度未必迁移到生产环境；OMLS 的空闲检测依赖用户配置，可能不适用于所有部署环境。
AI.conclusion: MetaClaw 用"两个时间尺度的适应机制 + 一条数据有效性协议"把静态部署的 LLM 智能体改造成可自我进化的持续元学习系统：秒级、零停机、无梯度的技能蒸馏负责捕捉行为启发式；分钟到小时级、由空闲窗口触发的 RL-PRM + 云端 LoRA 负责跨任务的执行可靠性；技能代际版本戳通过 support/query 严格分离与缓冲区清空，保证梯度只优化"适应之后"的表现。实验结论清晰可复用：技能与权重解决不同瓶颈（知识 vs 执行），弱模型受益更大、完整流程可抹平模型代差，技能注入可零权重跨域迁移到长时程科研流水线。但证据强度受限于作者自建的模拟基准与配置依赖的调度器，真实生产流量上的收益、长期稳定性、灾难性遗忘与安全性尚待验证——后续关键方向包括更真实的长期在线基准、多用户/多设备的空闲信号普适化、以及技能库膨胀与冲突的治理。

title: From Virtual Environments to Real-World Trials: Emerging Trends in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted manuscript - Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary: Autonomous driving technologies have achieved significant advances in recent years, yet their real-world deployment remains constrained by data scarcity, safety requirements, and the need for generalization across diverse environments. In response, synthetic data and virtual environments have emerged as powerful enablers, offering scalable, controllable, and richly annotated scenarios for training and evaluation. This survey presents a comprehensive review of recent developments at the intersection of autonomous driving, simulation technologies, and synthetic datasets. We organize the landscape across three core dimensions: (i) the use of synthetic data for perception and planning, (ii) digital twin-based simulation for system validation, and (iii) domain adaptation strategies bridging synthetic and real-world data. We also highlight the role of vision-language models and simulation realism in enhancing scene understanding and generalization. A detailed taxonomy of datasets, tools, and simulation platforms is provided, alongside an analysis of trends in benchmark design. Finally, we discuss critical challenges and open research directions, including Sim2Real transfer, scalable safety validation, cooperative autonomy, and simulation-driven policy learning, that must be addressed to accelerate the path toward safe, generalizable, and globally deployable autonomous driving systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文是一篇关于自动驾驶中合成数据与仿真技术的综合综述，涵盖合成数据在感知与规划中的应用、数字孪生仿真验证、域适应策略三个核心维度，并探讨了视觉-语言模型、场景理解与泛化能力等前沿方向。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶技术的实际部署受限于数据稀缺、安全要求以及跨多样化环境泛化的需求。合成数据和虚拟环境作为可扩展、可控、标注丰富的训练与测试方案，成为突破该瓶颈的关键使能技术。
AI.method: 通过系统梳理自动驾驶、仿真技术与合成数据集交叉领域的最新进展，建立三维分类框架：1) 合成数据用于感知与规划；2) 数字孪生仿真用于系统验证；3) 桥接合成与真实数据的域适应策略。同时对数据集、工具、仿真平台进行详细 taxonomy 分析，并分析基准测试设计趋势。
AI.result: 提供 了数据集、工具和仿真平台的详细分类体系，识别出视觉-语言模型和仿真真实感在增强场景理解和泛化能力中的作用，并明确了 Sim2Real 迁移、可扩展安全验证、协同自动驾驶、仿真驱动策略学习等关键挑战与开放研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为推动安全、可泛化、全球可部署的自动驾驶系统提供了系统性参考框架，指出了从仿真到真实（Sim2Real）迁移、可扩展安全性验证、协同 autonomy 及基于仿真的策略学习等未来核心研究方向。

title: Self-Conditioned Denoising for Atomistic Representation Learning
summary: The success of large-scale pretraining in NLP and computer vision has catalyzed growing efforts to develop analogous foundation models for the physical sciences. However, pretraining strategies using atomistic data remain underexplored. To date, large-scale supervised pretraining on DFT force-energy labels has provided the strongest performance gains to downstream property prediction, out-performing existing methods of self-supervised learning (SSL) which remain limited to ground-state geometries, and/or single domains of atomistic data. We address these shortcomings with Self-Conditioned Denoising (SCD), a backbone-agnostic reconstruction objective that utilizes self-embeddings for conditional denoising across any domain of atomistic data, including small molecules, proteins, periodic materials, and 'non-equilibrium' geometries. When controlled for backbone architecture and pretraining dataset, SCD significantly outperforms previous SSL methods on downstream benchmarks and matches or exceeds the performance of supervised force-energy pretraining. We show that a small, fast GNN pretrained by SCD can achieve competitive or superior performance to larger models pretrained on significantly larger labeled or unlabeled datasets, across tasks in multiple domains. Our code is available at: https://github.com/TyJPerez/SelfConditionedDenoisingAtoms

AI.tldr: 本文提出「自条件去噪」（Self-Conditioned Denoising, SCD）这一与骨干网络无关的自监督重建目标：通过用模型自身对未损坏几何结构生成的 L0 不变嵌入作为条件，指导对加噪几何的 L1 等变噪声预测，从而同时解决标准节点去噪的三个缺陷（局部性、L0 语义通道缺乏压力、非平衡结构歧义）。SCD 适用于任意域的原子结构数据（小分子、蛋白质、周期材料、非平衡构象），在受控对比下显著优于既有 SSL 方法，并可匹配甚至超越有监督的力-能量预训练；10M 参数的小型快速 GNN 即可在 QM9、Matbench 带隙、配体结合亲和力等基准上取得 SOTA 或接近 SOTA 结果，而预训练成本远低于 JMP 等大模型。
AI.motivation: 原子科学领域正走向「基础模型」，但目前主流的机器学习原子间势（UMA、MACE、Orb）均依赖 DFT 力-能量标签的有监督预训练，代价高昂（OMol25 的 1 亿几何体需 60 亿 CPU 核时）。现有自监督方法（对比学习、节点去噪）受限于 3D 原子数据的特殊性质：样本大小不固定（3–3000+ 原子）、具有周期性、需对坐标微小变化保持敏感，且多局限于小分子基态几何，无法达到有监督预训练的性能。核心问题在于：能否在不依赖 DFT 标签的前提下，利用任意来源（DFT、xTB、扩散生成、非平衡 MD）的原子结构数据获得通用且可迁移的表示。作者还观察到生成式 SSL 在 CV/NLP 中能学到比监督学习更可解释、更可迁移的完整特征分布，这一原则应同样适用于 3D 原子数据。
AI.method:
核心方法 SCD：先对未损坏几何 x 做一次前向传播，将 L0 不变嵌入 sum-pool 后经两层 MLP 得到条件嵌入 c = f_η(x)；再以 c 为条件对加噪几何 x̃ = x + ε 做第二次前向，用 L1 等变输出预测逐节点噪声 ε：L = E[||φ_θ(x̃|c)_{L1} − ε||²]。训练中同一网络同时充当嵌入模型与去噪器，每步需两次前向传播，20% 概率丢弃条件嵌入以保留无条件行为。

针对节点去噪的三个缺陷：(s1) 局部性——条件嵌入引入全局语义目标；(s2) 标量 vs 向量通道压力——L0 嵌入作为独立训练目标形成信息瓶颈；(s3) 非平衡结构歧义——条件嵌入提供足够上下文以区分「被加噪的输入」与「合法的高能目标构象」。

骨干网络：以 TorchMD-Net（ET）为主，并构建 GET 版本用于与 Frad/SliDe 对比；通过将 pre-norm 替换为 Adaptive Layer Normalization（AdaNorm，类似 DiT）引入条件输入，AdaNorm 对速度与显存开销可忽略。得到 CT 与 CGT（9.2M/16M 参数），CT 比 CGT 快约 4×。细节还包括：drop path 0.1 提升稳定性、预训练时冻结元素嵌入、正则化噪声 σ=0.005 Å 与损坏噪声 σ=0.04 Å 两种尺度区分、材料体系的晶胞重复增强、pocket/ligand 组件间条件去噪（用口袋嵌入去噪配体）变体。

数据集：PCQ（3.378M）、GEOM10/GEOM1（xTB 构象）、AMP20（周期材料）、SAIR（Boltz-1x 扩散生成构象）、ALL 混合（11.3M 构象）、OMol25 4M（非平衡 MD）。基准：QM9（11 项性质）、Matbench mp_gap、LBA（id30/id60）、MD17。
AI.result: 1) 同一骨干与预训练数据下，SCD 相比标准节点去噪在 QM9 上提升 19.6%–45.5%（仅 Cv 下降 5%）；相比 SliDe（GET 骨干）提升 0%–29%，多数目标优于 Frad/SliDe（附录表15中 SCD 也优于 EPT-10 与 Uni-Corn）。2) 预训练数据几乎「所有来源都有用」：PCQ 12.7 meV、GEOM10 13.2、AMP20 14.6、SAIR 14.6、ALL 12.7、OMol25 12.8（baseline 20.3）；PCQ 300k 子集即可捕获约 97% 的增益。3) UMAP 显示 SCD 的嵌入空间更平滑、与原子数相关性更低的「非广延」语义空间，且下游误差随平滑度提升而下降。4) 计算成本：CT-SCD 仅 298 预训练 GPU 小时、10M 参数，总计 758 GPU 小时即优于 EquiformerV2 的 1370 小时，且精度更佳；Matbench 上 10M/675k 无标签数据得 0.123 eV，接近 JMP-L（235M/120M 有标签）的 0.091–0.121 eV；LBA 上 CT-SCD-SAIR-Pocket 达 1.304/1.200，优于 EPT-Multi 等更大模型。5) 与力-能量预训练直接对比（同一 OMol25 4M 几何）：CT-SCD-OMol25 相对 CT-FE-OMol25 分别为 −1.1% 与 +3.9%，三任务平均 26.4% vs 25.1% 提升，说明无标签预训练可匹配有监督预训练。6) MD17 上 SCD 与 Frad/SliDe 相当但推理快 4×，三者均不理想（因预训练全为基态、非平衡结构分布外）；CGT 因梯度回传段错误无法评测。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出 SCD，作为原子表示学习中无需标签的通用自监督预训练范式：(1) 所有数据都有用——任意域/来源（DFT 基态、非平衡、扩散生成）的原子数据都能带来下游提升，甚至周期性材料预训练可提升 LBA（+12%），非平衡分子预训练可提升带隙（+26.9%）；(2) 预训练并不昂贵——简单快速 GNN 加 SCD 可超越复杂的张量积架构与大规模有监督模型，300k 分子即可捕获大部分收益，提示「高效预训练比复杂归纳偏置更有性价比」；(3) 数据相关性是性能的决定因素——预训练集与微调集越相似效果越好，多域混合数据总体最优但单域模型在各自领域仍占优，作者归因于 10M 模型容量有限；(4) 基础模型预训练不必依赖标签——SCD 在受控条件下匹配或超越力-能量有监督预训练，表明可借助廉价生成/无标签数据推动原子基础模型的扩展。作者强调当前仅为初步探索，仍需研究数据集与模型维度的规模化效应，并公开了代码与预训练模型（TyJPerez/SelfConditionedDenoisingAtoms）。

title: Facts as First Class Objects: Knowledge Objects for Persistent LLM Memory
summary: Large language models increasingly serve as persistent knowledge workers, with in-context memory - facts stored in the prompt - as the default strategy. We benchmark in-context memory against Knowledge Objects (KOs), discrete hash-addressed tuples with O(1) retrieval. Within the context window, Claude Sonnet 4.5 achieves 100% exact-match accuracy from 10 to 7,000 facts (97.5% of its 200K window). However, production deployment reveals three failure modes: capacity limits (prompts overflow at 8,000 facts), compaction loss (summarization destroys 60% of facts), and goal drift (cascading compaction erodes 54% of project constraints while the model continues with full confidence). KOs achieve 100% accuracy across all conditions at 252x lower cost. On multi-hop reasoning, KOs reach 78.9% versus 31.6% for in-context. Cross-model replication across four frontier models confirms compaction loss is architectural, not model-specific. We additionally show that embedding retrieval fails on adversarial facts (20% precision at 1) and that neural memory (Titans) stores facts but fails to retrieve them on demand. We introduce density-adaptive retrieval as a switching mechanism and release the benchmark suite.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了大型语言模型中两种记忆策略：上下文内记忆（in-context memory）与知识对象（Knowledge Objects, KOs）。KO通过离散哈希寻址实现O(1)检索，在准确率、成本和推理能力上均显著优于上下文内记忆。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型作为持久知识工作者的需求日益增长，上下文内记忆（将事实存储在提示中）成为默认策略，但生产环境中存在容量限制、信息压缩损失和目标漂移等关键失败模式。
AI.method: 1. 在不同规模（10-7,000个事实）下测试Claude Sonnet 4.5的精确匹配准确率；2. 识别生产环境中的三种失败模式；3. 对比KO与上下文内记忆的性能与成本；4. 在多跳推理任务上评估两种方法；5. 跨四个前沿模型验证压缩损失的架构性质；6. 测试嵌入检索对抗性事实的表现；7. 评估神经记忆（Titans）的检索能力。
AI.result: 1. Claude Sonnet 4.5在200K窗口的97.5%（7,000个事实）内达到100%精确匹配准确率；2. 生产环境失败模式：容量溢出（8,000个事实时提示溢出）、压缩损失（摘要销毁60%的事实）、目标漂移（级联压缩侵蚀54%的项目约束）；3. KO在所有条件下保持100%准确率，成本降低252倍；4. 多跳推理：KO 78.9% vs 上下文内31.6%；5. 跨模型复制确认压缩损失是架构性的，非模型特定；6. 嵌入检索对抗性事实精确率仅20%；7. 神经记忆（Titans）能存储但无法按需检索事实。
AI.conclusion: 上下文内记忆存在根本性架构缺陷，表现为容量限制、压缩损失和目标漂移。知识对象（KO）通过哈希寻址的离散存储方式在准确率、成本和推理能力上全面优于上下文内记忆。嵌入检索和神经记忆均无法可靠解决这些问题。研究引入密度自适应检索作为切换机制，并发布基准测试套件。

title: Abstraction as a Memory-Efficient Inductive Bias for Continual Learning
summary: The real world is non-stationary and infinitely complex, requiring intelligent agents to learn continually without the prohibitive cost of retraining from scratch. While online continual learning offers a framework for this setting, learning new information often interferes with previously acquired knowledge, causes forgetting and degraded generalization. To address this, we propose Abstraction-Augmented Training (AAT), a loss-level modification encouraging models to capture the latent relational structure shared across examples. By jointly optimizing over concrete instances and their abstract representations, AAT introduces a memory-efficient inductive bias that stabilizes learning in strictly online data streams, eliminating the need for a replay buffer. To capture the multi-faceted nature of abstraction, we introduce and evaluate AAT on two benchmarks: a controlled relational dataset where abstraction is realized through entity masking, and a narrative dataset where abstraction is expressed through shared proverbs. Our results show that AAT achieves performance comparable to or exceeding strong experience replay (ER) baselines, despite requiring zero additional memory and only minimal changes to the training objective. This work highlights structural abstraction as a powerful, memory-free alternative to ER.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Abstraction-Augmented Training (AAT)的持续学习方法，通过在损失函数层面鼓励模型捕捉跨样本的潜在关系结构，实现无需经验回放缓冲区的记忆高效在线学习。实验表明AAT在两个基准数据集（实体掩码关系数据集和共享谚语叙事数据集）上达到与或超过强ER基线的性能。
AI.motivation: The real world is non-stationary and infinitely complex, requiring intelligent agents to learn continually without prohibitive retraining costs. However, online continual learning faces catastrophic forgetting where learning new information interferes with previously acquired knowledge, causing degraded generalization.
AI.method: Abstraction-Augmented Training (AAT): a loss-level modification that jointly optimizes over concrete instances and their abstract representations, introducing a memory-efficient inductive bias that stabilizes learning in strictly online data streams.
AI.result: AAT achieves performance comparable to or exceeding strong experience replay (ER) baselines, despite requiring zero additional memory and only minimal changes to the training objective.
AI.conclusion: AAT provides a memory-efficient alternative to experience replay, achieving comparable or superior performance by leveraging structural abstraction. This approach eliminates the need for replay buffers in continual learning settings while maintaining learning stability in online data streams.

title: Catching rationalization in the act: detecting motivated reasoning before and after CoT via activation probing
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can produce chains of thought (CoT) that do not accurately reflect the actual factors driving their answers. In multiple-choice settings with an injected hint favoring a particular option, models may shift their final answer toward the hinted option and produce a CoT that rationalizes the response without acknowledging the hint - an instance of motivated reasoning. We study this phenomenon across multiple LLM families and datasets demonstrating that motivated reasoning can be identified by probing internal activations even in cases when it cannot be easily determined from CoT. Using supervised probes trained on the model's residual stream, we show that (i) pre-generation probes, applied before any CoT tokens are generated, predict motivated reasoning as well as a LLM-based CoT monitor that accesses the full CoT trace, and (ii) post-generation probes, applied after CoT generation, outperform the same monitor. Together, these results show that motivated reasoning is detected more reliably from internal representations than from CoT monitoring. Moreover, pre-generation probing can flag motivated behavior early, potentially avoiding unnecessary generation.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了LLM中动机推理现象的存在及其检测方法，证明从模型内部激活状态比从生成的思维链更能可靠地识别动机推理，且预生成探针可实现早期预警。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型可以产生不准确反映实际驱动因素的思维链（CoT）。在有多选提示的场景中，模型会偏向提示的选项并产生看似合理但未承认提示的CoT，这是动机推理的表现。需要一种方法来可靠地检测这种动机推理。
AI.method: 使用在模型残差流上训练的监督探针进行实验。实验包括两种探针：(i) 预生成探针，在CoT标记生成之前应用；(ii) 后生成探针，在CoT生成之后应用。将探针性能与基于LLM的CoT监控器进行比较。
AI.result: 预生成探针在预测动机推理方面与访问完整CoT轨迹的LLM CoT监控器表现相当，而后生成探针则优于该监控器。内部表示比CoT监控更能可靠地检测动机推理。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过探针技术从LLM内部表示检测动机推理比从思维链（CoT）监控更为可靠。预生成探针可以在CoT生成之前就标记动机推理行为，从而避免不必要的生成过程。

title: RPMS: Enhancing LLM-Based Embodied Planning through Rule-Augmented Memory Synergy
summary: LLM agents often fail in closed-world embodied environments because actions must satisfy strict preconditions -- such as location, inventory, and container states -- and failure feedback is sparse. We identify two structurally coupled failure modes: (P1) invalid action generation and (P2) state drift, each amplifying the other in a degenerative cycle. We present RPMS, a conflict-managed architecture that enforces action feasibility via structured rule retrieval, gates memory applicability via a lightweight belief state, and resolves conflicts between the two sources via rules-first arbitration. On ALFWorld (134 unseen tasks), RPMS achieves 59.7% single-trial success with Llama 3.1 8B (+23.9 pp over baseline) and 98.5% with Claude Sonnet 4.5 (+11.9 pp); of the 8B gain, rule retrieval alone contributes +14.9 pp (statistically significant), making it the dominant factor. A key finding is that episodic memory is conditionally useful: it harms performance on some task types when used without grounding, but becomes a stable net positive once filtered by current state and constrained by explicit action rules. Adapting RPMS to ScienceWorld with GPT-4 yields consistent gains across all ablation conditions (avg. score 54.0 vs. 44.9 for the ReAct baseline), providing transfer evidence that the core mechanisms hold across structurally distinct environments.

AI.tldr: RPMS是一种冲突管理架构，通过结构化规则检索、基于信念状态的记忆门控和规则优先仲裁来解决LLM智能体在闭环体现环境中的两类耦合失败模式（无效动作生成和状态漂移），在ALFWorld上实现显著提升，且 episodic memory 需要条件过滤才能发挥正向作用。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在闭环体现环境中经常失败，因为动作必须满足严格的前提条件（如位置、库存、容器状态），且失败反馈稀疏。研究识别出两种结构耦合的失败模式：(P1)无效动作生成和(P2)状态漂移，二者形成恶性循环。
AI.method: 提出RPMS架构，包含三个核心机制：(1)结构化规则检索强制动作可行性；(2)轻量级信念状态 gating 记忆适用性；(3)规则优先仲裁解决两个来源之间的冲突。规则检索在8B模型中贡献了+14.9 pp的增益。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld（134个未见任务）上，RPMS使用Llama 3.1 8B达到59.7%单次试验成功率（+23.9 pp），使用Claude Sonnet 4.5达到98.5%（+11.9 pp）。在ScienceWorld上使用GPT-4适配，平均得分54.0 vs 44.9（ReAct基线）。关键发现：episodic memory 在无 grounding 时对某些任务类型有害，但通过当前状态过滤和动作规则约束后可成为稳定正向因素。
AI.conclusion: RPMS通过冲突管理机制有效解决了LLM智能体在闭环体现环境中的耦合失败问题。规则检索是主要贡献因素，episodic memory 需要条件过滤才能发挥正向作用。该机制在不同模型和环境中具有迁移泛化性。

title: On the Cone Effect and Modality Gap in Medical Vision-Language Embeddings
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit a characteristic "cone effect" in which nonlinear encoders map embeddings into highly concentrated regions of the representation space, contributing to cross-modal separation known as the modality gap. While this phenomenon has been widely observed, its practical impact on supervised multimodal learning -particularly in medical domains- remains unclear. In this work, we introduce a lightweight post-hoc mechanism that keeps pretrained VLM encoders frozen while continuously controlling cross-modal separation through a single hyperparameter {λ}. This enables systematic analysis of how the modality gap affects downstream multimodal performance without expensive retraining. We evaluate generalist (CLIP, SigLIP) and medically specialized (BioMedCLIP, MedSigLIP) models across diverse medical and natural datasets in a supervised multimodal settings. Results consistently show that reducing excessive modality gap improves downstream performance, with medical datasets exhibiting stronger sensitivity to gap modulation; however, fully collapsing the gap is not always optimal, and intermediate, task-dependent separation yields the best results. These findings position the modality gap as a tunable property of multimodal representations rather than a quantity that should be universally minimized.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的"锥体效应"导致的模态差距(modality gap)问题，提出了一种轻量级的后处理机制来控制跨模态分离度，无需重新训练即可分析模态差距对下游多模态性能的影响。
AI.motivation: VLMs存在"锥体效应"，非线性编码器将嵌入映射到表示空间的高度集中区域，导致跨模态分离（模态差距），但这一现象对监督多模态学习的实际影响尚不明确，尤其是在医学领域。
AI.method: 提出一种轻量级后处理机制，保持预训练VLM编码器冻结状态，通过单一超参数λ连续控制跨模态分离程度，实现无需昂贵重训练的模态差距系统分析。评估了通用模型（CLIP、SigLIP）和医学专用模型（BioMedCLIP、MedSigLIP）在多种医学和自然数据集上的表现。
AI.result: 减少过度模态差距可提升下游性能；医学数据集对差距调制的敏感性更强；完全消除差距并非最优，任务相关的中间分离度效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 模态差距应被视为多模态表示的可调属性，而非需统一最小化的量。最佳分离度因任务而异，需针对性优化。

title: AgentFactory: A Self-Evolving Framework Through Executable Subagent Accumulation and Reuse
summary: Building LLM-based agents has become increasingly important. Recent works on LLM-based agent self-evolution primarily record successful experiences as textual prompts or reflections, which cannot reliably guarantee efficient task re-execution in complex scenarios. We propose AgentFactory, a new self-evolution paradigm that preserves successful task solutions as executable subagent code rather than textual experience. Crucially, these subagents are continuously refined based on execution feedback, becoming increasingly robust and efficient as more tasks are encountered. Saved subagents are pure Python code with standardized documentation, enabling portability across any Python-capable system. We demonstrate that AgentFactory enables continuous capability accumulation: its library of executable subagents grows and improves over time, progressively reducing the effort required for similar tasks without manual intervention. Our implementation is open-sourced at https://github.com/zzatpku/AgentFactory, and our demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/iKSsuAXJHW0.

AI.tldr: AgentFactory是一种新的LLM智能体自进化框架，其核心创新在于将成功任务解决方案保存为可执行的子智能体代码（而非文本经验），通过执行反馈持续优化，使子智能体库不断增长和提升，实现能力的持续积累和高效任务复用。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体自进化方法主要将成功经验记录为文本提示或反思，但这种方法无法可靠地保证复杂场景下的高效任务重新执行。文本形式的经验缺乏可执行性，难以在相似任务中直接复用并保证效果。
AI.method: AgentFactory的核心方法包括：1）将成功的任务解决方案保存为可执行的Python子智能体代码，而非文本提示或反思；2）基于执行反馈持续优化和精炼子智能体；3）子智能体采用标准化文档的纯Python代码实现，确保跨Python系统的可移植性。
AI.result: 实验表明AgentFactory能够实现持续的能力积累：其可执行子智能体库不断增长和改进，随着遇到更多任务，相似任务的处理工作量逐渐减少，且无需人工干预。
AI.conclusion: AgentFactory提出了一种新的LLM智能体自进化范式，通过将成功任务解决方案保存为可执行的子智能体代码而非文本经验，实现了持续的能力积累。子智能体库随着任务执行不断增长和改进，为类似任务提供更高效的解决方案，减少人工干预。该方法为构建更强大、更可移植的LLM智能体系统提供了新的思路。

title: Binary Latent Protein Fitness Landscapes for Quantum Annealing Optimization
summary:
We propose Q-BIOLAT, a framework for modeling and optimizing protein fitness landscapes in binary latent spaces. Starting from protein sequences, we leverage pretrained protein language models to obtain continuous embeddings, which are then transformed into compact binary latent representations. In this space, protein fitness is approximated using a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model, enabling efficient combinatorial search via classical heuristics such as simulated annealing and genetic algorithms.
  On the ProteinGym benchmark, we demonstrate that Q-BIOLAT captures meaningful structure in protein fitness landscapes and enables the identification of high-fitness variants. Despite using a simple binarization scheme, our method consistently retrieves sequences whose nearest neighbors lie within the top fraction of the training fitness distribution, particularly under the strongest configurations. We further show that different optimization strategies exhibit distinct behaviors, with evolutionary search performing better in higher-dimensional latent spaces and local search remaining competitive in preserving realistic sequences.
  Beyond its empirical performance, Q-BIOLAT provides a natural bridge between protein representation learning and combinatorial optimization. By formulating protein fitness as a QUBO problem, our framework is directly compatible with emerging quantum annealing hardware, opening new directions for quantum-assisted protein engineering.
  Our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/HySonLab/Q-BIOLAT

AI.tldr: Q-BIOLAT是一个在二进制潜在空间中建模和优化蛋白质适应度景观的框架，利用预训练蛋白质语言模型将序列转换为紧凑的二进制表示，通过二次无约束二进制优化(QUBO)模型近似蛋白质适应度，并使用模拟退火和遗传算法进行组合搜索。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质工程中需要高效建模和优化蛋白质适应度景观，现有的连续嵌入空间方法在组合优化方面存在挑战，需要一种能够桥接蛋白质表示学习与组合优化的方法。
AI.method: 1)使用预训练蛋白质语言模型获取连续嵌入 2)通过简单二值化方案转换为紧凑二进制潜在表示 3)在二进制空间中使用QUBO模型近似蛋白质适应度 4)使用模拟退火和遗传算法等经典启发式算法进行高效组合搜索
AI.result: 在ProteinGym基准测试中，Q-BIOLAT能够捕获蛋白质适应度景观的有意义结构，成功识别高适应度变体；不同优化策略表现各异——进化搜索在高维潜在空间表现更好，局部搜索在保持真实序列方面具有竞争力；特别是在最强配置下，检索到的序列的最近邻位于训练适应度分布的前列。
AI.conclusion: Q-BIOLAT为蛋白质表示学习与组合优化提供了自然桥梁，通过将蛋白质适应度形式化为QUBO问题，使框架可直接兼容新兴量子退火硬件，为量子辅助蛋白质工程开辟新方向。

title: Pathology-Aware Multi-View Contrastive Learning for Patient-Independent ECG Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing a 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) from a reduced lead set is an ill-posed inverse problem due to anatomical variability. Standard deep learning methods often ignore underlying cardiac pathology losing vital morphology in precordial leads. We propose Pathology-Aware Multi-View Contrastive Learning, a framework that regularizes the latent space through a pathological manifold. Our architecture integrates high-fidelity time-domain waveforms with pathology-aware embeddings learned via supervised contrastive alignment. By maximizing mutual information between latent representations and clinical labels, the framework learns to filter anatomical "nuisance" variables. On the PTB-XL dataset, our method achieves approx. 76\% reduction in RMSE compared to state-of-the-art model in patient-independent setting. Cross-dataset evaluation on the PTB Diagnostic Database confirms superior generalization, bridging the gap between hardware portability and diagnostic-grade reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出 Pathology-Aware Multi-View Contrastive Learning 框架，通过病理流形正则化潜在空间，将高保真时域波形与病理感知嵌入相结合，从减少的导联集重建12导联心电图。
AI.motivation: 从减少的导联集重建12导联心电图是一个不适定的逆问题，由于解剖学变异性，标准深度学习方法往往忽略潜在的心脏病理，导致胸前导联丢失重要形态学信息。
AI.method: 提出 Pathology-Aware Multi-View Contrastive Learning 框架，通过监督对比对齐学习病理感知嵌入，最大化潜在表示与临床标签之间的互信息，从而过滤解剖学"干扰"变量。架构集成高保真时域波形与病理感知嵌入。
AI.result: 在 PTB-XL 数据集上，与最先进模型相比，RMSE 降低约 76%。在 PTB Diagnostic Database 上的跨数据集评估证实了优异的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功弥合了硬件便携性与诊断级重建之间的差距，通过病理感知学习有效处理了解剖学变异性问题，为从减少导联集重建诊断级12导联心电图提供了有效方案。

title: Variational Rectification Inference for Learning with Noisy Labels
summary: Label noise has been broadly observed in real-world datasets. To mitigate the negative impact of overfitting to label noise for deep models, effective strategies (\textit{e.g.}, re-weighting, or loss rectification) have been broadly applied in prevailing approaches, which have been generally learned under the meta-learning scenario. Despite the robustness of noise achieved by the probabilistic meta-learning models, they usually suffer from model collapse that degenerates generalization performance. In this paper, we propose variational rectification inference (VRI) to formulate the adaptive rectification for loss functions as an amortized variational inference problem and derive the evidence lower bound under the meta-learning framework. Specifically, VRI is constructed as a hierarchical Bayes by treating the rectifying vector as a latent variable, which can rectify the loss of the noisy sample with the extra randomness regularization and is, therefore, more robust to label noise. To achieve the inference of the rectifying vector, we approximate its conditional posterior with an amortization meta-network. By introducing the variational term in VRI, the conditional posterior is estimated accurately and avoids collapsing to a Dirac delta function, which can significantly improve the generalization performance. The elaborated meta-network and prior network adhere to the smoothness assumption, enabling the generation of reliable rectification vectors. Given a set of clean meta-data, VRI can be efficiently meta-learned within the bi-level optimization programming. Besides, theoretical analysis guarantees that the meta-network can be efficiently learned with our algorithm. Comprehensive comparison experiments and analyses validate its effectiveness for robust learning with noisy labels, particularly in the presence of open-set noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出变分整纠正推断（VRI），把带噪标签下的自适应损失整正过程建模为摊销变分推断问题，在元学习框架下推导新的ELBO目标。VRI将整正向量视为层次贝叶斯模型中的隐变量，用摊销元网络近似其条件后验，并引入先验网络以KL正则项防止MC近似中的模型坍缩为Dirac delta，同时借助平滑性假设从特征而非噪声标签中获取判别信息，从而在双层优化下高效元学习整正策略。
AI.motivation: 深度模型在噪声标签上会过拟合。重加权与损失整正是两大主流策略，但存在两个局限：(1) 权重函数形式需在数据分布假设下手工指定，可扩展性差；(2) 超参数依赖交叉验证调参，扩展性差。基于元学习的方法（Meta-Weight-Net、Meta Label Corrector、Probabilistic Meta-Weight-Net、WarPI）借助少量干净元数据可数据驱动地学习权重/纠正函数，但概率化元学习仍存在两个未解问题：(1) MC近似下条件先验易坍缩为Dirac delta，模型退化为确定性网络，导致泛化性能退化；(2) 忽略了数据固有的平滑性假设——当特征中的判别信息与（可能含噪的）标签不一致时，元网络不应过度依赖标签，而应主要依赖特征。
AI.method:
1) 概率建模：将整正向量 v 视为隐变量，构建层次贝叶斯模型，目标为最大化 log p_θ(y|x) = log ∫ p_θ(y|x,v) p(v|x) dv；用变分分布 q_φ(v|x,y)（以特征嵌入与标签为输入）近似不可解的后验 p(v|x,y)，最小化 KL[q_φ || p_θ]，经贝叶斯公式推导得ELBO：L_ELBO = E_{q_φ}[p_θ(y|x,v)] − D_KL[q_φ(v|x,y) || p_ω(v|x)]。
2) 三个网络：分类网络 F_θ；摊销元网络 V_φ 输出因子化高斯的 (μ, log σ²) 作为后验 q；先验网络 H_ω 仅以特征为输入输出 (μ, log σ²) 作为先验 p。v 经重参数化采样 v = μ + σ·ε，ε~N(0,I)，并经 sigmoid π 约束到 [0,1] 以避免负值扰乱学习；整正后的 logits 为 π[v] ⊙ F_θ(x)。
3) 目标与优化：经验损失 L^emp(θ) 采用 MC 采样平均（k=1或2）并加 KL 正则项（权重 λ=0.001）；元目标 L^meta(φ,ω) 在干净元数据上计算；采用双层优化（Franceschi et al.）：内层更新 θ̂，固定 θ̂ 后回传更新 φ 与 ω，再用更新后的 φ 指导 θ 的下一步更新（SGD/Adam）。
4) 理论：Lemma 1 证明关于 φ 的元损失是 ℓ̂-平滑（需损失 ℓ-光滑、τ-Lipschitz、KL 梯度 o-有界、元网络梯度 δ-有界与 Hessian ζ-有界）；Theorem 1 给出收敛率 O(1/√T)，并可找到 ε-一阶驻点，步数 O(1/ε²)，与 MAML 类确定性双层算法一致。
5) 无元数据场景：warm-up + 小损失样本选择构造伪元数据，并可类别均衡、GMM 选样、mixup 增强。
AI.result: 合成噪声：CIFAR-10 flip 40% 达 93.79%（ResNet-34）/91.21%（ResNet-32），优于 EMLC 等；CIFAR-100 flip 20% 达 75.13%，较 EMLC 提升 5.08%；uniform、instance-dependent 噪声下亦领先或持平 SOTA。真实噪声：Clothing1M 75.19%（较 MW-Net 提升 1.4%），Food-101N 86.24%。开集噪声 CIFAR80N：Unif20% 72.90%、Unif50% 67.03%、Unif80% 35.44%、Flip40% 64.71%，其中 Flip40% 比 SOTA 高 3.48%。效率：k=1 时 VRI 达 90.20%（2.20 min/epoch），优于 MC 近似的 k=1（88.23%）乃至 k=5（89.87%，7.04 min/epoch）；后验方差范数稳定在 3 附近，验证了不发生坍缩。消融：Sigmoid 末层（91.29%）优于 Tanh（88.17%）和无 Sigmoid（86.90%）；meta-net 结构 {1024,512} 最优（91.21%）；非贝叶斯变体在各设置下均明显下降（如 CIFAR-100 Inst.40%：68.17% vs 64.92%）；无元数据时 VRI(-) 在 CIFAR-10 uniform 60% 仍达 74.54%，ANIMAL-10N 达 85.8%。
AI.conclusion: VRI 通过将损失整正形式化为摊销变分推断，构建层次贝叶斯框架，以摊销元网络推断整正向量的条件后验，并用KL变分项与先验网络抑制MC近似的模型坍缩；同时利用平滑性假设让元网络依赖特征判别信息，提升泛化性。配合双层优化可高效元学习，并有O(1/√T)收敛率保证。大量实验表明其在flip/uniform/实例相关/真实/开集噪声下整体优于或持平SOTA，尤其在开集噪声与高噪声率下优势明显，且仅需1个采样即可获得优于MC多采样的效果与效率。局限在于仍需干净元数据（可用伪元数据缓解），且需计算元网络二阶导数（但网络仅三层全连接，开销可控）。

title: Classifier Pooling for Modern Ordinal Classification
summary: Ordinal data is widely prevalent in clinical and other domains, yet there is a lack of both modern, machine-learning based methods and publicly available software to address it. In this paper, we present a model-agnostic method of ordinal classification, which can apply any non-ordinal classification method in an ordinal fashion. We also provide an open-source implementation of these algorithms, in the form of a Python package. We apply these models on multiple real-world datasets to show their performance across domains. We show that they often outperform non-ordinal classification methods, especially when the number of datapoints is relatively small or when there are many classes of outcomes. This work, including the developed software, facilitates the use of modern, more powerful machine learning algorithms to handle ordinal data.

AI.tldr: 针对序数数据缺乏现代机器学习方法和软件的问题，提出模型无关的序数分类方法并开发Python开源包，实验表明该方法在小样本或大多类别场景下性能优异。
AI.motivation: 序数数据在临床和其他领域广泛存在，但缺乏现代机器学习方法处理序数数据，也缺少公开可用的软件工具。
AI.method: 提出模型无关的序数分类方法，将任意非序数分类方法转化为序数分类方法；开发了Python开源软件包实现这些算法；在多个真实数据集上验证性能。
AI.result: 提出的序数分类方法通常优于非序数分类方法，特别是在数据点较少或结局类别较多时。
AI.conclusion: 开发了一个模型无关的序数分类方法和一个Python开源软件包，使现代机器学习算法能够处理序数数据。该方法在数据点较少或类别较多时表现尤其优异。

title: WINFlowNets: Warm-up Integrated Networks Training of Generative Flow Networks for Robotics and Machine Fault Adaptation
summary: Generative Flow Networks for continuous scenarios (CFlowNets) have shown promise in solving sequential decision-making tasks by learning stochastic policies using a flow and a retrieval network. Despite their demonstrated efficiency compared to state-of-the-art Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms, their practical application in robotic control tasks is constrained by the reliance on pre-training the retrieval network. This dependency poses challenges in dynamic robotic environments, where pre-training data may not be readily available or representative of the current environment. This paper introduces WINFlowNets, a novel CFlowNets framework that enables the co-training of flow and retrieval networks. WINFlowNets begins with a warm-up phase for the retrieval network to bootstrap its policy, followed by a shared training architecture and a shared replay buffer for co-training both networks. Experiments in simulated robotic environments demonstrate that WINFlowNets surpasses CFlowNets and state-of-the-art RL algorithms in terms of average reward and training stability. Furthermore, WINFlowNets exhibits strong adaptive capability in fault environments, making it suitable for tasks that demand quick adaptation with limited sample data. These findings highlight WINFlowNets' potential for deployment in dynamic and malfunction-prone robotic systems, where traditional pre-training or sample inefficient data collection may be impractical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WINFlowNets：一种无需预训练检索网络的连续流网络（CFlowNets）新训练框架，通过"预热（Warm-Up）+ 双网络联合训练（Dual-Training）+ 共享回放缓冲区"实现流网络 F_θ 与检索网络 G_φ 的协同训练。在 MuJoCo Reacher-v2 正常环境与两种故障环境（执行器损坏 AD、活动范围受限 ROM）下，WINFlowNets 在平均回报与最终性能上优于 CFlowNets、PPO、SAC、DDPG，尤其在分布外故障场景中表现出更强的适应能力，但代价是样本效率与算力开销低于预训练版 CFlowNets。
AI.motivation: CFlowNets 在连续控制任务中虽具备比 PPO/SAC 更强的探索与样本效率，但其原始训练架构要求先单独预训练检索网络 G_φ（用于估计父状态、计算流入 f⁺），这一前提在动态机器人环境中难以满足：预训练数据可能不可获得或无法代表当前环境，硬件故障等异常还会造成分布外（OOD）状态，导致流入/流出估计错误、性能退化；同时预训练还带来额外的时间、显存与算力开销。因此需要一个能在训练过程中让 G_φ 随环境动态演化、能快速适应故障的自适应训练框架。
AI.method: 问题建模为 MDP。保留 CFlowNets 的核心机制：动作选择时从动作空间均匀采样 M 个候选动作，用流网络 F_θ 计算流值构造动作概率缓冲 P=[F_θ(s_t,a_i)]，按 P 采样执行；流入用检索网络 G_φ 预测的父状态近似（f̂⁺=μ(A)/K·Σ F_θ(G_φ(s_t,a_k),a_k)），流出直接由 F_θ 在当前状态计算（f̂⁻=μ(A)/K·Σ F_θ(s_t,a_k)），并用 log-sum-exp 形式的连续流匹配损失 L_θ 更新 F_θ。框架包含两个模块：Module 1 预热阶段（100k 步）——仅训练 G_φ，随机选动作收集经验存入回放缓冲 β，用前驱状态预测的 MSE 损失 L_φ（配合由低到高递增的动态学习率）训练 G_φ；Module 2 双网络联合训练阶段——F_θ 与 G_φ 同时与环境交互、共享同一回放缓冲 β，每回合后用同一批数据同时更新 F_θ（式2 流匹配损失）与 G_φ（式3 MSE 损失），两者相互强化。实验在 MuJoCo Reacher-v2 上进行：正常环境对比 CFlowNets、PPO、SAC、DDPG；故障环境注入执行器功率降至 1/4（AD）与 joint1 角度范围由 [-3.0,3.0] 收窄至 [-1.5,1.5]（ROM），先在正常环境训练后迁移模型与回放缓冲继续训练；评估指标为 10 次评估的平均回报（95% 置信区间）、最后 20 次评估的最终性能与样本效率，并做消融（v1 仅双训练、v2 独立缓冲区 vs. 原版共享缓冲区）。
AI.result: 正常环境：WINFlowNets 最终性能 -2.39±0.17，显著优于 CFlowNets (-3.70±0.05)、SAC (-7.89±0.16)、PPO (-9.50±0.37)、DDPG (-9.55±0.44)（双尾 t 检验 p<0.05）；因无预训练，其初始回报上升慢于 CFlowNets，约 240k 步后反超，0.2M 与 0.8M 步附近出现两次回报跃升，样本效率 0.72M 步劣于 CFlowNets 的 0.10M 与 SAC 的 0.67M。故障环境：AD 中 WINFlowNets -8.25±0.19 优于 CFlowNets -9.01 与 SAC -9.69；ROM 中 -5.25±0.12 优于 CFlowNets -8.50 与 SAC -6.16；其前 400k 步因预热与更强探索而表现波动，后期方差逐渐收窄、置信区间变窄，说明稳定性随训练提升。消融显示：去掉预热（v1）最差且不稳定（渐近 -8.2），预热+独立缓冲区（v2）为 -4.6，两者均不及完整版（-2.39），验证了预热、双训练与共享缓冲区三者的组合效应。
AI.conclusion: WINFlowNets 通过预热—联合训练两阶段架构与共享回放缓冲，实现了流网络与检索网络的协同进化，免除了预训练 G_φ 的需求，在正常与故障/OOD 的连续机器人控制任务中取得最高平均回报，且不确定性随训练下降。但代价明确：需要比 CFlowNets 与 SAC 更多的样本与更长收敛时间、GPU 显存与算力开销更高、对预热时长/学习率/缓冲区大小等超参数敏感，因此不适合安全关键（人机交互）与资源受限的边缘部署，且实验仅限仿真。后续方向包括引入按 TD 误差优先采样的优先回放缓冲以缩短预热期、模型压缩与分布式训练的轻量化变体，以及在真实机器人平台和更多 OOD 场景上验证。

title: Learning Permutation Distributions via Reflected Diffusion on Ranks
summary: The finite symmetric group S_n provides a natural domain for permutations, yet learning probability distributions on S_n is challenging due to its factorially growing size and discrete, non-Euclidean structure. Recent permutation diffusion methods define forward noising via shuffle-based random walks (e.g., riffle shuffles) and learn reverse transitions with Plackett-Luce (PL) variants, but the resulting trajectories can be abrupt and increasingly hard to denoise as n grows. We propose Soft-Rank Diffusion, a discrete diffusion framework that replaces shuffle-based corruption with a structured soft-rank forward process: we lift permutations to a continuous latent representation of order by relaxing discrete ranks into soft ranks, yielding smoother and more tractable trajectories. For the reverse process, we introduce contextualized generalized Plackett-Luce (cGPL) denoisers that generalize prior PL-style parameterizations and improve expressivity for sequential decision structures. Experiments on sorting and combinatorial optimization benchmarks show that Soft-Rank Diffusion consistently outperforms prior diffusion baselines, with particularly strong gains in long-sequence and intrinsically sequential settings.

AI.tldr: 提出Soft-Rank Diffusion框架，通过将置换松弛为软秩连续表示来解决对称群S_n上的分布学习问题，并使用上下文广义Plackett-Luce (cGPL)去噪器。在排序和组合优化基准测试中优于先前扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 对称群S_n上学习概率分布具有挑战性，原因包括：1) 阶乘级增长的规模；2) 离散非欧几里得结构。现有的基于洗牌的扩散方法（如riffle shuffle）轨迹 abrupt，随n增大难以去噪。
AI.method: 提出两个核心创新：1) 前向过程：软秩（soft-rank）机制——将置换提升为连续的秩表示，将离散秩松弛为软秩，产生更平滑可处理的轨迹；2) 逆向过程：上下文广义Plackett-Luce (cGPL)去噪器——推广先前PL类参数化，增强顺序决策结构的表达能力。
AI.result: 在排序和组合优化基准测试中一致优于先前扩散基线，在长序列和内在顺序设置中取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 软秩机制提供了更平滑的轨迹，cGPL去噪器增强了顺序决策结构的表达能力，验证了连续松弛和增强表达力对离散扩散模型的有效性。

title: Beyond Outliers: A Data-Free Layer-wise Mixed-Precision Quantization Approach Driven by Numerical and Structural Dual-Sensitivity
summary: Layer-wise mixed-precision quantization (LMPQ) enables effective compression under extreme low-bit settings by allocating higher precision to sensitive layers. However, existing methods typically treat all intra-layer weight modules uniformly and rely on a single numerical property when estimating sensitivity, overlooking their distinct operational roles and structural characteristics. To address this, we propose NSDS, a novel calibration-free LMPQ framework driven by Numerical and Structural Dual-Sensitivity. Specifically, it first mechanistically decomposes each layer into distinct operational roles and quantifies their sensitivity from both numerical and structural perspectives.
